र: र 1. र, the twenty-seventh consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet, being the semivowel of the vowels ऋ, ॠ, and having the sound of the English r in real. —र-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound र।
र 2. र, अस्, m. fire; heat, warmth; burn-ing, scorching; love, desire; speed; (आ), f. = वि-भ्रम; giving, = दान; gold, = काञ्चन; (ई), f. going, motion, = गति; (अम्), n. = तेजस्, bright-ness, splendor.
र 3. र, (in prosody) a cretic or a short between two long syllables. —र-विपुला, f. ‘abound-ing in cretics,’ N. of a metre.
रसु: रसु रंसु, उस्, उस्, उ (said by some to be fr. rt. रण्, but according to Nirukta VI. 17. and Sāy. fr. rt. रम्), Ved. cheerful, joyful, delightful; (उ), ind. cheerfully, delightfully, (Sāy. = रमणी-येषु, i. e. आज्यादि-हविःषु, in oblations, &c.) —रंसु-जिह्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having a pleasing tongue or voice, (Sāy. = रमणीय-ज्वालोपेत, pos-sessing a pleasing tongue of flame.)
रंह्: रंह् रंह् (connected with rt. लङ्घ्; cf. rt. रङ्घ्), cl. 1. P. रंहति (also Ved. A. रंहते), ररंह, रंहितुम्, to go, move with speed, hasten; to make to run or go rapidly, cause to flow; to flow: Caus. रंहयति (according to some also रंहापयति), to cause to move rapidly, urge on; to cause to flow; to go; to speak; to shine, (in the last two senses a various reading for rt. वंह्); [cf. perhaps Gr. τρέχ-ω; Goth. thrag-ja.]
रंहण: रंहण, अम्, n. going swiftly, hastening.
रंहति: रंहति, इस्, f. (?), speed, velocity; the speed of a chariot.
रंहमाण: रंहमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, moving or flowing rapidly, (Sāy. = वेगं कुर्वाण।)
रंहस्: रंहस्, अस्, n. speed, quickness, velocity; eager-ness, vehemence, violence, impetuosity; N. of Śiva, (Vehemence personified); of Viṣṇu.
रंहस: रंहस at the end of an adj. comp. = रंहस्।
रंहि: रंहि, इस्, f., Ved. the act of running or flowing, a running stream; the making to run, pursuing, hunting; speed, haste, flight.
रारहाण: रारहाण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. Intens.; in Pada-pāṭha ररहाण), Ved. going quickly, hastening, swift.
रक्: रक् रक् (connected with rts. रग्, रघ्, लक्, लग्), cl. 10. P. राकयति, &c., to taste, relish; to obtain, get.
रक: रक, अस्, m. the sun gem; crystal; a hard shower.
रकसा: रकसा रकसा, f. a mild form of leprosy.
रक्क: रक्क रक्क, अस्, m. a proper N. —रक्क-जया, f., N. of a statue of Śrī erected by Rakka.
रक्त: रक्त रक्त, रक्तक, रक्त-कङ्गु, &c. See p. 826, col. 3, and p. 828, col. 1.

A. -सूर्यायते, &c., to represent or be like a red sun. —रक्त-सौगन्-धिक, अम्, n. a red lotus-flower. —रक्त-स्रग्-अनुलेपिन्, ई, m. (probably) ‘wearing a red garland and being anointed,’ epithet of Śiva. —रक्त-स्राव, अस्, m. a flow of blood, hemorrhage (Ved.); a kind of sour sorrel or dock. —रक्त-हंसा, f., N. of a Rāgiṇī. —रक्त-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, bloodless, cold-blooded. —रक्ताकार (°त-आक्°), अस्, m. ‘having a red appearance,’ coral. —रक्ताक्त (°त-आक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, dyed red; sprinkled or besmeared with blood; (अम्), n. red sandal or Cæsalpina Sappan. —रक्ता-क्ष (°त-अक्°), अस्, ई, अम्, red-eyed, having red or blood-shot eyes; fearful, dreadful, = क्रूर; (अस्), m. a buffalo; Perdix Rufa; a pigeon; the Indian crane; N. of a sorcerer; (अम्), n., N. of the fifty-eighth year in a Jupiter's cycle of sixty years. —रक्ताक्षि (°त-अक्°), इस्, or रक्ताक्षिन्, ई, m., N. of the fifty-eighth year in a Jupiter's cycle of sixty years. —रक्-ताङ्क (°त-अङ्°), अस्, m. coral. —रक्ताङ्ग (°त-अङ्°), अस्, m. ‘red-bodied,’ a species of bird; a bug; a species of plant (= काम्पिल्ल, कम्पिल्ल); the planet Mars; the disk of the sun or moon; N. of a serpent-demon; (आ, ई), f. a species of plant, = जी-वन्ती; (ई), f. Rubia Munjista; coral; (अम्), n. coral; saffron; a species of plant (= कम्पिल्ल)। —रक्तातिसार or रक्तातीसार (°त-अत्°), अस्, m. ‘blood-diarrhœa,’ dysentery, bloody flux. —रक्ता-धरा (°त-अध्°), f. a Kinnarī. —रक्ताधार (°त-आध्°), अस्, m. ‘blood-receptacle,’ the skin. —रक्ताधिमन्थ (°त-अध्°), अस्, m. inflamma-tion of the eyes, ophthalmia with discharge of blood. —रक्तान्त (°त-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having red ex-tremities, having the corners (of the eyes) inflamed. —रक्तापह (°त-अप्°), अम्, n. myrrh. —रक्ता-पामार्ग (°त-अप्°), अस्, m. red-flowering Apā-mārga. —रक्ताभ (°त-आभ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, red-looking, having a red appearance. —रक्ताभिष्-यन्द (°त-अभ्°), अस्, m. ophthalmia brought on by the state of the blood, redness of the vessels of the eye with a watery discharge. —रक्तामिषाद (°त-आमिष-अद), अस्, आ, अम्, eating blood and flesh. —रक्ताम्बर (°त-अम्°), अम्, n. a red garment; (अस्, आ, अम्), wearing a red cloth, clad in red gar-ments; (अस्), m. any vagrant devotee wearing red garments; (आ), f., N. of a goddess. —रक्ताम्बर-त्व, अम्, n. the wearing of red garments (with Buddhist monks). —रक्ताम्बर-धर, अस्, आ, अम्, wearing red garments. —रक्ताम्बु-पूर (°त-अम्°), अस्, m. a stream or flood of blood. —रक्-ताम्बु-रुह (°त-अम्°), अम्, n. a red lotus-flower. —रक्ताम्र (°त-आम्°), अस्, m. a species of plant (= कोशाम्र). —रक्तारुण (°त-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, blood-red, red as blood. —रक्तार्बुद (°त-अर्°), अस्, m. a bloody tumour. —रक्तार्मन् (°त-अर्°), अ, n. a particular disease of the eyes. —रक्तार्शस् (°त-अर्°), अस्, n. a form of hemorrhoids. —रक्तालु (°त-आलु), उस्, or रक्तालुक, अस्, m. a species of red yam, Dioscorea Purpurea. —रक्ताशय (°त-आश्°), अस्, m. ‘blood-receptacle,’ any viscus containing or secreting blood (as the heart, liver, spleen). —रक्ताशोक (°त-अश्°), अस्, m. red-flowering Aśoka. —रक्तेक्षु (°त-इक्°), उस्, m. red sugar-cane. —रक्तैरण्ड (°त-एर्°), अस्, m. the red Ricinus or castor-oil plant. —रक्तैर्वारु (°त-एर्°), उस्, m. a kind of cucum-ber (= इन्द्र-वारुणी). —रक्तोत्क्लिष्ट (°त-उत्°), अस्, m. a particular disease of the eyes. —रक्तोत्पल (°त-उत्°), अस्, m. Bombax Heptaphyllum; (अम्), n. a red lotus, the flower of Nymphæa Rubra. —रक्-तोत्पलाभ (°ल-आभ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, being like the colour of Nymphæa Rubra, resembling the red lotus. —रक्तोपल (°त-उप्°), अम्, n. red chalk, red earth, red ochre or orpiment, indurated ochre or clay iron-stone.
रक्ति: रक्ति, इस्, f. pleasingness, attractiveness, charming-ness, loveliness; the being attached, affection, attach-ment, devotion, loyalty; = रक्तिका, the seed of Abrus Precatorius. —रक्ति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing charms, charming, lovely, attractive.
रक्ष्: रक्ष् 1. रक्ष् (thought by some to be connected with rt. रञ्ज् as a kind of Desid. form of that rt.), cl. 1. P. रक्षति (Ved. and ep. also A. रक्षते), ररक्ष, रक्षिष्यति, अरक्षीत् (an earlier form अराक्षीत् is also given, Ved. Leṭ. रक्-षिषत्), रक्षितुम्, to guard, watch, take care of, protect, preserve, save, keep, (रहस्यं रक्ष्, to keep a secret), hold, maintain, tend, (पशून् रक्ष्, to tend cattle); to govern, rule over, (क्षि-तिम् or वसुधां रक्ष्, to govern the earth); to spare, save; to protect or save from (with abl.); to take care, beware of, be on one's guard against; to take refuge or shelter (A.): Caus. रक्षयति, यितुम्, Aor. अररक्षत्, to guard, watch, protect: Desid. रिरक्षिषति, to wish to guard, intend to pro-tect from (with abl.): Intens. रारक्ष्यते, राराष्टि, to protect very carefully; [cf. probably Gr. ἀρκ-έ-ω, ἄρκιο-ς, ἀλκτήρ, ἀλαλκτήρ, ἀλκή, ἀλέξω; Lat. arc-e-o, arx; Goth. ga-rehsns.]
2. रक्ष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, guarding, watching, protecting, tending, &c. (at the end of a comp., cf. गो-रक्ष्).
रक्ष् 3. रक्ष् (probably a form of rt. ऋक्ष् = rts. रिश्, 1. रिष्, q. q. v. v.), Ved. to hurt, injure, destroy, damage.
रक्ष: रक्ष, अस्, ई, m. f. a guard, guardian, protector, keeper; protecting, preserving, watching, keeping, &c. (often at the end of a comp., cf. गो-र्°); (आ), f. the act of protecting or guarding, protection, care, preservation, security; a guard, watch; any preser-vative, any act or right performed for protection or preservation, a sort of bracelet or amulet, any mys-tical token used as a charm; a tutelary divinity [cf. महा-र्°]; ashes (used as a preservative); (आ or ई), f. a piece of thread or silk bound round the wrist on particular occasions (especially on the full moon of Śrāvaṇa, either as an amulet and preservative against misfortune, or as a symbol of mutual dependence, or as a mark of respect; among the Rājputs it is sometimes sent by a lady of rank or family to a person of influence whose protection she is desirous of securing and whom she thus adopts, as it were, as a male relative or brother). —रक्ष-पाल or रक्ष-पालक, अस्, m. a protector, guard. —रक्ष-भ-गवती, f. = प्रज्ञा-पारमिता. —रक्षा-करण्-डक, अम्, n. an amulet in the shape of a small basket. —रक्षा-गृह, अम्, n. ‘watch-room,’ a lying-in chamber, room appropriated to a lying-in woman. —रक्षाधिकृत (°षा-अध्°), अस्, आ, अम्, entrusted with the protection or superintendence (of a country, &c.), placed over the government; (अस्), m. a superintendent or governor (of a province), magistrate, superintendent of police. —रक्षाधि-पति (°षा-अध्°) or रक्षा-पति, इस्, m. one placed over for protection, a superintendent of police. —रक्षा-पत्त्र, अस्, m. a kind of birch tree (= भूर्ज). —रक्षा-पुरुष, अस्, m. a watchman, guard, protector. —रक्षापेक्षक (°षा-अप्°), अस्, m. a doorkeeper, porter; a guard of the women's apartments; a catamite; an actor, mime. —रक्षा-प्रदीप, अस्, m. a light kept burning for protection (against evil spirits, &c.). —रक्षा-भूषण, अम्, n. an ornament or amulet worn for protection (against evil spirits, &c.). —रक्षाभ्यधिकृत (°षा-अभ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, and अस्, m. = रक्षाधिकृत। —रक्षा-मङ्गल, अम्, n. a ceremony performed for protection (against evil spirits, &c.). —रक्षा-मणि, इस्, m. a jewel worn as a preservative (against evil spirits, &c.). —रक्षा-मल्ल, अस्, m., N. of a king. —रक्षा-महौषधि, इस्, f. a sovereign remedy serving as a preservative (against evil spirits, &c.). —रक्षा-रत्न, अम्, n. = रक्षा-मणि। —रक्षा-रत्न-प्रदीप, अस्, m. a lamp shining or brilliant with gems used as a preservative (against evil spirits, &c.; cf. रत्न-प्रदीप). —रक्षार्-थम् (°षा-अर्°), ind. for the sake of guarding, for guarding. —रक्षा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having or en-joying protection, protected, guarded. —रक्षा-सर्-षप, अस्, m. mustard as a preservative (against evil spirits).
रक्षक: रक्षक, अस्, इका, अम्, who or what protects or guards or tends [cf. गो-र्°]; guarding, protecting; (अस्), m. a guardian, protector; a guard, watch; (इका), f. a female guardian or protector; an amulet, charm, anything worn as a preservative (= रक्षा)। —रक्षकाम्बा (°क-अम्°), f., N. of the wife of Rāmānuja.
रक्षण: रक्षण, अस्, m. a protector, defender, guardian; N. of Viṣṇu; (आ), f. the act of protecting or guard-ing, watching over, protection; (ई), f. a rein, bridle; (अम्), n. the act of guarding, watching, protecting, tending, caring for, preserving, protection, (पशू-नां रक्षणम्, the tending of cattle); a ceremony performed for protection or preservation. —रक्ष-णार्थम् (°ण-अर्°), ind. for the sake of guarding or protecting. —रक्षणोपाय (°ण-उप्°), अस्, m. a means of safety.
रक्षणारक: रक्षणारक or रक्षणीरक, अस्, m. (pro-bably connected with rt. 1. रक्ष्), morbid retention of urine.
रक्षणि: रक्षणि, इस्, f. a species of plant (= त्रायमाणा).
रक्षणीय: रक्षणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be guarded or pre-served, to be protected; to be watched or guarded against, defensible.
रक्षत्: रक्षत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, guarding, protecting, pre-serving.
रक्षमाण: रक्षमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, protecting, guarding, being on one's guard, watching against.
रक्षस्: 1. रक्षस्, आस्, आस्, अस् (for 2. see col. 2), protecting (at the end of a comp., e. g. पथि-र्°, q. v.)

2. रक्षस्, अस्, n. hurt, injury, damage (Ved., but according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VII. 104, 23. रक्षस् = राक्षस-जाति, ‘the race of Rākṣasas,’ and in I. 36, 20. रक्षस् = बलम्, ‘strength’); ‘the injurer,’ (according to some a kind of euphe-mism fr. rt. 1. रक्ष्, like Εὐμενίδες); an evil being or demon, an ogre, malignant spirit, a Rākṣasa, (these beings play an important part in the Hindū religious and mythological system; see their description under राक्षस); (आस्), m., Ved. an evil and malignant being, a nocturnal fiend or Rākṣasa, (see राक्षस।) —रक्ष-ईश, अस्, m. ‘lord of the Rākṣasas,’ N. of Rāvaṇa. —रक्षः-सभ, अम्, n. an assemblage or multitude of Rāk-ṣasas. —रक्षस्-त्व, अम्, n. the nature of a Rākṣasa, demoniacal nature or disposition, fiend-ishness, malignity, malice. —रक्षस्-पाश, अस्, m. a contemptible Rākṣasa, despicable demon; [cf. पाश।] —रक्षस्-विन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. having or attended by Rākṣasas, demoniacal, evil-disposed, malignant; (Sāy.) powerful, strong (= बल-वत्)। —रक्षो-गण, अस्, m. a class or company of demons. —रक्षो-गण-भोजन, अस्, m., N. of a hell where human beings are eaten by Rākṣasas. —रक्षो-घ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, driving back or repel-ling Rākṣasas, killing or destroying Rākṣasas; (अस्), m. Semecarpus Anacardium; white mustard; (ई), f. Acorus Calamus; (अम्), n. sour rice-gruel. —रक्षो-जननी, f. ‘producing Rākṣasas,’ night. —रक्षो-ऽधिदेवता, f. the chief goddess of the Rākṣasas. —रक्षो-भाष्, ट्, Ved. barking or mak-ing a noise like a Rākṣasa, (see 2. भाष्।) —रक्-षो-मुख, अस्, m. ‘Rākṣasa-faced,’ N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl. his descendants. —रक्षो-युज्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. associated with Rākṣasas. —रक्षो-वाह, आस्, m. pl., N. of a race. —रक्षो-विक्षोभिणी, f. ‘agitating or exciting the Rākṣasas,’ N. of a god-dess. —रक्षो-हण, अस्, आ, अम्, = रक्षो-हन्। —रक्षोहणक, containing the word रक्षो-हण. —रक्षो-हत्य, अम्, n., Ved. the killing or destruction of Rākṣasas. —रक्षो-हन्, हा, घ्नी, ह, Ved. destroying or killing Rākṣasas; (हा), m., N. of the author of the hymn Ṛg-veda X. 162; bdellium.
रक्षा: रक्षा, f. guard, protection, &c.; see रक्ष, col. 1; (for रक्षा = राक्षा, lac, see राक्षा।)
रक्षि: रक्षि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. guarding, protecting (at the end of a comp., e. g. पथि-र्°, पशु-र्°).
रक्षिक: रक्षिक, अस्, m. (fr. रक्षा), a guard, protector, policeman. —रक्षिक-पुरुष, अस्, m. a watch-man, policeman.
रक्षित: रक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, guarded, protected, taken care of, preserved, maintained, kept; (अस्), m., N. of a teacher of medicine; of a grammarian; (आ), f., N. of an Apsaras. —रक्षित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, con-taining the idea of रक्ष् or ‘protecting, &c.’
रक्षितक: रक्षितक in दार-रक्षितक, relating to the guarding or protection of wives; (इका), f. a proper N.
रक्षितव्य: रक्षितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be guarded, to be protected or taken care of, to be guarded against or kept off.
रक्षितृ: रक्षितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who guards or protects, a guardian, guard, protector, watch, sentinel.
रक्षिन्: रक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, a guardian, protector, defender, guard, sentinel; guarding, protecting, protecting from (often at the end of comps., e. g. अमृत-रक्षिन्, guarding the nectar; cf. रिपु-र्°, सर्व-र्°). —रक्षि-वर्ग, अस्, m. an assemblage of guards or sentinels, body-guard.
रक्ष्य: रक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be guarded or protected, to be taken care of; to be watched against; to be concerned about, to be on one's guard against (with abl.). —रक्ष्य-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, to be protected most carefully, requiring the greatest watching, most worthy of protection.
रक्ष्यमाण: रक्ष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being guarded or protected.
ररक्षाण: ररक्षाण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. excessively pro-tecting.
रक्षस्य: रक्षस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, useful for (keeping off) Rākṣasas, anti-demoniacal.
रख्: रख् रख् or रङ्ख् (connected with rts. रिख्, रिङ्ख्), cl. 1. P. रखति, रङ्खति, &c., to go, move.
रग्: रग् रग्, cl. 1. P. रगति, रराग, अरगीत्, &c., to doubt, suspect; cl. 10. P. रागयति = rt. रक्, to taste, &c.
रघ्: रघ् रघ् (= rt. रक्), cl. 10. P. राघयति, to taste, relish; to obtain; cl. 1. A. रङ्घते, &c., to go, (see rt. रङ्घ्); [cf. Lith. ragauja.]
रघु: रघु रघु, उस्, घ्वी, उ (fr. rt. रंह् or रङ्घ्), Ved. fleet, rapid, rushing, (Sāy. = शीघ्र-गामिन्); eager; light (= लघु), fickle; (उस्), m. a racer, fleet courser (Ved.); N. of an ancient king and ancestor of Rāma, (in the Raghu-vaṃśa he is described as the son of Dilīpa and Su-dakṣiṇā, and in III. 21. the name Raghu is said to have been given to him as ‘going’ to the end of the Śāstras and to the destruction of his enemies; he was the father of Aja, the father of Daśa-ratha, and was therefore great-grandfather of Rāma; but different accounts are given of Rāma's genealogy, and in Rāmāyaṇa II. 110, 28. Raghu is said to be son of Kakutstha; in the Hari-vaṃśa two Raghus are men-tioned among the ancestors of Rāma); N. of a son of Śākya-muni; of the author of the Kavi-darpaṇa; an abbreviation for Raghu-vaṃśa, q. v.; (अवस्), m. pl. the Raghus or descendants of Raghu; [cf. रा-घव।] —रघु-कार, अस्, m., N. of Kālidāsa the author of the Raghu-vaṃśa. —रघु-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. produced from a fleet courser or racer. —र-घु-टिप्पणी, f., N. of a commentary on the Raghu-vaṃśa. —रघु-तनय, अस्, m. son of Raghu, N. of Rāma. —रघु-देव, अस्, m., N. of the author of the Virudāvalī; (ई), f., N. of a commentary on the Tattva-cintāmaṇi by Raghu-deva. —रघु-द्रु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. going or running quickly, running like a race-horse. —रघु-नन्दन, अस्, m. a descendant or son of Raghu, N. of Rāma; N. of an author of several treatises on religion and law. —र-घु-नाथ, अस्, m., N. of Rāma; of various persons; of the author of the Rasika-ramaṇa. —रघु-पति, इस्, m., N. of Rāma; of the father of the lexicogra-pher Jaṭā-dhara. —रघु-पत्म-जंहस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. light-winged, (Sāy.) having a light-falling foot (= लघु-पतन-समर्थ-पाद). —रघु-पत्वन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. lightly flying, going or moving quickly; [cf. Lat. acci-piter = Sansk. आशु-पत्वन्।] —रघु-प्रतिनिधि, इस्, m. image or counterpart of Raghu. —रघु-प्रवर, अस्, m., N. of Rāma. —रघु-मन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. having light or little wrath, mild-tempered, (Sāy. = लघु-क्रोध); full of eagerness or zeal. —रघु-यामन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. going quickly, moving lightly. —रघु-राम, अस्, m. a proper N. —रघु-वंश, अस्, m. the race or family of Raghu; N. of Kālidāsa's celebrated poem in honour of the race of Raghu, (it consists of nineteen chapters or books; cf. महा-काव्य।) —रघुवंश-तिलक, अस्, m. ‘ornament of the race of Raghu,’ epithet of Rāma. —रघुवंश-सञ्जीवनी, f., N. of Mallinātha's commentary on the Raghu-vaṃśa. —रघु-वर, अस्, m., N. of Rāma. —रघु-वर्तनि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. lightly rolling or turning (said of a chariot and of a horse). —रघु-वीर, अस्, m., N. of Rāma; of an author (= Raghu-deva). —रघु-ष्यद्, त्, त्, त् (i. e. रघु + स्यद्), Ved. moving quickly, hasty, speedy, rapid, (Sāy. = शीघ्र-गमन, शीघ्रं स्यन्दमान।) —रघूत्तम (°घु-उत्°), अस्, m. ‘best of the Raghus,’ N. of Rāma. —रघूद्वह (°घु-उद्°), अस्, m. ‘offspring of Raghu,’ N. of Rāma.
रघीयस्: रघीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. of रघु), Ved. more rapid or fleet, very swift.
रघुयत्: रघुयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (Part. fr. an unused Nom. रघुय), moving fleetly or rapidly, (Sāy. = शीघ्रं गच्छत्।)
रघुया: रघुया, ind. (fr. रघु), Ved. quickly, swiftly, lightly, (Sāy. = शीघ्र-गामिन्, as if रघु-या।)
रघूयत्: रघूयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. = रघुयत् above.
रङ्क: रङ्क रङ्क, अस्, आ, अम्, niggardly, mean, indigent, poor, miserable, hungry, (कङ्क-रङ्क, a hungry or half-starved crane; cf. जल-र्°, मत्स्य-र्°); slow; (अस्), m. a beggar.
रङ्कु: रङ्कु रङ्कु, उस्, m. a species of deer or antelope; N. of a place. —रङ्कु-मालिन्, ई, m., N. of a Vidyā-dhara.
रङ्क्तृ: रङ्क्तृ रङ्क्तृ। See रक्तृ, p. 828, col. 1.
रङ्क्षु: रङ्क्षु रङ्क्षु, N. of a river.
रङ्ख्: रङ्ख् रङ्ख् = rt. रख्, q. v.
रङ्ग्: रङ्ग् रङ्ग् (= rt. रिङ्ग्), cl. 1. P. रङ्गति, &c., to go, move.
रङ्ग: रङ्ग, अस्, m. colour, paint, pigment, dye, hue; the nasal modification or nasalizing of a vowel; a place of public amusement or for dramatic exhibi-tions, theatre, play-house, amphitheatre, stage, arena, place of public contest, place for athletic exercises or feats, sports, &c.; a place of assembly; an assembly or assemblage of spectators; a field of battle; dancing, singing, acting, diversion, mirth; borax; an extract obtained from Acacia Catechu; a proper N.; (अम्), n. tin (= वङ्ग; in this sense also अस्, m.). —रङ्ग-कार or रङ्ग-कारक, अस्, m. ‘a colour-maker,’ painter, colourist. —रङ्ग-काष्ठ, अम्, n. Cæsal-pina Sappan. —रङ्ग-क्षेत्र, अम्, n., N. of a place. —रङ्ग-चर, अस्, m. ‘a stage-goer,’ stage-player, actor, player, performer, &c.; a gladiator. —रङ्ग-ज, अम्, n. red lead, vermilion. —रङ्ग-जीवक, अस्, m. ‘living by colours,’ a painter, an actor, performer. —रङ्ग-द, अस्, m. borax; an extract from Acacia Catechu; a particular white paint (= स्फटी, दृढ-रङ्गा). —रङ्ग-दत्त, (probably) अम्, n., N. of a drama. —रङ्ग-दायक, अम्, n. a particular kind of earth (= कङ्कुष्ठ)। —रङ्ग-दृढा, f. a sort of white paint (= दृढ-रङ्गा). —रङ्ग-देवता, f. a goddess sup-posed to preside over sports and diversions, the god-dess or genius of pleasure. —रङ्ग-द्वार्, र्, f. a stage-door, the door or entrance of a theatre. —रङ्ग-द्वार, अम्, n. a stage-entrance, stage-door; the prologue of a play. —रङ्ग-नाथ, अस्, m., N. of various men; of the author of a commentary on the Vikramorvaśī-(A.D. 1656); of a commentator on the Sūrya-siddhānta. —रङ्ग-पताका, f., N. of a woman. —रङ्ग-पत्त्री or रङ्ग-पुष्पी, f. the indigo plant. —रङ्ग-पीठ, अम्, n. a place for dancing. —रङ्ग-प्रवेश, अस्, m. entering on the stage, engaging in theatrical performances. —रङ्ग-भूति, इस्, f. the night of full moon in the month Āśvina. —रङ्ग-भूमि, इस्, f. a place for acting, stage, theatre, arena; a battle-field, —रङ्ग-मङ्गल, अम्, n. a stage-festival, rejoicing or festive ceremony on the stage. —रङ्ग-मण्डप, अस्, अम्, m. n. a play-house, theatre. —रङ्ग-मण्डल, अम्, n. the circuit of an arena or assembly. —रङ्ग-मध्य, अम्, n. the middle of an arena. —रङ्ग-मल्ल, अस्, m. a proper N.; (ई), f. the Indian lute. —रङ्ग-माणिक्य, अम्, n. a ruby (= माणिक्य). —रङ्ग-मातृ, ता, f. lac or the insect which forms the red dye; a bawd; = त्रुटि. —रङ्ग-मातृका, f. lac. —रङ्ग-राज, अस्, m., N. of a king; of a learned man, (also called Raṅgarāja-dīkṣita, &c.) —रङ्ग-लासिनी, f. Nyctanthes Arbor Tristis. —रङ्ग-वती, f., N. of a woman (who killed her husband Ranti-deva). —रङ्ग-वल्लिका or रङ्ग-वल्ली, f., N. of a kind of plant used at sacrifices. —रङ्ग-वस्तु, उ, n. any colouring substance, paint. —रङ्ग-वाट, a place or arena enclosed for contests, plays, dancing, &c. —रङ्ग-वाराङ्गना (°र-अङ्°), f. a kind of dancing girl. —रङ्ग-विद्या-धर, अस्, m. a pro-ficient in or teacher of the art of acting. —रङ्ग-वीज, अम्, n. silver. —रङ्ग-शाला, f. a play-house, theatre, dancing-hall, dancing-room. —रङ्ग-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, standing in an arena. —रङ्गाङ्गण (°ग-अङ्°), अम्, n. the area of an amphitheatre or arena, an arena or place of public contest. —रङ्-गाङ्गा (°ग-अङ्°), f. a particular white substance (= स्फटी). —रङ्गाजीव (°ग-आज्°), अस्, m. ‘living by colours,’ a painter; one who lives by the stage, an actor, performer. —रङ्गारि (°ग-अरि), इस्, m. a fragrant Oleander. —रङ्गावतरण (°ग-अव्°), अम्, n. entering on the stage, engaging in theatrical performances; the profession of an actor. —रङ्गा-वतारक (°ग-अव्°), अस्, or रङ्गावतारिन्, ई, m. one who enters the stage or engages in theatrical performances, a stage-player, actor. —रङ्गेश (°ग-ईश), अस्, m., N. of a king. —रङ्गेश्वरी (°ग-ईश्°), f. (probably) N. of the wife of Raṅgeśa. —रङ्-गेष्ठालुक (°ठ-आल्°), अम्, n. a kind of bulbous root or onion, (also रङ्गेष्ठालु।) —रङ्गोप-जीविन् (°ग-उप्°), ई, or रङ्गोपजीव्य, अस्, m. one who lives by the stage, a stage-player, actor.
रङ्गोजि: रङ्गोजि रङ्गोजि, इस्, or रङ्गोजि-भट्ट, अस्, m., N. of the father of Koṇḍabhaṭṭa and brother of Bhaṭṭoji.
रङ्घ्: रङ्घ् रङ्घ् [cf. rt. रंह्], cl. 1. A. रङ्-घते, ररङ्घे, रङ्घितुम्, to go, hasten, run; cl. 10. P. or Caus. रङ्घयति, -यितुम्, to speak; to shine.
रङ्घस्: रङ्घस्, अस्, n. = रंहस्, haste, speed, velocity.
रच्: रच् रच्, cl. 10. P. रचयति, रचयाम्-आस, रचयितुम्, to make, form, fabricate, create, produce; to prepare, get ready, contrive, plan, arrange, dispose; to complete, effect; to com-pose, write (a book or any literary work); to string together; to adorn, decorate; to place in or on (with loc.), fix on; to direct (the thoughts &c.) towards: Caus. रचयति, to cause to make or do (with two acc.); to cause to move, put in motion; [cf. Lat. locare, locus: Angl. Sax. logian, ‘to place;’ loh.]
रचन: रचन, अम्, n. the act of making, forming, form-ation, creation, arranging, putting in order, managing, directing, preparing; (आ, अम्), f. n. arrangement, disposition, management, preparation, performance, accomplishment, fabrication; a literary production, work, composition; dressing of the hair; stringing flowers or garlands, the arrangement of troops, array; a creation of the mind, artificial image, (अर्थ-रचना, striving after or accomplishing an object; गीति-रचना, a musical or vocal composition; निवास-रचना, a building); according to native lexicogra-phers रचना = परि-स्पन्द or परि-स्यन्द, प्र-ति-यत्न, ग्रन्थन, गुम्फ, व्यूह, निवेश, स्थिति; also = पाश, भार, पक्ष, उच्चय, ‘abundance,’ ‘quantity,’ when compounded with a word meaning ‘hair’ (e. g. केश-रचना, abundance of hair); (आ), f., N. of the wife of Tvaṣṭṛ.
रचयत्: रचयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, making, forming, com-posing.
रचयितृ: रचयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who makes or com-poses, a composer, author.
रचयित्वा: रचयित्वा, ind. having made or formed, having arranged, &c.
रचित: रचित, अस्, आ, अम्, made, formed, fabricated, pro-duced, prepared, made ready, concerted, contrived, planned, arranged, completed, effected, composed, written; strung together; decorated, adorned; fas-tened, placed in or on (with loc.); directed towards; furnished or equipped with, provided with (with inst. or at the end of a comp.); (अस्), m. a proper N. —रचित-त्व, अम्, n. the being composed or written. —रचित-धी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, having the mind directed to (with loc.), intent on. —रचित-पङ्क्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, forming a line. —रचित-शिखर, अस्, आ, अम्, having the summit adorned. —रचितार्थ (°त-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one who has obtained his object (= कृतार्थ).
रज: रज, रजक, रजनि, रजस्, &c. See p. 828, cols. 2, 3.

रज, अस्, m. = रजस्, dust [cf. नी-र्°]; the pollen of flowers; the menstrual excretion, (in this sense also अम्, n.); the quality of passion, (see रजस्); emotion, affection; N. of one of Skanda's attendants; of a king (a son of Vi-raja).
रजि: रजि रजि, इस्, m., N. of a demon or king subdued by Indra, (according to Sāy., Ṛg-veda VI. 26, 6, रजि means ‘a maiden or a kingdom called Raji;’ and X. 105, 2, ‘heaven and earth’ or ‘the sun and moon,’ but the meaning is obscure); N. of a son of Āyu.
रजिष्ठ: रजिष्ठ रजिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. of ऋजु), Ved. = ऋजिष्ठ, most honest or upright.
रजीयस्: रजीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. of ऋजु), Ved. more honest.
रजीकृ: रजीकृ रजी-कृ, रजो-गात्र, &c. See p. 829, col. 1.
रज्जु: रज्जु रज्जु, उस्, f. (at the end of a comp. sometimes उस्, m.; in the older language also रज्जू, Ved. acc. रज्ज्वम्, gen. रज्ज्वास् [Manu XI. 168] and रज्जोस्; said in Uṇādi-s. I. 16. to be fr. rt. सृज्; according to some, perhaps for original स्रज्यु, cf. स्रज्), a rope, cord, string, line, (at the end of an adj. comp. the fem. may be रज्जुका); N. of certain sinews or tendons proceeding from the vertebral column (in anatomy); a lock of braided hair, braid (= वेणी); N. of a particular constellation; [cf. Lat. ligare, stringere; Old Germ. stricch, stric, strac-chian; Angl. Sax. streccan.] —रज्जु-कण्ठ, अस्, m., N. of a preceptor. —रज्जु-दाल, अस्, m., Ved. a species of tree. —रज्जु-दालक, अस्, m. a kind of wild-fowl. —रज्जु-पेडा, f. a rope basket. —रज्जु-भार, अस्, m., N. of a preceptor. —रज्जु-मात्र-त्व, अम्, n. the condition of being only a rope. —रज्जु-वाल, अस्, m. = रज्जु-दालक, a wild-fowl. —रज्जु-शारद, अस्, आ, अम्, newly drawn up by a rope (said of water; Pāṇini VI. 2, 9). —रज्जु-सर्ज, अस्, m., Ved. a rope-maker. —रज्जूद्धृत (°जु-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, drawn up by means of a rope. —रज्ज्व्-अवलम्बिन्, ई, इनी, इ, hanging by a string.
रज्जव्य: रज्जव्य, अम्, n., Ved. material for a rope.
रञ्ज्: रञ्ज् रञ्ज् or रज्, cl. 1. 4. P. A. रजति, -ते (ep. also रञ्जति), रज्यति, -ते, र-रञ्ज (3rd pl. ररजतुस् or ररञ्जतुस्), ररञ्जे, रङ्क्ष्यति, -ते, अराङ्क्षीत्, अरङ्क्त, रज्यात्, रङ्क्षीष्ट, रङ्क्तुम्, to be dyed or coloured, to redden, grow red, glow; to dye, tinge, colour; to be affected or moved, to have the passions or feelings roused, to be excited; to be pleased or delighted with (with inst.); to attach one's self to, be attached or devoted to, (perhaps in this sense connected with rt. लग्); fall in love with, be enamoured of (usually with loc.); to go, (in this sense cl. 1. P. according to Naighaṇṭuka II. 14): Caus. रञ्जयति, -यते, -यितुम्, to dye, colour, paint, make red, redden, illuminate; to rejoice, gratify, exhilarate, charm; to cause to be attached, to conciliate; (according to Naighaṇṭuka III. 14) = rt. अर्च्, to worship, (also रजयति); to hunt, (in this sense only रजयति): Desid. रिरङ्क्षति, -ते: Intens. रारज्यते, रा-रङ्क्ति, to be greatly affected or excited; to be intensely attached or devoted; [cf. Gr. ῥέζ-ω, ῥαγ-εύ-ς, ῥηγ-εύ-ς, ῥεγ-εύ-ς, ῥέγ-ος, ῥέγ-μα, ῥήσσω, ῥῆγ-ος, λέγ-νον: probably Angl. Sax. ge-regnian, ‘to colour.’]
रक्तक: रक्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, red; passionately attached to, fond of, enamoured; pleasing, entertaining, amusing; bloody, containing blood; (अस्), m. a red garment; an amorous or impassioned man; a sporter, player; N. of various plants bearing red flowers, Pentapetes Phœnicea; the globe-amaranth; = रक्त-शिग्रु; = रक्तैरण्ड।
रक्तिका: रक्तिका, f. Abrus Precatorius; the seed or grain of this plant used as a weight = (1/6) or (1/7) or (2/15) of a Māṣaka; (according to some, the seed weighs about 1(5/16) of a grain troy, the artificial Ratti or Raktikā should be double that weight, but in common use it averages nearly 2(1/4) grains.)
रक्तिमन्: रक्तिमन्, आ, m. redness, red colour.
रक्तृ: रक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who colours or dyes, a colourist, painter, (more correctly रङ्क्तृ।)
रक्त्वा: रक्त्वा or रङ्क्त्वा, ind. having dyed; having attached one's self to.
रङ्गिन्: रङ्गिन्, ई, इणी, इ, colouring, dyeing, painting; passionate, impassioned; attached to, devoted to, finding enjoyment in; acting or exhibiting on a stage, being an actor; (इणी), f. Asparagus Race-mosus.
रजक: रजक, अस्, m. a washerman (so called from his being occupied in the cleaning or whitening of clothes; the washermen are regarded as a degraded caste of Hindūs); a parrot; N. of a king; (ई), f. a washerman's wife, washerwoman; epithet of a woman on the third day of the menses; (इका), f. a washer-woman.
रजत: रजत, अस्, आ, अम् [cf. rt. 2. अर्ज्], white, whitish, silver-coloured, silvery, (रजतं हिरण्यम्, white gold, i. e. silver); silver, made of silver, like silver; (अम्), n. silver [cf. अर्जुन]; gold; a pearl-ornament or necklace; blood; ivory; N. of a particular moun-tain (perhaps of Kailāsa); of a particular lake; an asterism, constellation; [cf. Gr. ἀργό-ς, ἀργ-ή-ς, ἄργυ-ρο-ς; Lat. arg-entu-m; Hib. airgiod.] —रजत-कुम्भ, अस्, m. a silver jar. —रजत-कूट, N. of a peak on the Malaya mountains. —रजत-दंष्ट्र, अस्, m., N. of a son of Vajra-daṃṣṭra (a king of the Vidyā-dharas). —रजत-द्युति, इस्, m., N. of Hanumat. —रजत-नाभ, अस्, m., N. of a particular fabulous being. —रजत-नाभि, इस्, इस्, इ, having a white navel; (इस्), m., N. of a descendant of Kuvera. —रजत-पर्वत, अस्, m. a silver mountain; N. of a particular mountain. —रजत-पात्र or रजत-भाजन, अम्, n. a silver cup, silver vessel of any kind. —रजत-प्रस्-थ, अस्, m., N. of Kailāsa. —रजत-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made of silver, silver. —रजत-वाह, अस्, m., N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl. his descendants. —रज-ताद्रि (°त-अद्°), इस्, m. ‘silver-mountain,’ N. of Kailāsa.
रजन: रजन, अस्, m., N. of a person with the patro-nymic Kauṇeya; a ray, beam; (अम्), n. colouring, dyeing; safflower.
रजनक: रजनक, अस्, m. a proper N. (= रजन).
रजनि: रजनि, इस्, or रजनी, f. (the latter is the more common; said to be fr. rt. रञ्ज् in the sense ‘to colour,’ cf. रजस्), night; N. of Durgā; a species of plant (= जनी, जतूका, जतु-कृत्); Curcuma Longa, (all words meaning ‘night’ appear to be used for this plant); Curcuma Aromatica; the indigo plant; N. of a river; [cf. Hib. reag, ‘night.’] —रजनि-कर, अस्, m. ‘the night-maker,’ the moon. —रजनि-चर, अस्, m. ‘night-rover,’ a Rāk-ṣasa; [cf. रजनी-चर।] —रजनिम्-मन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, passing for or looking like night. —रजनि-राक्षसी, f. night regarded as a Rākṣasī. —रजनी-कर, अस्, m. ‘the night-maker,’ the moon. —र-जनी-गन्ध, अस्, m. Polianthes Tuberosa; (आ), f. a species of plant bearing white flowers. —रजनी-चर, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, wandering in the night, moving about by night; (अस्), m. epithet of the moon; a Rākṣasa, an evil spirit; a night-watcher; a thief. —रजनीचर-नाथ, अस्, m. ‘lord or pro-tector of night-wanderers,’ epithet of the moon, (wrongly read रजनी-चय-नाथ।) — रजनी-जल, अम्, n. ‘night-dew,’ rime, hoar-frost. —रजनी-द्वन्-द्व, अम्, n. a period of two nights with the inter-mediate day. —रजनी-पति, इस्, m. ‘the lord or hus-band of night,’ the moon. —रजनी-मुख, अम्, n. ‘front or beginning of night,’ evening, nightfall. —रजनी-रमण, अस्, m. ‘the husband of night,’ the moon. —रजनी-हासा, f. Nyctanthes Arbor Tristis.
रजनीय: रजनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be enjoyed, enjoyable, charming.
रजयित्री: रजयित्री, f. (fr. the Caus.), Ved. a female painter or colourist.
रजस्: रजस्, अस्, n. (said to be fr. rt. रञ्ज् in the sense ‘to colour,’ cf. rt. 2. अर्ज्; according to some the original meaning may have been ‘dimness,’ cf. र-जनि and Goth. riquis), the sphere of vapour or mist, region of clouds, atmosphere, air, firmament (Ved.; sometimes represented as the expanse of heaven or sky in general); any sphere or world or division of the world (so used in Ved. according to Yāska and Sāy.; the dual रजसी = ‘heaven and earth,’ or perhaps ‘the lower and higher atmospheres’ im-mediately above the earth; त्रीणि रजांसि = ‘the three worlds’ or earth, atmosphere, and sky; some-times even six such spheres are enumerated); vapour, mist, clouds, rain-water, water (according to Nirukta IV. 19); gloom, gloominess, dimness, darkness; im-purity, dirt, dust, powder, speck of dust, any small particle of matter, (गो-रजस्, a speck of dust on a cow's hair; a mote in a sun-beam; एडक-रजस्, a speck of dust on a sheep's fleece); the dust or pollen of flowers; cultivated or ploughed land (as ‘dusty’), arable land, fields; the ‘darkening’ quality, passion, foulness, impurity; (in philosophy) the second of the three Guṇas or qualities, (the three are called सत्त्व, goodness, रजस्, passion, and तमस्, darkness; cf. गुण; of these रजस् is sometimes identified with तेजस्, energy or activity: it is said to predominate in air, and to be active, urgent, and variable); passion, emotion, feeling, affection; the menstrual excretion; tin; (according to Nirukta IV. 19) = ज्योतिस्, अहन्; (आस्), m., N. of a Ṛṣi, son of Vasiṣṭha. —रज-उद्वास, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one who has put off soiled clothes; [cf. मलोद्वासस्।] —रजः-पटल, अम्, n. a coating of dust. —र-जः-पुत्र, अस्, m. the son of passion (a term applied to a person when the object is to mark his being of no particular note; cf. रजस्-तोक). —रजः-प्लुत, अस्, आ, अम्, filled with (the quality of) passion. —रजः-शय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. silver, made of silver. —रजः-शुद्धि, इस्, f. a pure or right condition of the menses. —रजः-स्पृश्, क्, क्, क्, touching the dust or the ground, touching the earth. —रजस्-तमस्क, अस्, आ, अम्, being under the influence of the two qualities रजस् and त-मस्, (see above.) —रजस्-तमो-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made up or consisting of the qualities रजस् and तमस्. —रजस्-तुर्, ऊर्, ऊर्, ऊर्, Ved. hastening through the sky or atmosphere, (Sāy.) dust-scattering (= पांसोस् त्वरयितृ) or water-scattering (= उद-कस्य प्रेरक). —रजस्-तोक, अस्, अम्, m. n. the child or offspring of passion; avarice, greediness. —रजस्-वल, अस्, आ, अम्, having water (Ved. = उदक-वत्); covered with dust, dusty; full of the quality रजस्, full of passion; (अस्), m. a buffalo; (आ), f. a menstruating woman, a female during the menses; a marriageable woman. —रजस्-विन्, ई, इनी, इ, dusty, full of dust or pollen; full of the quality रजस्. —रजी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to change or turn into dust. —रजेषित (fr. रज for रजस् + इषित), according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VIII. 46, 28. रजस् = उष्ट्र or गर्दभ, इषित = प्रापित. —रजो-गात्र, अस्, m., N. of a son of Vasiṣṭha. —रजो-गुण, अस्, m. the quality रजस् or passion, (see under रजस्।) —रजोगुण-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of or having the quality रजस्। —रजो-ग्रहि, इस्, इस्, इ, see Vopa-deva XXVI. 48. —रजो-दर्शन, अम्, n. the (first) appearance of the menstrual excretion. —रजो-निमीलित, अस्, आ, अम्, blinded by passion or desire. —रजो-बन्ध, अस्, m. suppression of menstruation. —रजो-बल, अम्, n. darkness, (perhaps more correctly रजो-वल।) —रजो-मेघ, अस्, m. a cloud of dust. —रजो-रस, अस्, m. darkness. —रजो-हर, अस्, m. ‘remover of impurity,’ a washerman. —रजो-हरण-धारिन् (according to Halāyudha II. 189) = व्रतिन्।
रजस: रजस (at the end of an adj. comp.) = रजस् (e. g. अ-प्राप्त-रजसा, not yet having menstruated); (अस्, आ, अम्), obscure, dark, dim, Ved.; (perhaps) dirty, unclean, impure.
रजसानु: रजसानु, उस्, m. a cloud; soul, heart (= चित्त)।
रजस्क: रजस्क (at the end of an adj. comp.) = रजस् in नी-र्°, वि-र्°, q. q. v. v.
रजस्य: 1. रजस्य, Nom. P. रजस्यति, &c., to become dust, to be scattered as dust.
2. रजस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having the quality रजस्; dusty.
रजित: रजित, अस्, आ, अम् (for रञ्जित), affected, moved, &c.
रञ्जक: रञ्जक, अस्, इका, अम् (fr. the Caus.), = रञ्जन, colouring, dyeing; causing affection or passion, ex-citing love or pleasure, gladdening, rejoicing, pleas-ing; (अस्), m. a colourist, dyer, painter; an inciter of affection &c., stimulus; a species of plant (= कम्पिल्लक); biliary humor on which vision de-pends; (अकी), f. a female colourer or dyer; (अम्), n. red sandal; vermilion.
रञ्जन: रञ्जन, अस्, ई, अम्, colouring, dyeing, (केश-रञ्जन, dyeing the hair); exciting passion or love; gratifying, exhilarating, delighting, rejoicing, (जन-रञ्जनी, ‘men-rejoicing,’ N. of a particular formula); conciliating, befriending; (अस्), m. Saccharum Munja, = मुञ्ज; (ई), f. the female personification of a particular musical mode; (probably) friendly saluta-tion; N. of various plants, the indigo plant; Nyc-tanthes Arbor Tristis; saffron; a kind of fragrant perfume; (अम्), n. the act of colouring, dyeing; colour, dye; the act of pleasing, delighting, concili-ating, rejoicing, giving pleasure; nasalizing (in gram.); red sandal-wood. —रञ्जन-द्रु, उस्, m. a kind of tree.
रञ्जनक: रञ्जनक, अस्, m. a kind of tree.
रञ्जनीय: रञ्जनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be coloured or dyed; to be rejoiced or pleased; anything which may be rejoiced at.
रञ्जित: रञ्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, dyed, coloured, tinted; affected, moved; highly delighted.
रञ्जिनी: रञ्जिनी, f., N. of various plants, the indigo plant; Rubia Munjista; [cf. रञ्जनी।]
रट्: रट् रट्, cl. 1. P. रटति, रराट, &c., to shout, howl, yell, cry, scream, roar, bellow; to call out, proclaim aloud; to shout with joy, applaud: Caus. रटयति, &c., to shout, &c.; to speak [cf. rt. रठ्]: Intens. रारटीति, to scream aloud.
रटन: रटन, अम्, n. the act of shouting, &c.; cry or shout of applause, approbation.
रटन्ती: रटन्ती, f., N. of the fourteenth day in the dark half of the month Māgha.
रटित: रटित, अस्, आ, अम्, screamed, shouted, &c.; (अम्), n. a roar, yell, scream, cry.
रट्टा: रट्टा रट्टा, f., N. of a princess.
रठ्: रठ् रठ् [cf. rt. रट्], cl. 1. P. रठति, &c., to speak; [cf. Old Germ. rediôn, re-dinôn; Old Sax. rethjôn, rethinôn, ‘to speak;’ perhaps Goth. rasda.]
रड्ड: रड्ड रड्ड, अस्, m. a proper N.; (आ), f., N. of a princess.
रण्: रण् रण् (thought by some to be deve-loped out of a base रम्णा, fr. rt. रम्), cl. 1. P. (Ved. also cl. 4. P.) रणति (रण्यति), रराण, अराणीत् (Ved. forms रारण or in Pada-pāṭha ररण, रणिष्टन्), रणितुम्, to rejoice, exult; to take pleasure in (with loc., rarely with acc., Ved.); to delight (Ved.); to sound, ring, rattle, jingle; to shout: Caus. P. A. रणयति, रणयते, यितुम्, Aor. अरीरणत् or अरराणत् (Ved. forms रारणत्, अरारणुस्, रारन्धि, रारन्तु, ररा-णत), to cause to rejoice; cause to be pleased, delight; to rejoice or be pleased at, delight in (with loc., Ved.); to make to sound, cause to sound forth; to praise; to go (P.): Desid. रिरणिषति: Intens. रंरण्यते, रंरण्टि; [cf. Hib. ran, ‘a squeal, roar;’ ranach, ‘a roaring.’]
रण: रण, अस्, m. joy, delight, gratification, pleasure (Ved.); sound, noise; the quill or bow of a lute; going, motion; (अस्, अम्), m. n. battle, war, combat, fight, conflict. —रण-कर्मन्, अ, n. ‘war-busi-ness,’ war, battle, combat, fighting. —रण-कामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, desirous of war, wishing to fight. —रण-काम्य, Nom. P. -काम्यति, &c., to wish for battle. —रण-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. causing battle or strife. —रण-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, causing joy, gratifying, delighting (Ved.); fighting, a fighter, combatant, warrior. —रण-क्षित्ति, इस्, f. or रण-क्षेत्र, अम्, n. or रण-क्षोणि, इस्, f. place of battle, battle-field. —रण-गोचर, अस्, आ, अम्, engaged in war, fight-ing. —रण-जय, अस्, m. victory in battle. —र-णञ्-जय, अस्, m. (रणम्, acc. c.), N. of a king. —रण-तूर्य, अम्, n. a war-drum, military drum. —रण-दर, अस्, m. a proper N. —रण-दुन्-दुभि, इस्, m. a military drum. —रण-दुर्गाधा-रण-यन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a particular amulet. —रण-पण्डित, अस्, m. ‘skilled in battle,’ a warrior. —रण-पुर-स्वामिन्, ई, m., N. of a certain statue of Sūrya. —रण-प्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, battle-loving, fond of war or battle, warlike; (अस्), m. a falcon; (अम्), n. the fragrant root of Andro-pogon Muricatus. —रण-भट, अस्, m. a proper N. —रण-भू, ऊस्, or रण-भूमि, इस्, f. a battle-ground, field of battle. —रण-मत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, furious in battle; (अस्), m. an elephant. —रण-मार्ग-कोविद, अस्, आ, अम्, experienced in the art or ways of war. —रण-मुख, अम्, n. the front or van of battle; the van of an army. —रण-मुष्टि, इस्, m. a species of plant (= विष-मुष्टि)। —रण-मूर्धन्, आ, m. the front or van of a fight. —रण-रङ्क, अस्, m. the space between the tusks of an elephant. —रण-रङ्ग, अस्, m. ‘battle-stage,’ a place or field of battle. —रणरङ्ग-मल्ल, अस्, m. = भोज-राज, q. v. —रण-रण, अस्, m. ‘the buzzer,’ a gnat, musquito; (अम्), n. a longing, anxious desire; regret (for a lost object). —रण-रणक, अस्, अम्, m. n. anxiety, anxious regret for some beloved object; desire, love; (अस्), m. the god of love. —रण-लक्ष्मी, ईस्, f. the fortune of war; the goddess of battle. —रण-वन्य, अस्, m., N. of a king. —रण-वाद्य, अम्, n. a military instrument of music, martial music. —रण-विशारद, अस्, आ, अम्, skilled in war. —रण-वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, having war or battle for a profession. —रण-शिक्षा, f. the art or science of war. —रण-शिरस्, अस्, n. the head or front of a battle. —रण-शूर, अस्, m. a hero in war, warrior. —रण-संरम्भ, अस्, m. the fury of battle. —रण-सङ्कुल, अम्, n. the confusion or noise of battle, a melée, mixed or tumultuary combat. —र-ण-सज्जा, f. military accoutrement. —रण-सत्त्र, अम्, n. war or battle regarded as a sacrifice. —रण-सहाय, अस्, m. ‘war-helper,’ an ally. —रण-स्तम्-भ, अस्, m. ‘battle-pillar,’ a monument of war or battle, trophy, column; N. of a country (Chitore?). —रण-स्थान, अम्, n. a battle-place, field of battle. —रण-स्वामिन्, ई, m., N. of a statue of Śiva as lord of battle. —रणाग्नि (°ण-अग्°), इस्, m. the fire of battle, battle regarded as fire. —रणाग्र (°ण-अग्°), अम्, n. the head or front of a battle. —रणाङ्ग (°ण-अङ्°), अम्, n. ‘war-implement,’ weapon of war or battle, any weapon, a sword. —रणाङ्गन (°ण-अङ्°), अम्, n. a battle-place, field of battle, (also रणाङ्गण।) —रणाजि (°ण-आजि), इस्, m., N. of a Sādhya. —रणाजिर (°ण-अज्°), अम्, n. area or arena for fighting, battle-field. —र-णातोद्य (°ण-आत्°), अम्, n. a battle-drum, military drum. —रणादित्य (°ण-आद्°), अस्, m., N. of a king of Kaśmīra; of another person. —रणान्त-कृत् (°ण-अन्°), त्, m. ‘making an end of battle,’ N. of Viṣṇu. —रणापेत (°ण-अप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, flying away from battle (Kirāt. XV. 33). —रणाभियोग (°ण-अभ्°), अस्, m. engaging in battle, warlike en-counter. —रणारम्भा (°ण-आर्°), f., N. of the wife of Raṇāditya. —रणारम्भा-स्वामि-देव, अस्, m., N. of a statue erected by Raṇārambhā. —र-णालङ्करण (°ण-अल्°), अस्, m. a heron (= कङ्क)। —रणावनि (°ण-अव्°), इस्, f. battle-ground, a field of battle. —रणाश्व (°ण-अश्°), अस्, m., N. of a king. —रणे-चर, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, going or mov-ing about in the field of battle (said of Viṣṇu). —रणेश (°ण-ईश) or रणेश्वर (°ण-ईश्°), अस्, m. = रण-स्वामिन्. —रणे-स्वच्छ, अस्, m. a cock. —रणैषिन् (°ण-एस्°), ई, इणी, इ, eager for battle. —रणोत्कट (°ण-उत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, furious or mad in battle; (अस्), m., N. of one of Skanda's attendants; of a Daitya. —रणोत्साह (°ण-उत्°), अस्, m. prowess in battle. —रणोद्दाम (°ण-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, eager for battle. —रणोद्देश (°ण-उद्°), अस्, m. a field of battle; a part or quarter of a battle.
रणक: रणक, अस्, m., N. of a king.
रणत्: रणत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, sounding, rattling; going. —रणत्-कार, अस्, m. a rattling or clanking sound; any sound; humming (of bees).
रणित: रणित, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded, sounding, rattling; (अम्), n. sound, any ringing or rattling sound.
रणितृ: रणितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. rejoicing in, delighting in, (Sāy. = रमण-शील।)
रण्य: रण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. agreeable, enjoyable, delightful, pleasant; fit for fighting, warlike; (अम्), n., Ved. joy, pleasure; war, battle. —रण्य-जित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. conquering in battle, victorious in war. —रण्य-वाच्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. speaking agreeably.
रण्य रण्य, रण्व, &c. See p. 829, col. 3.
रण्व: रण्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. pleasant, delightful, agree-able, lovely; joyous, gay; sounding; to be praised, worthy of praise. —रण्व-सन्दृश्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. looking lovely, appearing beautiful, (Sāy. = रम-णीय-दर्शन।)
रण्वन्: रण्वन्, in Ṛg-veda V. 44, 10, according to Sāy. = रमणीय, agreeable, pleasant.
रण्ड: रण्ड रण्ड, अस्, आ, अम् (in Uṇādi-s. I. 113. said to be fr. rt. रम्), mutilated, maimed, crippled, (incorrect for वण्ड, q. v.); faithless (in शाखा-रण्ड, q. v.); (अस्), m. a man who dies without male issue; a barren tree; (आ), f. a term of abuse in addressing women, a slut; a widow, (बाल-रण्डा, a young widow); Salvinia Cucullata; N. of a species of metre. —रण्डाश्रमिन् (°ड-आश्°), ई, m. one who loses a wife after the forty-eighth year.
रण्डक: रण्डक, अस्, m. a barren tree.
रण्व्: रण्व् रण्व् (= rts. रम्ब्, रिण्व्, रिम्ब्), cl. 1. P. रण्वति, to go; (a form रण्व् for rt. रण् occurs in Taittrīya-s. I. 2, 5, 1, where, accord-ing to the commentator, रण्वतु = रमयतु।)
रण्वित: रण्वित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. रण्व् for rt. रण्), in Ṛg-veda II. 3, 6. according to Sāy. = शब्दित, स्तुत, sounded, praised, or गच्छत्, going.
रत: रत रत, रति, &c. See p. 833, cols. 1, 2.

रत, अस्, आ, अम्, pleased, delighted, amused, gratified, satisfied, happy; enamoured of, fondly attached to; delighted with, taking pleasure in, pleased with (with inst.); intent on, addicted to; devoted to, occupied in, engaged in (with loc.); in-clined to, disposed; loved, beloved; (आ), f., N. of the mother of Day (in Mahā-bh. Ādi-p. 2584); (अम्), n. pleasure, enjoyment, enjoyment of love, sexual union, coition, copulation; the private parts (= गुह्य). —रत-कील, अस्, m. a dog. —रत-कूजित, अम्, n. lascivious murmur. —रत-गुरु, उस्, m. a husband. —रत-ज्वर, अस्, m. a crow. —रत-तालिन्, ई, m. a libertine, voluptuary. —रत-ताली, f. a procuress, bawd. —रत-नाराच, अस्, m. (according to some) = रत-नारीच, अस्, (except in the first meaning). —रत-नारीच, अस्, m. a voluptuary; a dog; N. of Kāma-deva, the god of love; lasci-vious murmur. —रत-निधि, इस्, m. a species of bird (the wagtail). —रत-बन्ध, अस्, m. sexual union. —रतर्द्धिक (°त-ऋद्°), अम्, n. a day; bathing for pleasure; the aggregate of eight auspi-cious objects. —रत-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. con-taining a form of the rt. रम्. —रत-व्रण, अस्, m. a dog. —रत-शायिन्, ई, m. a dog. —रत-हिण्डक, अस्, m. a ravisher or seducer of women; a libertine. —रतान्दुक (°त-अन्°), अस्, m. a dog. —रतामर्द (°त-आम्°), अस्, m. a dog. —रता-यनी (°त-अय्°), f. a prostitute, harlot. —रतार्थिन् (°त-अर्°), ई, इनी, इ, wishing for sexual enjoyment, amorous, lascivious; (इनी), f. a wanton woman. —रतोत्सव (°त-उत्°), अस्, m. ‘love-festival,’ feast of sexual enjoyment. —रतोद्वह (°त-उद्°), अस्, m. the Indian cuckoo.
रतान्ध्री: रतान्ध्री रतान्ध्री, f. a fog, mist.
रताम्बुक: रताम्बुक रताम्बुक, ए, n. du. the two cavities immediately above the hips.
रतू: रतू रतू, ऊस्, f. (said to be fr. a Sautra rt. ऋत्), the river of heaven, the celestial Ganges; a true speech.
रत्न: रत्न रत्न, अम्, n. (rarely अस्, m.; according to Uṇādi-s. III. 14. fr. rt. रम्), a gift, present (Ved., in this sense perhaps connected with rt. 1. रा); property, goods, riches, possessions (Ved.); a jewel, gem, treasure, precious stone, pearl; anything valu-able or desirable, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 41, 6, &c. रत्नम् = रमणीयम्); any precious thing, anything excellent or best of its kind (e. g. पुत्र-रत्न, an excellent son; गो-रत्नानि, excellent cows; cf. पुं-र्°, स्त्री-र्°); a magnet, loadstone [cf. मणि]; = रत्न-हविस् (Ved.); (अस्), m. a proper N. —रत्न-कन्दल, अस्, m. coral. —रत्न-कर, अस्, m., N. of Kuvera. —रत्न-करण्डक, N. of a Buddhist work. —रत्न-कलश, अस्, m. a proper N. —रत्न-कला, f., N. of a woman. —रत्न-कीर्त्ति, इस्, m., N. of a Buddha. —रत्न-कूट, अस्, m., N. of a mountain; of a Bodhi-sattva; of an island. —रत्नकूट-सूत्र, अम्, n., N. of a Buddhist Sūtra work. —रत्न-केतु, उस्, m., N. of a Buddha; of a Bodhi-sattva; (said to be a name common to 2000 future Buddhas.) —रत्न-कोटि, N. of a Samādhi. —रत्न-कोश or रत्न-कोष, अस्, m. ‘repository of jewels,’ N. of various works. —रत्न-क्षेत्र-कूट-सन्दर्शन, अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva, (also written रत्न-च्छत्त्र-कूट-सन्दर्शन।) —रत्न-खचित, अस्, आ, अम्, set or studded with gems. —रत्न-खानि, इस्, f. a jewel-mine, mine for precious stones. —रत्न-गर्भ, अस्, आ, अम्, holding precious stones, filled with jewels, containing jewels; (अस्), m. the sea; N. of Kuvera; of a Bodhi-sattva; of a commentator on the Viṣṇu-Purāṇa; (आ), f. the earth. —रत्न-ग्रीव-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a place of pilgrimage. —रत्न-चन्-द्र, अस्, m., N. of a god (said to be the guardian deity of a jewel-mine); of a Bodhi-sattva; of a son of Vimbisāra. —रत्न-चन्द्रामति, इस्, m. a proper N. —रत्न-चूड, अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva; of a mythical king. —रत्न-चूडा-परिपृच्छा, f., N. of a work. —रत्न-च्छत्त्र, अम्, n. ‘jewel-um-brella,’ an umbrella (adorned) with precious stones. —रत्नच्छत्त्र-कूट-सन्दर्शन, अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva. —रत्नच्छत्त्राभ्युद्गताव-भास (°र-अभ्°, °त-अव्°), अस्, m., N. of a Buddha. —रत्न-तेजो-ऽभ्युद्गत-राज, अस्, m., N. of a Buddha. —रत्न-त्रय, अम्, n. (with Jainas) ‘jewel-triad,’ three jewels or excellent things (viz. सम्यग्-दर्शन, सम्यग्-ज्ञान, and सम्यक्-चारित्र). —रत्नत्रय-परीक्षा, f., N. of a treatise on the Vedānta by Apya-dīkṣita. —रत्न-दत्त, अस्, m., N. of various persons. —रत्न-दर्-पण, अस्, m. ‘jewel-mirror,’ a looking-glass (orna-mented) with jewels; N. of a commentary on the Sarasvatī-kaṇṭhābharaṇa. —रत्न-दीप, अस्, m. ‘jewel-lamp,’ a lamp in which jewels give out light, a gem serving as a light, (such gems are fabled to be in Pātāla.) —रत्न-दीपिका, f., N. of a work. —रत्न-द्रुम, (probably) coral; [cf. रत्न-वृक्ष।] —रत्नद्रुम-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made or composed of coral, resembling coral. —रत्न-द्वीप, ‘jewel-island, pearl-island,’ N. of a particular island. —रत्न-धर, अस्, m., N. of the father of Jagad-dhara. —रत्न-धा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. getting or possessing wealth, possessed of riches or precious things, (रत्नधा-तम, superl. possessing great riches.) —रत्न-धेनु, उस्, f. an offering of jewels (properly in the shape of a cow, see धेनु). —रत्-न-धेय, अम्, n., Ved. the giving away or distri-bution of wealth, (according to Sāy. also = दातव्यं रत्नम्, treasure that ought to be given, and र-मणीय-धनस्य दातृ, giver of precious wealth.) —रत्न-ध्वज, अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva. —रत्न-नदी, f. ‘jewel-river,’ N. of a river. —रत्न-नाभ, अस्, m. ‘having a jewel on the navel,’ N. of Viṣṇu. —रत्न-निचय, अस्, m. a heap or collection of jewels, &c. —रत्न-निधि, इस्, m. ‘receptacle of pearls, mine of jewels,’ epithet of the sea; of Meru; N. of Viṣṇu; a wagtail (in this sense probably for रत-निधि). —रत्न-प-रीक्षा, f. ‘jewel-testing,’ N. of a work. —रत्न-पर्वत, अस्, m. ‘jewel-mountain,’ a mountain con-taining jewels; N. of Meru. —रत्न-पाणि, इस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva; of a grammarian. —रत्न-पाल, अस्, m., N. of a king. —रत्न-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town. —रत्न-प्रकाश, अस्, m., N. of a dictionary. —रत्न-प्रदीप, अस्, m. = रत्न-दीप। —रत्न-प्रभ, अस्, m., N. of a particular class of deities; of a king; (आ), f. epithet of the earth; N. of a hell (with Jainas); of various women; of a Nāgī; of the seventh Lambaka of the Kathā-sarit-sāgara. —रत्न-बाहु, उस्, m. ‘jewel-armed,’ N. of Viṣṇu. —रत्न-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, distributing gifts or wealth (Ved.); acquiring or possessing jewels, pos-sessing treasures. —रत्न-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, being a gem or jewel. —रत्न-मञ्जरी, f., N.of a Vidyā-dharī; of a woman in the Hitopadeśa. —रत्न-मति, इस्, m. a proper N. —रत्न-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made or consisting of jewels, abundantly studded with precious stones. —रत्न-माला, f. a jewel necklace, pearl necklace, &c.; N. of various works; of a lexicon; of a Dharma-śāstra; of a work by Śrī-pati (= ज्योतिष-र्°); = न्याय-रत्नमाला। —रत्नमाला-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a necklace of jewels or pearls; (अती), f., N. of one of Rādhā's female attendants. —रत्नमालिका, f. (diminutive fr. रत्न-माला), a little jewel necklace. —रत्न-मालिन्, ई, इनी, इ, adorned with a necklace of jewels. —रत्न-मुकुट, अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva. —रत्न-मुख्य, अम्, n. ‘chief of jewels,’ a diamond. —रत्न-मुद्रा, f., N. of a Samādhi. —रत्न-मुद्रा-हस्त, अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva. —रत्न-मेघ-सूत्र, अम्, n., N. of a Buddhist Sūtra work. —रत्न-यष्टि, इस्, m., N. of a Bud-dha. —रत्न-युग्म-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha. —रत्न-रक्षित, अस्, m., N. of one of the two translators of the Karaṇḍa-vyūha into Tibetan. —रत्-न-राज्, ट्, m. ‘jewel-king,’ a ruby. —रत्न-राजि, इस्, f. a string of pearls. —रत्न-राशि, इस्, m. a heap of precious stones, collection of jewels; the sea, ocean. —रत्न-रेखा, f., N. of a princess. —रत्न-लिङ्गेश्वर (°ग-ईश्°), अस्, m. (with Buddhists) Svayam-bhū in his visible form. —रत्न-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, accompanied with gifts (Ved.); possessing wealth or treasure, abounding in precious stones, decorated with jewels; (आन्), m., N. of a mountain; (अती), f. the earth; N. of various women. —रत्न-वर्धन, अस्, m., N. of a person (who erected a statue of Śiva called after him रत्नवर्धनेश). —रत्न-वर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a merchant. —रत्-न-वर्ष, अस्, m., N. of a king of the Yakṣas. —रत्न-वर्षुक, अम्, n., N. of the mythical car Puṣpaka (supposed to rain or pour forth jewels; see पुष्पक). —रत्न-विशुद्ध, अस्, m., N. of a world. —रत्न-वृक्ष, (probably) coral. —रत्न-शलाका, f. a sprout or sprig of jewels —रत्न-शास्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a work by Agastya. —रत्न-शिखर, अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva. —रत्न-शिखिन्, ई, m., N. of a Buddha. —रत्न-शेखर, अस्, m., N. of the author of the Guṇa-sthāna-prakaraṇa. —रत्न-षष्ठी, f. the sixth day of a particular fortnight. —रत्न-सङ्ग्रह, अस्, m., N. of a work on law. —रत्न-सङ्घात, अस्, m. a number or collection of jewels. —रत्नसङ्घात-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made or consisting of a number of jewels. —रत्न-समुद्गल, N. of a Samādhi. —रत्न-सम्भव, अस्, m., N. of a Dhyāni-buddha; of a Buddha; of a Bodhi-sattva; of the place where the Buddha Śaśi-ketu is to appear. —रत्न-सागर, अस्, m., N. of a work. —रत्न-सानु, उस्, m., N. of the mountain Meru. —रत्न-सू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ, producing jewels; (ऊस्), f. the earth. —रत्न-सूति, इस्, f. the earth. —रत्न-सेन, अस्, m., N. of a king. —रत्न-स्व-मिन्, N. of a temple founded by Ratna. —रत्न-हविस्, इस्, n., Ved. N. of a particular oblation in the Rāja-sūya having reference to whatever may be reckoned among a king's most valuable treasures. —रत्नाकर (°न-आक्°), अस्, m. a jewel-mine; the sea, ocean; N. of a Buddha; of a Bodhi-sattva; of a poet; of the author of the Vrata-kalpa-druma; of various other persons; of a horse descended from Uccaiḥ-śravas; of various works; of a Dharma-śāstra; of a work on music; of a work on rhetoric; of a town, (in this sense probably अम्, n.) —रत्ना-कर-निघण्ट, अस्, m., N. of a dictionary. —रत्-नाङ्क (°न-अङ्°), अस्, m., N. of Viṣṇu's car. —रत्नाङ्गुरीयक (°न-अङ्°), अम्, n. a finger-ring (set) with precious stones, (also written रत्-नाङ्गुलीयक।) —रत्नाढ्य (°न-आढ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, abounding in jewels. —रत्ना-देवी, f., N. of a princess. —रत्नाद्रि (°न-अद्°), इस्, m., N. of a mythical mountain. —रत्नाधिपति (°न-अध्°), इस्, m. a superintendent of treasures or valuables; N. of a king. —रत्ना-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town. —रत्नाभरण (°न-आभ्°), अम्, n. an ornament made of jewels. —रत्नार्चिस् (°न-अर्°), इस्, m., N. of a Buddha. —रत्नालोक (°न-आल्°), अस्, m. the lustre or brilliance of a gem. —रत्ना-वती, f., N. of a town. —रत्नावभास (°न-अव्°), अस्, m., N. of a Kalpa. —रत्नावली (°न-आव्°), f. a string of pearls, row of jewels, pearl necklace; N. of a parti-cular rhetorical figure; of various women; of a cele-brated comedy by Harṣa-deva; of a Tantra work; of various other works. —रत्नावली-निबन्ध, अस्, m., N. of a work. —रत्नासन (°न-आस्°), अम्, n. a throne ornamented with jewels. —रत्नेन्द्र (°न-इन्°), अस्, m. ‘jewel-chief,’ a very precious jewel. —रत्नेश्वर (°न-ईश्°), अस्, m., N. of various persons; (अम्), n., N. of a Liṅga. —रत्नोत्तमा (°न-उत्°), f., N. of a Tantra deity. —रत्नोद्भव (°न-उद्°), अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist saint. —रत्-नोल्का (°न-उल्°), f., N. of a Tantra deity.
रत्नक: रत्नक, अस्, m. a proper N.
रत्निन्: रत्निन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. having gifts, receiving presents or offerings, possessing treasures, having precious things, (Sāy. = रमणीय-धन-वत् or रमणीय-फल-वत्, having valuable riches or rewards); epithet of certain persons in whose dwell-ing the Ratna-havis (q. v.) is offered by a king.
रत्नि: रत्नि रत्नि, इस्, m. f. (a corrupted form of अरत्नि), the elbow; a measure of length (= the dis-tance from the elbow to the end of the closed fist, a cubit); (इस्), m. the closed fist. —रत्नि-पृष्ठक, अम्, n. the elbow.
रत्यङ्ग: रत्यङ्ग रत्य्-अङ्ग। See under रति, p. 833.
रथ: रथ रथ, अस्, m. (according to some fr. rt. 4. ऋ, according to Uṇādi-s. II. 2. fr. rt. रम्, according to Nirukta IX. 11. fr. rt. रंह्), a two-wheeled vehicle, carriage, car, chariot, war-chariot; a vehicle or equipage in general, (applied also to the vehicles of the gods; in Ved. applied sometimes to the driver as well as the vehicle, but according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda V. 63, 7. रथ = रंहण-स्व-भाव, of a swift nature, going swiftly); a warrior, hero, champion; the body; the foot; a limb, mem-ber, part; Calamus Rotang; Dalbergia Ougeinensis; = पौरुष; pleasure, delight, desire [cf. मनो-रथ, रथ-जित्]; (ई), f. a small carriage; [cf. probably Gr. ῤέθος; Lat. rota; Old Germ. rad; Angl. रमण: रमण, अस्, ई, अम्, causing pleasure, pleasing, gratifying, delighting, rejoicing, agreeable, delightful, charming; (अस्), m. a lover, wooer, spouse, husband, (क्षपा-रमण, the husband of night, the moon); the god of love or Kāma-deva; an ass; a testicle; a species of tree (= महा-रिष्ट); N. of a mythical son of Mano-harā; of Aruṇa or the charioteer of the sun; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; (आ), f. a charming woman, a wife, mistress; a kind of metre, four times ˘˘¯; N. of Dākṣāyaṇī in Rāma-tīrtha; (ई), f. a beautiful young woman, a mistress, wife; Aloe Indica (= बाला); a kind of metre, four times ˘˘¯ or four times ˘˘¯˘˘¯; N. of a female serpent-demon; (अम्), n. sporting, playing, dalliance, amorous sport, love, sexual pleasure or intercourse; joy or pleasure in general; the hinder parts, the hip and loins, the pudenda (= जघन); the root of Trichosanthes Diœca; N. of a forest. —रमण-वसति, इस्, f. the dwelling-place of a lover.
रमणक: रमणक, अस्, m., N. of a Varṣa; (अस्), m., N. of the regent of this Varṣa, (he was a son of Yajña-bāhu); of Dvīpa; of a son of Vīti-hotra.
रमणीय: 1. रमणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be enjoyed, pleasant, agreeable, delightful, beautiful, lovely, charming, handsome. —रमणीय-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, most charming. —रमणीय-ता, f. or रमणीय-त्व, अम्, n. pleasantness, agreeableness, delightfulness, beauty, charm.
2. रमणीय (fr. रमणी), Nom. A. रमणी-यते, &c., to represent or take the place of a wife, to be the mistress of any one (gen.).
रमणीयक: रमणीयक, अम्, n. pleasantness, beauty, (for रामणीयक।)
रमति: रमति, इस्, f., Ved. a place of pleasant resort; (इस्, इस्, इ), liking to remain in one place, not straying (Ved., said of a cow); (इस्), m. a lover; paradise, heaven; a crow; time; the god of love, Kāma-deva.
रमाण: रमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, playing, sporting, disporting.
रमयत्: रमयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (fr. the Caus.), causing delight, giving pleasure; enjoying.
रम्य: रम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be enjoyed, enjoyable, pleasing, pleasant, delightful, agreeable, beautiful, handsome; (अस्), m. Michelia Champaka (= चम्-पक); = वक-वृक्ष; N. of a son of Āgnīdhra; (आ), f. night [cf. राम्या]; Hibiscus Mutabilis; N. of a female personification of a particular musical mode; of a daughter of Meru (wife of Ramya); of a river; (अम्), n. the root of Trichosanthes Diœca; semen virile. —रम्य-ग्राम, अस्, m., N. of a village. —रम्य-ता, f. or रम्य-त्व, अम्, n. pleasantness, enjoyableness, agreeableness, pleasure, beauty. —रम्य-पुष्प, अस्, m. Bombax Hepta-phyllum. —रम्य-फल, अस्, m. a species of plant (= कारस्कर). —रम्य-श्री, ईस्, m., N. of Viṣṇu. —रम्य-सानु, उस्, उस्, उ, having pleasant peaks or summits (said of a mountain). —रम्याक्षि (°य-अक्°), इस्, m. a proper N.
रम्यक: रम्यक, अस्, m. Melia Sempervirens; the root of Trichosanthes Diœca; N. of a son of Āgnīdhra; (आ), f., scil. सिद्धि, N. of one of the eight perfec-tions in the Sāṅkhya system, (in this sense also अम्, n.); (अम्), n., N. of a Varṣa called after Āgnīdhra's son Ramyaka.
रम्र: रम्र, अस्, m., N. of Aruṇa, the charioteer of the sun [cf. रमण]; beauty, splendor.
रमठ: रमठ रमठ, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people in the west of India, (also read रमट, रामठ); (अम्), n. = रामठ, Asa Fœtida. —रमठ-ध्वनि, इस्, m. Asa Fœtida.
रमितङ्गम: रमितङ्गम रमितङ्गम, अस्, m. a proper N.
रम्फ्: रम्फ् रम्फ्। See rt. रफ्, p. 832.
रम्ब्: रम्ब् रम्ब् [cf. rt. रम्भ् below], cl. 1. A. रम्बते, ररम्बे, &c., to sound; to go (cl. 1. P. रम्बति, cf. rt. रण्व्); to hang down, hang loosely (= rt. लम्ब्).
रम्भ्: रम्भ् रम्भ् [cf. rts. रम्ब्, लम्भ्], cl. 1. A. रम्भते, &c., to sound, roar, bellow, low (as cows), &c., make a noise; (for रम्भ्, as a form of rt. रभ्, see rt. रभ् at p. 832.)
रम्भमाण: रम्भमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, sounding, roaring, bellowing, lowing.
रय्: रय् रय् [cf. rt. लय्], cl. 1. A. रयते, रेये, &c., रयितुम्, to go.
रय: रय रय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. री), the stream of a river, current; rapid flow, quick motion, velocity, speed, swiftness, (रयात् or रयेण quickly, imme-diately, straightway); course [cf. संवत्सर-र्°]; impetuosity, vehemence, violence, ardour, zeal, im-petuous onset; N. of a son of Purū-ravas; of a king. —रय-प्रश्न-सूत्र-सिद्धान्त or राय-प्°, N. of a work. —रय-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing a rapid current or course, swift.
रयिष्ठ: रयिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, very swift or fleet, very vehement; (अस्), m., N. of Agni; of Kuvera; of Brahman; (अम्), n., N. of various Sāmans.
रयि: रयि रयि, इस्, m. (sometimes also इस्, f.; fr. rt. 1. रा; the following forms occur in the Veda, रयिम्, रयिभिस्, रयीणाम्, रय्या, रय्यै, रय्याम्; cf. 2. रै), Ved. property, goods, possessions, treasure, wealth; stuff, materials; (रयेर् आङ्गिरसस्य प्रस्तोभः, N. of a Sāman.) —रयि-द, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. giving property, a bestower of wealth. —रयि-पति, इस्, m., Ved. a lord of property or wealth. —रयि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. possessing property, well off, rich; containing the word रयि. —रयि-विद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. obtaining or possessing property or wealth. —रयि-वृध्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. abounding in riches, (Sāy. = रय्या or धनेन वृद्ध।) —रयि-षाच्, क्, क्, क् (i. e. रयि + साच्), Ved. sharing or possessing pro-perty, (Sāy. = धन-समवायिन्।) —रयि-षाह्, ट्, ट्, ट् (i. e. रयि + साह्), Ved. ruling over property, (Sāy. = रयीणाम् अभिभवितृ।) —रयि-ष्ठा, आस्, आस्, अम् (i. e. रयि + स्था) or रयि-स्थान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being a receptacle of riches, possessing wealth or property.
रयिक्व: रयिक्व, अस्, m. = रैक्व, a proper N.
रयिन्तम: रयिन्-तम, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. of an unused form रयिन्; cf. Pāṇ. VIII. 2. 17), Ved. possessing much property, very wealthy.
रयीयत्: रयीयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (pres. part. fr. a Nom. fr. रयि), Ved. wishing for property, desiring riches.
रयीषिन्: रयीषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. desiring treasures, (appa-rently an incorrect form.)
रय्यावट्ट: रय्यावट्ट रय्यावट्ट, अस्, m. a proper N.
रराट: रराट रराट, अम्, n. (an earlier form of ललाट, q. v.), the forehead, brow; (ई), f. the fore-head; twisted grass used in a particular manner for the Havir-dhāna (Ved.).
रराट्य: रराट्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging or relating to the forehead; (आ), f. twisted grass, (see रराटी above); the horizon.
ररावन्: ररावन् ररावन्, आ, आ, अ (fr. rt. 1. रा), liberal, bountiful, (Sāy. = हविः, प्रयच्छत्।)
रर्फ्: रर्फ् रर्फ् [cf. rt. रफ्], cl. 1. P. रर्-फति, &c., to go.
रलमानाथ: रलमानाथ रलमा-नाथ, अस्, m., N. of a poet; [cf. रमा-नाथ।]
रला: रला रला, f. a species of bird.
रल्लक: रल्लक रल्लक, अस्, m. a woollen cloth, woollen coverlet, blanket; a species of stag or deer; an eyelash.
रव: रव रव, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. रु), a cry, shriek, bray, yell, howl, roar (of animals, wild beasts, &c.); song, singing (of birds &c.); hum, humming; clamour, outcry; talk; thunder; sound, noise (in general).
रवण: रवण, अस्, आ, अम्, crying, screaming, roaring, shrieking, singing, making an outcry or noise of any kind, sounding, sonorous (= शब्दन); jesting, a jester (= भण्डक); sharp, hot (= तीक्ष्ण); unsteady, fickle, changing, = चञ्चल; (अस्), m. a camel; the Koil or Indian cuckoo; N. of a man; of a serpent-king; (अम्), n. brass, bell metal.
रवत्: रवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (for रुवत्, q. v., pres. part. P. of rt. 1. रु), crying out, raising a cry, bellowing.
रवथ: रवथ, अस्, m. = रव (Ved.); the Koil or Indian cuckoo.
रवमाण: रवमाण, अस्, आ, अम् (anomalous pres. part. A. of rt. 1. रु), crying, roaring, raising a cry.
रवस्: रवस् in पुरू-रवस्, बृहद्-रवस्, q.q. v.v.
रवाण: रवाण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. = रवमाण above.
रवितृ: रवितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who cries or calls out, crier, screamer.
रवक: रवक रवक, अस्, m., N. of a Dharaṇa or particular weight of pearls (thirty making the Dha-raṇa; also read रयक, रिवक).
रवणक: रवणक रवणक, a filter made of cane or bamboo.
रवि: रवि रवि, इस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 1. रु), a particular form of the sun (sometimes regarded as one of the twelve Ādityas); the sun (in general) or the god of the sun; a mountain; N. of a Sauvīraka; of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra; the right canal for the passage of the vital air (?). —रवि-कर, अस्, m., N. of a commentator. —रवि-कान्त, अस्, m. a sort of crystal (= सूर्य-कान्त). —रवि-गुप्त, अस्, m., N. of a poet. —रवि-चक्र, अम्, n. a particular astro-nomical diagram (the sun represented as a man car-rying the stars on the various parts of his body). —रवि-ज, अस्, m. ‘child of the sun,’ N. of a parti-cular Ketu; the planet Saturn. —रवि-तनय, अस्, m. the son of the sun, the planet Saturn. —रवि-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha. —रवि-तेजस्, अस्, n. the radiance of the sun. —रवि-दत्त, अस्, m., N. of a priest; of a poet. —रवि-दिन, अम्, n. the day of the sun, Sunday. —रवि-दीप्त, अस्, sun-lighted, sun-illuminated. —रवि-देव, अस्, m., N. of a poet. —रवि-नन्दन, अस्, m. ‘son of the sun,’ Manu Vaivasvata; the ape Sugrīva. —रवि-पत्त्र, अस्, m. a sort of shrub. —रवि-पुत्र, अस्, m. the son of the sun, the planet Saturn. —रवि-प्रिय, अस्, m., N. of various plants, = लकुच; = आदित्य-पत्त्र; = रक्त-करवीर; (आ), f., N. of Dākṣāyaṇī in Gaṅgā-dvāra; (अम्), n. a red lotus-flower; copper. —रवि-बिम्ब, अम्, n., Ved. the sun's disk. —रवि-मण्डल, अम्, n. the sun's orb or disk. —रवि-रत्न, अम्, n. = रवि-कान्त। —रवि-रत्नक, अम्, n. ‘sun-jewel,’ a ruby. —रवि-लोचन, अस्, m. ‘sun-eyed,’ N. of Viṣṇu; of Śiva. —रवि-लोह, अम्, n. copper. —रवि-वार, अस्, m. or रवि-वासर, अस्, अम्, m. n. the day of the sun, Sunday. —रवि-सङ्क्रान्ति, इस्, f. the sun's entrance into a sign of the zodiac. —रवि-सञ्ज्ञक, अम्, n. copper (‘called after the sun’). —रवि-सम-प्रभ, अस्, आ, अम्, radiant as the sun. —रवि-सा-रथि, इस्, m. the sun's charioteer, i. e. Aruṇa or the Dawn. —रवि-सुत, अस्, m. son of the sun, the planet Saturn; the ape Sugrīva. —रवि-सुन्दर-रस, अस्, m., N. of a particular elixir. —रवि-सूनु, उस्, m. son of the sun, the planet Saturn.
रविन्द: रविन्द रविन्द, अम्, n. = अरविन्द, a lotus, lotus-flower.
रविपुला: रविपुला र-विपुला। See under 3. र, p. 824.
रवीषु: रवीषु रवीषु, उस्, m. the god of love, Kāma-deva, (also read वरीषु।)
रशना: रशना रशना, f. (connected with रश्मि below), a rope, cord, line; a rein, bridle; a girth, girdle, zone, woman's zone or girdle, (in this and the previous senses often incorrectly written रसना); the tongue, (in this sense incorrect for रसना); a finger (according to Naigh. II. 5). —रशन-सम्-मित, अस्, आ, अम् (रशन for रशना), Ved. as long as the rope on the sacrificial post. —रशना-कलाप, अस्, m. a woman's girdle formed out of several strings or threads; [cf. कलाप, रश्मि-कलाप।] —रशनाकृत (°ना-आक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. guided by a cord, managed with a bridle. —रशना-गुण, अस्, m. the cord of a girdle. —रशनागुणा-स्पद (°ण-आस्°), अम्, n. the place for the girdle, waist. —रशनोपमा (°ना-उप्°), f. ‘string of com-parisons,’ a form of simile (when the object to which anything is compared is made the subject of another comparision, which again leads to a third and so on).
रशनाय: रशनाय, Nom. A. रशनायते, &c., to be guided by a rein or bridle (?).
रशनायमान: रशनायमान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being guided by a rein.
रश्मि: रश्मि रश्मि, इस्, m. (in one passage इस्, f.; connected with रशना above; in Uṇādi-s. IV. 46. said to be fr. रश्, substituted for rt. 1. अश्, to per-vade; perhaps connected with rt. 1. लस्, to shine), a string, rope, cord; a bridle, rein, leash; a measuring cord or rope; a goad, whip; a finger (Ved.); a ray of light, beam [cf. अंशु]; an eyelash (= पक्ष्-मन्); (in Vājasaneyi-s. XV. 6. said to) = अन्न; [cf. probably Lat. laqueus.] —रश्मि-कलाप, अस्, m. a pearl-necklace &c. consisting of fifty-four (or according to others fifty-six) threads. —रश्मि-केतु, उस्, m. ‘beam-bannered,’ epithet of a Rākṣasa; of a particular comet (Ved.). —रश्मि-क्रीड, अस्, m., N. of a Rākṣasa. —रश्मि-पति, इस्, m. a species of plant (= रवि-पत्त्र). —रश्मि-पवित्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. purified by rays or beams. —रश्मि-प्र-भास, अस्, m., N. of a Buddha. —रश्मि-मण्डल, अम्, n. a circle or garland of rays. —रश्मि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having rays or beams, radiant; (आन्), m. the sun; a proper N. —रश्मि-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, formed of beams, consisting of rays. —रश्मि-मालिन्, ई, इनी, इ, encircled or garlanded with rays. —रश्मि-मुच, अस्, m. ‘ray-emitting,’ the sun. —रश्मि-राज, अस्, m. a proper N. —रश्मि-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having rays, radiant; (आन्), m. the sun, (also रश्मी-वत्।) —रश्मि-शत-शहस्र-परिपूर्ण-ध्वज, अस्, m., N. of a Buddha.
रश्मन्: रश्मन्, only found in inst. c. m. रश्मा = रश्-मिना, by a rein (Ṛg-veda VI. 67, 1).
रश्मिन्: रश्मिन् at the end of an adj. comp. = रश्मि।
रश्मिस: रश्मिस, अस्, m., N. of a Dānava.
रस्: रस् 1. रस् [cf. rt. 1. रास्], cl. 1. P. (some-times also A.) रसति (-ते), ररास, र-सिष्यति, अरासीत् or अरसीत्, रसितुम्, to roar, howl, bellow, neigh, yell, cry, scream, cry out, sound, make any sound or noise; to sing; to resound, reverberate; (according to Naigh. III. 14) to praise: Caus. रास-यति, -यितुम्, Aor. अरीरसत्: Desid. रिरसिषति: Intens. रारस्यते, रारस्ति, to cry out loudly, scream aloud; [cf. Goth. razda; Old Germ. rartjan, rerjan; Angl. Sax. reordian, rarian.]

रस् 2. रस् (perhaps to be regarded as a Nominal fr. रस below), cl. 1. 4. 10. P. रसति, रस्यति, रसयति (also रसापयति; in Ved. occasionally A. रसयते), to taste, relish; to feel, perceive, be sensible of; to love: Pass. रस्यते: Desid. रिरसयिषति, to desire to taste.
रसत्: रसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, crying, sounding, making any sound.
रसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, tasting, perceiving flavour.
रसन: 1. रसन, अम्, n. the act of roaring or screaming, crying, tinkling, sounding, &c., the shaking or rum-bling (of the earth), croaking (of frogs); sound, noise.

2. रसन, अस्, m. (for 1. रसन see p. 835, col. 1), phlegm (regarded as the cause of taste to the tongue); (आ), f. the tongue; N. of two plants, = रास्ना; = गन्ध-भद्रा; (incorrectly) = रशना; (अम्), n. tasting, taste, flavour, savour; the organ of taste; the being sensible of (anything), perception, apprehension, sense. —रसना-रद, अस्, m. ‘having the tongue for teeth,’ a bird. —रसना-लिह्, ट्, m. ‘licking with the tongue,’ a dog. —रसनेन्द्रिय (°न-इन्°), अम्, n. the organ of taste, the tongue.
रसित: 1. रसित, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded, uttering inarticulate sounds; (अम्), n. a roar, scream, cry, noise, sound; the rattling of thunder. —रसिताशिन् (°त-आश्°), ई, इनी, इ, consuming or destroying by mere noise.

2. रसित, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see p. 835, col. 1), tasted; having taste or flavour or sentiment; covered or overlaid with gold, gilded, plated, (in this sense fr. रस, gold, + इत); (अम्), n. vinous liquor, wine.
रसितृ: 1. रसितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who roars or bellows.
2. रसितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, = रसयितृ, a taster.
रारस्यमान: रारस्यमान, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Intens.), crying out or howling very loud.
रस: रस, अस्, m. (perhaps connected with rt. रम्), the sap or juice of plants, juice of fruit; juice of the sugar-cane, syrup; (metaphorically) the best or finest or prime part of anything, essence, marrow; any liquid or fluid, (गवां रसः, milk), water, liquor, drink; milk; melted butter; any mixture, draught, elixir, potion; nectar; poison, poisonous drink; soup, broth; a constituent fluid or essential juice of the body, serum, (especially) the primary juice called chyle (formed from the food and changed by the bile into blood);
