राष्ट्रीय: राष्ट्रीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to a country or kingdom; (अस्), m. a king's brother-in-law.
रास्: रास् 1. रास् (connected with rt. 1. रस्), cl. 1. A. रासते, ररासे, रासितुम्, to scream, cry, yell, howl (said of animals); to sound, make any cry or noise: Intens. रारास्यते।
रास् 2. रास्, a form of rt. 1. रा, to give, (to which forms like रासते, अरासत, रासन्, रासत् are sometimes referred; see Naigh. III. 20.)
रारास्यमान: रारास्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, crying aloud, uttering loud lamentations.
रास: रास, अस्, m. uproar, confused noise, din; noise, sound in general; N. of a particular rustic dance (in this sense probably connected with लास, लास्य, q. v.), a kind of circular dance practised by cowherds, (especi-ally) that in which Kṛṣṇa and the Gopīs engaged; any sportive game or festive amusement, amorous pastime, play in general; (according to some also) speech; a chain. —रास-क्रीडा, f. a sportive dance, the circular dance of Kṛṣṇa and the cowherdesses. —रास-मण्डल, अम्, n. Kṛṣṇa's circular dance or dancing-ground. —रास-यात्रा, f. a festival in honour of Kṛṣṇa and his dances with the Gopīs on the full moon of the month Kārttika. —रासे-रस, अस्, m. (रासे, loc. c.), the dance described above; pastime, sport, festive mirth; a company, assembly, party; love, desire, sentiment; the sixth night after delivery when the family sit up all night (?); alchemy; [cf. रस।] —रासोत्सव (°स-उत्°), अस्, m. the Rāsa festival or festive dances.
रासक: रासक, अस्, अम्, m. n. a kind of drama or dramatic entertainment.
रासभ: रासभ, अस्, आ, अम्, sounding, braying; neighing (applied in Ṛg-veda III. 53, 5. to the horse of Indra); (अस्), m. an ass, jackass, donkey, (in Ṛg-veda I. 34, 9, I. 116, 2. the chariot of the Aśvins is said to be drawn by a single ass, and other authorities mention two asses, but in other places their car is described as drawn by golden-winged, falcon-like, swan-like horses); (ई), f. a she-ass. —रासभ-धूसर, अस्, आ, अम्, ass-grey, grey as an ass, light brown. —रासभ-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, yoked with asses, drawn by asses. —रासभ-वन्दिनी, f. Arabian jasmine. —रासभ-सेन, अस्, m., N. of a king. —रासभाराव (°भ-आर्°), अस्, m. the braying of asses. —रासभारुण (°भ-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, brown as an ass.
रास्य: रास्य in गो-रास्य, अस्, m., N. of Kṛṣṇa.
रासन: रासन रासन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. रसना), relating to the tongue, perceptible by the tongue, pertaining to the sense or organ of taste, savoury, palatable.
रासायन: रासायन रासायन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. रसायन), relating to an elixir, &c.
रास्ना: रास्ना रास्ना, f. (according to Uṇādi-S. III. 15. fr. rt. 1. रस्), a girdle (Ved.; cf. रशना); N. of two plants, Mimosa Octandra, a thorny shrub; the ichneumon plant; a sort of perfume.
रास्नाका: रास्नाका, f., Ved. a small girdle or band.
रास्नाव: रास्नाव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having a girdle, girdled, girt.
रास्प: रास्प रास्प, Ved. (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda V. 43, 14) a sacrificial ladle (= 2. जुहू).
रास्पिर: रास्पिर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (according to Sāy.) holding the sacrificial ladles, &c.
रास्पिन: रास्पिन रास्पिन, अस्, आ, अम् (according to Sāy. either fr. rt. 1. रस् or rt. रप्), Ved. sounding forth praise, praising.
राहक्षति: राहक्षति राहक्षति, इस्, m. a patronymic.
राहित्य: राहित्य राहित्य, अम्, n. (fr. रहित), the being without anything, the being destitute of, free-dom from anything, destitution, destituteness (at the end of a comp., e. g. कृपा-राहित्य, the being without compassion).
राहिल: राहिल राहिल, अस्, m. a proper N.
राहु: राहु राहु, उस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. रह्; probably connected with rts. रभ्, ग्रभ्), ‘the looser’ or ‘the seizer,’ N. of a Daitya or demon who is supposed to seize the sun and moon and thus cause eclipses, (according to the common myth he was a son of Vipra-citti and Sinhikā, and had four arms, his lower part ending in a tail; he was the instigator of all mischief among the Daityas, and when the gods had produced the Amṛta or nectar from the churned ocean, he disguised himself like one of them and drank a portion of it, but the Sun and Moon having detected his fraud and informed Viṣṇu, the latter severed his head and two of his arms from the rest of his body; the portion of nectar he had swallowed having secured his immortality, the head and tail were transferred to the stellar sphere, the head wreaking its vengeance on the Sun and Moon by occasionally swallowing them for a time, while the tail, under the name of Ketu, gave birth to a numerous progeny of comets and fiery meteors: in astronomy Rāhu is variously regarded as a dragon's head, as the ascending node of the moon, or as one of the planets); an eclipse or (rather) the moment of occultation or obscuration; the regent of the south-west quarter. —राहु-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. ‘gone to Rāhu,’ darkened, ob-scured, eclipsed. —राहु-ग्रसन or राहु-ग्र-हण, अम्, n. ‘seizure or swallowing by Rāhu,’ an eclipse of the sun or moon. —राहु-ग्रस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘swallowed by Rāhu,’ eclipsed. —राहु-ग्रास or राहु-ग्राह, अस्, m. an eclipse of the sun or moon, the immersion at an eclipse. —राहु-च्छत्त्र, अम्, n. green ginger. —राहु-दर्शन, अम्, n., Ved. ‘appearance of Rāhu,’ an eclipse. —राहु-पर्-वन्, अ, n. the day or period of an eclipse. —राहु-पीडा, f. ‘oppression by Rāhu,’ an eclipse. —राहु-पूजा, f. the worship of Rāhu. —राहु-भेदिन्, ई, m. ‘severing Rāhu,’ epithet of Viṣṇu. —राहु-मूर्ध-भिद्, त्, or राहु-मूर्ध-हर, अस्, m. ‘decapitator of Rāhu,’ epithet of Viṣṇu. —राहु-रत्न, अम्, n. Rāhu's jewel, N. of a kind of jewel. —राहु-संस्पर्श, अस्, m. contact with Rāhu, i. e. an eclipse of the sun or moon. —राहु-सूतक, अम्, n. the birth or appearance of Rāhu, an eclipse of the sun or moon. —राहूच्छिष्ट (°हु-उच्°) or राहूत्सृष्ट (°हु-उत्°), अम्, n. ‘left or despised by Rāhu,’ a shalote, Allium Ascalonicum.
राहवि: राहवि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Rāhu.
राहुल: राहुल, अस्, m., N. of a son of Śākya-muni; of a son of Śuddhodana; of a minister of Hiouen-thsang. —राहुल-सू, ऊस्, m. father of Rāhula, i. e. Śākya-muni.
राहुलक: राहुलक, अस्, m., N. of a poet.
राहुलत: राहुलत (?), अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist patriarch.
राहूगण: राहूगण राहूगण, अस्, m. (fr. रहूगण), Ved. a patronymic of Gotama; (आस्), m. pl. of the following word.
रि: रि 1. रि (connected with rts. 1. री, 4. ऋ), cl. 6. P. रियति, रिराय, रेष्यति, अरैषीत्, रेतुम्, to go, move; cl. 5. P. रिणोति, &c., to hurt [cf. rt. 4. ऋ]; cl. 9. P. A. रिणाति, रिणीते, &c., to go, move; to draw out, drive out, set free, expel; to separate, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda III. 60, 2. अरिणीत = योजनात् प्रापितवन्तः); to emit; to bestow, grant; to hurt, injure, kill; to be injured (A.); to howl, &c. [cf. rt. 1. री]: Caus. राययति, यितुम्, Aor. अरीरयत्: Desid. रिरीषति: Intens. रेरीयते, रेरयीति, रेरेति।
रि 2. रि, at the end of adj. comps.; [cf. अति-रि, बृहद्-रि।]
रि 3. रि (a contraction of ऋषभ), the second note of the Hindū gamut.
रिणत्: रिणत्, अन्, अती, अत्, Ved. injuring, hurting; setting free.
रिःफ: रिःफ रिःफ, अम्, n. (fr. Gr. ῥιφή), Ved. epithet of the twelfth astrological house.
रिक्त: रिक्त रिक्त, रिक्थ, &c. See below and p. 846, col. 1.

रिक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, emptied, cleared, purged; empty, void; unloaded, unburdened; hollow, hol-lowed (as the hands); having nothing, poor, indi-gent; vain, worthless, valueless; epithet of one of the four wagtails (employed in augury); free from, devoid of, deprived of, destitute of, without; (आ), f., scil. तिथि, epithet of the fourth, ninth, or fourteenth days of the lunar fortnight; (अम्), n. an empty place, empty space, vacuum, void, vacuity; a desert, wilderness, wood, forest. —रिक्त-कुम्भ, अम्, n., Ved. (the sound of) an empty vessel, a hollow sound, empty or senseless language. —रिक्त-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. making empty, emptying; causing a vacuum. —रिक्त-गुरु, see Pāṇ. VI. 2, 42. —रिक्त-ता, f. emptiness, vacuity, void, empty space or space in general. —रिक्त-पाणि, इस्, इस्, इ, empty-handed, bringing no present. —रिक्त-भाण्ड, अम्, n. an empty vessel; (अस्, आ, अम्), having no vessels or effects. —रिक्त-मति, इस्, इस्, इ, empty-minded, thinking of nothing —रिक्त-हस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, empty-handed, having empty hands, bringing no present; carrying away no present. —रिक्तार्क (°त-अर्°), अस्, m. a Sunday falling on one of the Riktā days. —रिक्ती-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to make empty or void, remove, take away; to steal; to get back, recover. —रिक्तीकृत-हृदय, अस्, आ, अम्, emptied or deprived of heart.
रिक्वन्: रिक्वन् रिक्वन्, आ, m., Ved. = स्तेन, a thief (according to Naigh. III. 24).
रिक्षा: रिक्षा रिक्षा, f. a nit (= लिक्षा); a mote in a sun-beam.
रिख्: रिख् रिख् (connected with rts. रिङ्ख्, रिङ्ग्, रख्, रङ्ख्), cl. 1. P. रेखति, &c., to go, move (so given by Vopa-deva, but by other grammarians identified in this sense with rt. रिङ्ख् below); cl. 6. P. (not in use, but apparently the original form of rt. लिख्, cl. 6. लिखति, q. v.), to scratch, scrape, write; [cf. रेखा; cf. also Gr. ἐρείκω, ἐρέχθω.]
रिङ्ख्: रिङ्ख् रिङ्ख् (connected with rts. रिख्, रख्, रङ्ख्, रिङ्ग्, रङ्ग्), cl. 1. P. रिङ्खति, &c., to go, move, creep, crawl (said of young children); to go slowly; to slip.
रिङ्ख: रिङ्ख, अस्, m. See under रिङ्खा below.
रिङ्खण: रिङ्खण, अम्, n. the act of crawling, creeping (said of children who creep on all fours).
रिङ्खा: रिङ्खा, f. creeping, sliding; dancing; one of a horse's paces; a horse's hoof; deceiving, disappoint-ing, (according to some also अस्, m. in the previous senses); the plant Carpopogon Pruriens.
रिङ्ग्: रिङ्ग् रिङ्ग् (connected with rts. रङ्ग्, रिङ्ख्, &c., see above), cl. 1. P. रिङ्गति, &c., to go, move, creep, crawl (said of young children), to move slowly or with difficulty; to slip: Caus. रिङ्गयति, &c., to cause to creep.
रिङ्गण: रिङ्गण, अम्, n. the act of moving, creeping, crawling (= रिङ्खण); slipping, sliding; deviating (from rectitude, &c.).
रिङ्गत्: रिङ्गत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, creeping, crawling, moving.
रिङ्गमाण: रिङ्गमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, creeping, crawling, slipping.
रिङ्गि: रिङ्गि, इस्, f. going, moving, motion.
रिङ्गित: रिङ्गित, अम्, n. motion, surging (of waves).
रिङ्गिन्: रिङ्गिन्, ई, इणी, इ, creeping, crawling (said of young children).
रिच्: रिच् रिच्, cl. 7. P. A. रिणक्ति, रिङ्क्ते, रिरेच, रिरिचे, रेक्ष्यति, -ते, अरिचत् or अरैक्षीत् (Vedic forms अरिरेचीत्, अरैक्), अरिक्त (1st sing. अरिक्षि), रेक्तुम्, to empty, make empty, evacuate, clear, purge, remove, separate, divide; to resign, give up, deliver up, part with, sell, (but ac-cording to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda IV. 24, 9. ‘to recover, get back’); to leave, leave behind, bequeath; cl. 10. 1. P. रेचयति, रेचति, &c., to divide, separate; to disconnect, disjoin; to leave, abandon; to join, mix: Pass. रिच्यते, Aor. अरेचि, to be emptied, &c.; to be deprived of, lose, be freed from; to be destroyed, perish: Caus. रेचयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अरीरिचत्, to cause to empty, make empty; to discharge, emit (as breath); to abandon, give up: Desid. रिरिक्षति, -ते: Intens. रेरिच्यते, रेरेक्ति; [cf. Zend ric; Gr. λείπ-ω, λιμπάν-ω, λεῖμμα, λείψανο-ν, λοιπός; Lat. linqu-o, re-linqu-o, re-liqu-u-s, lic-e-t (Osc. lik-i-tud = lice-to), lic-e-o-r; Goth. laib-a, bi-laib-jan, af-lif-nan, leihvan; Old Germ. bi-lib-an; Mod. Germ. bleibe; Angl. Sax. lyfan, be-lijan, lafan, lœn, lœnan; Lith. lek-u, lik-ti, lek-as, pa-laiki-s.]
रिक: रिक (?), अम्, n. the heart, mind; law, litigation.
रिक्तक: रिक्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, empty, void; unladen, un-burdened.
रिक्थ: रिक्थ, अम्, n. (frequently written ऋक्थ), pro-perty left at death, inheritance, portion, bequest; property in general, possessions, substance, wealth; gold. —रिक्थ-ग्राह, अस्, आ, अम्, receiving an in-heritance, inheriting property; (अस्), m. an inheritor, heir. —रिक्थ-जात, अम्, n. the aggregate of a property, collected estate (of a deceased person). —रिक्थ-भागिन्, ई, इनी, इ, or रिक्थ-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, inheriting or sharing property, dividing the pro-perty (of a deceased person), an inheritor, heir. —रिक्थ-विभाग, अस्, m. the division or sharing of (a deceased person's) property, partition of inherit-ance; a share in an inheritance. —रिक्थ-हर or रिक्थ-हार, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, receiving an inherit-ance, inheriting property; (अस्), m. an heir. —रिक्-थ-हारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, receiving or inheriting pro-perty; (ई), m. an heir, one who succeeds to property; a maternal uncle; the seed of the Indian fig-tree.
रिक्थाद: रिक्थाद (°थ-आद), अस्, आ, अम्, receiving an inheritance; (अस्), m. an heir, son.
रिक्थिन्: रिक्थिन्, ई, इनी, इ, inheriting property; possessing property, wealthy; (ई), m. an heir.
रिक्थीय: रिक्थीय in अ-रिक्थीय, अस्, आ, अम्, incapable of inheriting property, having no claim to inheritance.
रिच्यमान: रिच्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being emptied, being purged, being left clear, being freed from, being delivered from.
रिरिक्वस्: रिरिक्वस्, वान्, m., Ved. one who has emaciated or attenuated (his body by austerities, Ṛg-veda IV. 24, 3).
रेक: रेक, रेच, रेचित, &c. See p. 852, col. 3.
1. रेक, अस्, m. suspicion, doubt, fear, care, anxiety, concern; a man of a low caste, outcast; a frog; [cf. भेक।]
रेक 2. रेक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. रिच्), emptying, loosening, looseness, purging.
रिज्: रिज् रिज् (connected with rt. ऋञ्ज्), cl. 1. A. रेजते, &c., to fry; to parch; [cf. rt. भृज्।]
रिटि: रिटि रिटि, इस्, f. the crackling or roaring of flame; a musical instrument; black salt.
रिणीनगर: रिणीनगर रिणी-नगर, अम्, n., N. of a town.
रिण्व्: रिण्व् रिण्व् or रिम्ब् (= rt. रण्व्), cl. 1. P. रिण्वति, रिम्बति, &c., to go.
रित्: रित् रित्, त्, त्, त् (fr. rt. 1. रि), Ved. (per-haps) moving, flowing, (Sāy. = गन्तृ।)
रितक्वन्: रितक्वन् रितक्वन्, आ, m., Ved. a thief, (various reading for तक्वन्, Naigh. III. 24.)
रिद्ध: रिद्ध रिद्ध, अस्, आ, अम् (probably for ऋद्ध, q. v.), ripe (said of grain).
रिधम: रिधम रिधम, अस्, m. (perhaps connected with रिद्ध above), spring; love.
रिप्: रिप् 1. रिप् (the old form of rt. लिप्, q. v.; in Ṛg-veda V. 85,8. the form रिरिपुः = लेपयन्ति = पापम् आरोपयन्ति), Ved. to smear, smear or cover over; to defile, spoil; to deceive, cheat.
2. रिप्, प्, f., Ved. injury, fraud, deceit, trick, guile, (Sāy. = हिंसा, माया); the earth, (Sāy. = भूमि); (प्, प्, प्), injuring, an injurer, enemy, deceiver, cheat, (Sāy. = रिपु।)
रिपु: रिपु, उस्, उस्, उ (according to Uṇādi-s. I. 27. fr. rt. रप्; according to others, connected with rt. 1. रि or with Caus. of rt. 1. री; cf. rt. रिफ्), injuring, cheating, deceiving, fraudulent, treacherous, false (Ved.); (उस्), m. a deceiver, cheat, rogue, thief (Ved.); an enemy, adversary, foe; (in astrology) a hostile planet; epithet of the sixth astrological house; N. of a son of Śliṣṭi. —रिपु-घातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, slaying an enemy, killing foes; (इनी), f. a species of creeper; Abrus Precatorius. —रिपु-घ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, killing an enemy. —रिपुञ्-जय, अस्, आ, अम्, conquering a foe, vanquishing enemies; (अस्), m., N. of several kings; of a son of Śliṣṭi; of a son of Suvīra; of a son of Viśva-jit. —रिपु-ता, f. en-mity, hostility. —रिपु-निपातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, causing an enemy to fall, destroying a foe. —रिपु-बल, अम्, n. an enemy's army. —रिपु-भय, अम्, n. fear or danger from an enemy. —रिपु-भवन, अम्, n. or रिपु-भाव, अस्, m. epithet of the sixth astrological house. —रिपु-मल्ल, अस्, m., N. of a king. —रिपु-रक्त, अम्, n. an enemy's blood. —रिपु-रक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, preserving from an enemy. —रिपु-राक्षस, अस्, m., N. of an elephant. —रिपु-वर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, freed from an enemy. —रिपु-वश, अस्, आ, अम्, subject to an enemy. —रिपुवश-त्व, अम्, n. subjection to an enemy. —रिपु-सूदन, अस्, ई, अम्, destroying ene-mies. —रिपु-स्थान, अम्, n. epithet of the sixth astrological house.
रिप्त: रिप्त, अस्, आ, अम् (= लिप्त), Ved. anointed, smeared, (अपि-रिप्त in Ṛg-veda I. 118, 7 = पट-लेन पिहित-दृष्टि, i. e. blinded.)
रिप्र: रिप्र, अम्, n. (according to Uṇādi-s. V. 55. fr. rt. 1. री), dirt, impurity (Ved.); sin, (Sāy. = पाप; cf. Nirukta IV. 21); (अस्, आ, अम्), vile, bad; (अस्), m., N. of a son of Śliṣṭi. —रिप्र-वाह, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. carrying off or removing impurity or sin, (Sāy. = पापस्य वोढृ।)
रेप: रेप, अस्, आ, अम्, low, vile, inferior, contemptible; cruel, savage.
रेप रेप, रेपस्। See p. 846, col. 2.
रेपस्: रेपस्, अस्, n. (according to Uṇādi-s. IV. 189. fr. rt. रप्; cf. रपस्), a spot, stain; a wrong or blamable action, fault, sin; (आस्, आस्, अस्), low, vile, contemptible; miserly, niggardly; wicked, aban-doned, cruel, savage.
रिफ्: रिफ् रिफ् [cf. rt. रिह्], cl. 6. P. रिफति, रिरेफ, &c., to utter a murmuring gut-tural sound, to utter a rough or grating or burring sound, to pronounce the letter र् [cf. रेफ below]; to murmur or snarl at, revile, find fault with, blame, despise; (according to lexicographers also capable of the following senses), to speak, say, relate; to boast, (कत्थने being a various reading for कथने); to give; to fight; to hurl, kill, (in this sense = rts. ऋफ्, रिम्फ्): Pass. रिफ्यते, to be murmured or spoken in a grating or burring manner, to have or take the pronunciation of the letter र्।
रिफत्: रिफत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, murmuring, uttering a burring sound, pronouncing the letter र्।
रिफित: रिफित, अस्, आ, अम्, uttered in a burring or grating manner, pronounced with the sound of the letter र्।
रेफ: रेफ, अस्, m. a burr, burring or grating sound, the letter र्; a cretic (see 3. र); passion, affection of the mind; (अस्, आ, अम्), low, vile, contemptible; [cf. रेप above.] —रेफ-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. containing a burring sound, having the sound of र्। —रेफ-विपुला = र-विपुला, q. v.
रेफ रेफ, रेफस्, रेफिन्। See p. 846, col. 2.
रेफस्: रेफस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, low, vile, contemptible; wicked, abandoned; miserly, niggardly; cruel, savage; [cf. रेपस् above.]
रेफित्वा: रेफित्वा, ind. having uttered a burring or grating sound, having pronounced with the sound of the letter र्।
रेफिन्: रेफिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. containing a burring sound, containing the letter र्, having the nature of र्।
रिभ्: रिभ् रिभ् or रेभ्, cl. 1. A. रेभते (Ved. also P. रेभति), रिरेभे, रेभितुम्, to crackle, creak; to murmur (as a stream &c.); to sound in general; to chatter, babble, clatter; to talk or speak aloud, shout with joy, rejoice [cf. rt. रिह्]; to praise, glorify, worship (Ved. P.): Pass. रिभ्यते, to be praised or glorified; [cf. Gr. ῥοίβδην, ῥοῖβδος, ῥοιβδέω.]
रिभ्वन्: रिभ्वन्, आ, m., Ved. (according to Naigh. III. 24) a thief; [cf. रिह्वन्।]
रेभ: रेभ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. crackling; sounding loudly; (अस्), m. a praiser, reciter of praises, panegyrist, celebrator; a talker, prattler, chatterer; N. of a Ṛṣi (who was cast into a well by the Asuras, and rescued by the Aśvins after having lain there for ten nights and nine days, see Ṛg-veda I. 112, 5. 116, 24, &c.); N. of the author of Ṛg-veda VIII. 97 (having the patronymic Kāśyapa). —रेभ-सूनू, m. du. two sons of Rebha, the authors of the hymns Ṛg-veda IX. 99, 100.
रेभण: रेभण, अम्, n. the lowing of kine.
रेभत्: रेभत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. crackling, sounding; praising.
रेभिल: रेभिल and रेभिलक, अस्, m. a proper N.
रिम्फ्: रिम्फ् रिम्फ् (connected with rt. ऋफ्; cf. rt. रिफ्), cl. 6. P. रिम्फति, to hurt, kill.
रिरंसा: रिरंसा रिरंसा, f. (fr. Desid. of rt. रम्), the desire to rejoice or be pleased, wish to sport; desire of pleasure or sexual enjoyment, lasciviousness, lustfulness.
रिरंसु: रिरंसु, उस्, उस्, उ, desiring to rejoice, wishing to sport, wishing for sexual pleasures, lustful, wanton, lascivious.
रिरमयिषु: रिरमयिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of Caus.), wishing to cause or give pleasure (especially sexual pleasure).
रिरक्षिषा: रिरक्षिषा रिरक्षिषा, f. (fr. the Desid. of rt. 1. रक्ष्), the desire to watch or keep guard, wish to protect.
रिरक्षा: रिरक्षा, f. less correct for the above.
रिरक्षिषु: रिरक्षिषु, उस्, उस्, उ, desiring to watch or keep guard, wishing to protect.
रिरक्षु: रिरक्षु, less correct for रिरक्षिषु above.
रिरिक्षु: रिरिक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to injure or harm, (this form is sometimes referred to rt. 1. रिष्।)
रिरी: रिरी रिरी, f. yellow brass, pale brass, prince's metal; [cf. रीरी, रीति।]
रिल्हण: रिल्हण रिल्हण or रिह्लण, अस्, m. a proper N.
रिश्: रिश् रिश् (according to some an older form of rt. 1. लिश्, q. v.; closely connected with rt. 1. रिष्, from which, in some forms and meanings, it is not distinguishable; cf. also rts. रुश्, 1. रुष्), cl. 6. P. रिशति, रिरेश, रेक्ष्यति, अरि-क्षत्, रेष्टुम्, Ved. to tear, rend, tear off, break off, pluck off, injure, hurt; to feed on, graze: Caus. रेशयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अरीरिशत्: Desid. रिरिक्षति, to wish to injure: Intens. रेरिश्यते, रेरेष्टि; [cf. Slav. resati, ‘to cut.’]
रिरिक्षत्: रिरिक्षत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. wishing to injure, &c.; (अन्), m. an enemy.
रिश: रिश, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. tearing, tearing off, injur-ing; (अस्), m. an injurer, enemy.
रिशत्: रिशत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, Ved. tearing, injuring, hurting; feeding or grazing upon, consuming, (Sāy. = भक्षणार्थं हिंसत्।)
रिशादस्: रिशादस्, आस्, आस्, अस् (a word of doubtful derivation and meaning; said to be fr. रिश, an enemy, + अद fr. rt. अद्), Ved. destroying those who injure, de-stroying enemies, epithet of the Maruts, &c.; [cf. Ṛg-veda I. 39, 4.]
रिष्ट: 1. रिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. रिष्ट see below), Ved. torn, torn off, broken, injured; wearied.

2. रिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see above), injured, hurt, wounded; unlucky; (according to some also) lucky; (अम्), n. mischief, harm; misfortune, bad luck (= अरिष्ट); destruction, loss; sin; (according to some also) good luck, prosperity; (अस्), m. a sword; the soap plant, Sapindus Detergens; N. of a king; of a Daitya or demon (destroyed by Viṣṇu); of a son of a Manu; (आ), f., N. of the mother of the Apsarases. —रिष्ट-ताति, इस्, इस्, इ, causing prosperity, propitious; auspicious; [cf. शिव-ताति।] —रिष्ट-देह, अस्, आ, अम्, wounded in body.
रिश्य: रिश्य रिश्य, अस्, m. = ऋश्य, an antelope.
रिष्: रिष् 1. रिष् (closely connected with rt. रिश्, from which, in some forms and mean-ings, it is not distinguishable; cf. also rts. रुश्, 1. रुष्), cl. 1. 4. P. रेषति, रिष्यति (in ep. and later authors also A. रिष्यते), रिरेष, रेषिष्यति, अरेषीत् or अरिषत् (Vedic forms रिषत्, रिषाम, रिषाथन, रेषत्, रीषत), रेषितुम् or रेष्टुम् (Ved. inf. रिषे), to injure, hurt, harm; to kill, destroy, ruin; to give offence; to be injured or destroyed, suffer wrong, perish (cl.4); to fail, mis-carry, meet with misfortune or disaster (cl. 4): Caus. रेषयति, -यते, -यितुम्, Aor. अरीरिषत्, अरीरि-षत, to cause to be injured, injure, hurt, harm; to cause to miscarry, make to fail; to fail, miscarry, meet with misfortune or disaster (A.): Desid. रिरि-षिषति, रिरेषिषति, (according to some also रि-रिक्षति): Intens. रेरिष्यते, रेरेष्टि; [cf. pro-bably Gr. ῥαίω, ῥαιστός; Lat. lœdo.]
2. रिष्, ट्, f. injury; (ट्, ट्, ट्), injuring, an injurer.
रिष: रिष, अस्, आ, अम्, injuring, destroying, &c.; [cf. नघा-रिष।]
रिषण्य: रिषण्य, Nom. P. रिषण्यति, &c. (Pāṇ. VII. 4, 36), Ved. to injure, harm, be hurtful; to reject (a petition); to fail, miscarry.
रिषण्यु: रिषण्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. injurious, hurtful, ma-levolent, (Sāy. = हिंसक।)
रिषीक: रिषीक, अस्, आ, अम्, (probably) destroying, destruc-tive, injurious.
रिष्टि: रिष्टि, इस्, f. injury, hurt, damage; failure, mis-carriage, misfortune, bad luck; (according to some) good luck; इषु-रिष्टि, ‘the going astray or swerv-ing of an arrow,’ N. of a Sāman; (इस्), m. = ऋष्टि, a sword, (according to some also इस्, f.)
रिष्टीय: रिष्टीय, Nom. P. रिष्टीयति, &c. = रिषण्य above.
रिष्व: रिष्व, अस्, आ, अम्, injurious, hurtful, mischievous.
रिष्य: रिष्य रिष्य, अस्, m. = ऋष्य, ऋश्य। —रिष्य-मूक, अस्, m. = ऋष्य-मूक।
रिह्: रिह् रिह् (a Vedic form of rt. लिह्), the following forms of this rt. are found, रेऌहि, रिहति (3rd pl. रिहन्ति, A. रिहते), to lick, taste; to caress, kiss; (also regarded as another form of rt. रिफ्, and therefore said to be capable of the follow-ing meanings) to praise, worship; to say, speak; to boast; to give [cf. rt. 1. रा]; to blame; to fight; to hurt, injure; to kill, (in this sense said to be also रेहति): Intens. रेरिह्यते, to lick again and again; to caress, kiss.
रिहाण: रिहाण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. licking, caressing, wish-ing to caress.
रिहायस्: रिहायस्, आस्, m., Ved. a thief, robber (Naigh. III. 24).
रिह्वन्: रिह्वन्, आ, m. a thief; [cf. रिभ्वन्।]
रेरिहाण: रेरिहाण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. repeatedly licking or caressing; (अस्), m., N. of Śiva; a thief; an Asura; = अम्बर; = वर।
रिहम्: रिहम् रिहम्, ind., Ved. various reading for ऋहत्, q. v.
री: री 1. री (connected with rt. 1. रि), cl. 9. P. A. रिणाति, रिणीते, रिराय (3rd du. रिर्यतुस्), रिर्ये, रेष्यति, रेष्यते, अरैषीत्, अरेष्ट, रेतुम्, to go, move; to hurt, injure, kill, (see rt. 1. रि); to howl [cf. rt. 1. रु]; cl. 4. A. रीयते, &c., to melt, become fluid, distil, drip, trickle, ooze, drop, flow [cf. rt. 1. ली]: Caus. रेप-यति, -यितुम्, Aor. अरीरिपत्: Desid. रिरीषति, -ते: Intens. रेरीयते, रेरयीति; [cf. Goth. and Angl. Sax. rinnan.]
री 2. री = रै in ऋधद्-री, (for री, fem. of 2. र, see under 2. र, p. 824.)
रीण: रीण, अस्, आ, अम्, dropping, trickling, oozing, distilling, flowing, leaking.
रीति: रीति, इस्, f. going, motion, moving, flowing, trick-ling; a stream, river; a course; a line, streak; a limit, boundary (= सीमन्); general course or way, method, mode, manner, fashion; usage, observance, custom, practice, natural property or disposition; style, diction, (three styles of diction or composition are enumerated, viz. वैदर्भी, गौडी, पाञ्चालि, to which a fourth is sometimes added, viz. लाटिका, and even a fifth and sixth, viz. आवन्तिका and मागधी); bell-metal, brass, pale brass; calx of brass; rust of iron; scoria of any metal or the oxide formed on the surface of metals by their exposure to heat and air. —रीति-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, acquainted with estab-lished usages or customs. —रीति-पुष्प, अम्, n. ‘brass-efflorescence,’ calx of brass. —रीति-प्रष्ठ, अस्, अम्, m. n. a Praṣṭha weight of brass. —रीति-बद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, brass-bound, studded or inlaid with brass. —रीती-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, being in a row, standing in a line. —रीत्य्-अप्, प्, प्, प्, Ved. stream-ing with rain.
रीतिक: रीतिक, अम्, n. calx of brass; (आ), f. bell-metal, brass.
रीज्या: रीज्या रीज्या, f. reproach, censure [cf. रीढा]; shame, modesty.
रीठा: रीठा रीठा, f. or रीठा-करञ्ज, अस्, m. a species of Karañja.
रीढक: रीढक रीढक, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. रिह्), the back-bone.
रीढा: रीढा रीढा, f. (probably fr. rt. रिह्), dis-respect. disregard, contempt, irreverence; [cf. अव-लीढा।]
रीर: रीर रीर, अस्, m., N. of Śiva.
रीरी: रीरी रीरी, f. = रिरी, yellow brass.
रीव्: रीव् रीव्, cl. 1. P. A. रीवति, -ते, &c., to take.
रु: रु 1. रु, cl. 2. P. रौति, रवीति (Ved. also रुवति, and in some forms also A.), Impf. अरौत् or अरवीत् (1st du. अरुव or अरुवीव, 3rd pl. अरुवन्), रुराव (1st du. रुरुविव, 3rd pl. A. रुरुविरे), रविता or (according to Vopa-deva IX. 53) रोता, रविष्यति, अरावीत् (A. अराविष्ट, 3rd pl. अराविषुस्, Ved. अरवन्त), रवितुम्, and (ac-cording to Vopa-deva) रोतुम्, to cry or make any particular sound or noise, bellow, roar, howl, yelp, yell, bray, shout, shriek; to hum (as bees); to sound in general; to cry aloud, to fill with noise or cries; to praise (according to Naigh. III. 14): Pass. रू-यते: Caus. रावयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अरीरवत् (anomalous form 3rd pl. अरूरुवन्), to cause to bellow or roar, &c., to cause an uproar; to fill with shrieks, clamour, &c.: Desid. of Caus. रिरावयि-षति: Desid. रुरूषति: Intens. रोरूयते, -ति, रोरवीति, रोरोति, to cry out loudly, bellow or roar loudly, yelp loudly, scream aloud, to vociferate; [cf. Gr. ὠρύ-ω, ὠρυ-θ-μό-ς, ὀρυ-μαγδό-ς; Lat. rû-mor, rûm-i-to, râvi-s, rau-cu-s; Angl. Sax. ryn; Slav. rev-a, rju-ti, ‘to roar.’]
2. रु, उस्, m. sound, noise; fear, alarm; war, battle.
रु 3. रु, cl. 1. A. रवते, रुरुवे, &c., Ved. to break to pieces, dash to pieces; to kill, hurt (?); to be angry (?); to go; to speak: Caus. रावयति, &c.
रुत: 1. रुत, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see col. 3), sounded, filled with the cry (of animals), made to resound, rendered vocal; (अम्), n. any cry or noise, yell, roar, humming (of bees), the note of birds; song. —रुत-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, understanding the cries (of animals); (अस्), m. an augur. —रुत-व्याज, अस्, m. simulated cry or sound; mimicry.
2. रुत, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see col. 2), broken to pieces, divided, &c.
रुत रुत, &c. See under rt. 1. रु, p. 847, col. 2.
रुतायत: रुतायत (?), अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 1. रुत), rendered vocal (by the sound of birds, &c.).
रुवण्य: रुवण्य (fr. an unused form रुवण), Nom. P. रु-वण्यति, &c., Ved. to cry, utter harsh or loud cries.
रुवण्य रुवण्य, रुवथ। See p. 847, col. 3.
रुवण्यु: रुवण्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. sounding, clamouring.
रुवत्: रुवत्, अन्, अती, अत्, crying out, bellowing, howling, crying.
रुवथ: रुवथ, अस्, m. the bellowing of a bull (Ved.); a dog.
रोरवण: रोरवण, अम्, n. (fr. the Intens.), Ved. a loud cry or roaring, violent bellowing.
रोरवण रोरवण, रोरुवत्, रोरूय। See p. 847, col. 3.
रोरुवत्: रोरुवत्, अन्, अती, अत्, Ved. sounding or shouting loudly, (referred by some to rt. 3. रु।)
रोरुवाण: रोरुवाण, अस्, आ, अम्, crying loudly, making a loud cry or sound.
रोरूय: रोरूय, अस्, m. crying much, &c. (Vopa-deva XXVI. 29).
रोरूयमाण: रोरूयमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, crying loudly, making a loud cry.
रुंश्: रुंश् रुंश्, cl. 1. 10. P. रुंशति, रुंश-यति, &c., to speak; to shine (?).
रुक: रुक रुक, अस्, आ, अम्, liberal, bountiful.
रुक्काम: रुक्काम रुक्-काम। See under 2. रुच्, p. 848.
रुक्प्रतिक्रिया: रुक्प्रतिक्रिया रुक्-प्रतिक्रिया। See under 2. रुज्, p. 848, col. 3.
रुक्म: रुक्म, अस्, आ, अम्, bright, radiant, clear; (अस्), m. an ornament of gold, golden chain, (perhaps also) an ornament of precious stones (Ved.); the plant Mesua Roxburghii; the thorn-apple; N. of a son of Rucaka; (अम्), n. gold; iron. —रुक्म-कवच, अस्, m., N. of a grandson of Uśanas. —रुक्म-कारक, अस्, m. a worker in gold, gold-smith. —रुक्म-केश, अस्, m., N. of a son of Bhīṣmaka. —रुक्म-पाश, अस्, m., Ved. a string on which golden ornaments are worn. —रुक्म-पुर, अम्, n. ‘city of gold,’ N. of the city inhabited by Garuḍa. —रुक्म-पृष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, having a gold surface, coated or overlaid with gold, gold-plated, gilded. —रुक्म-प्रस्तरण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having an outer garment decorated with gold. —रुक्म-बाहु, उस्, m., N. of a son of Bhīṣmaka. —रुक्म-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made of gold, golden. —रुक्म-मालिन्, ई, m., N. of a son of Bhīṣmaka. —रुक्म-रथ, अस्, m. a golden car or chariot; the chariot of Rukma-ratha, i. e. of Droṇa; (अस्, आ, अम्), having a golden chariot; (अस्), m., N. of Droṇa; of a son of Śalya; of a son of Mahat; of a son of Bhīṣmaka. —रुक्म-वक्षस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. golden-breasted, having golden ornaments on the breast (said of the Maruts). —रुक्म-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing gold, golden, ornamented with gold; (आन्), m. a proper N., = रुक्मिन्; (अती), f. a parti-cular metre, four times ¯˘˘¯¯¯˘˘¯¯; N. of a granddaughter of Rukmin and wife of Aniruddha. —रुक्म-वाहन, अस्, आ, अम्, golden-carred, hav-ing a golden chariot; (अस्), m., N. of Droṇa. —रुक्म-स्तेय, अम्, n. stealing gold. —रुक्माङ्-गद (°म-अङ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, wearing a golden bracelet on the upper arm; (अस्), m., N. of various kings. —रुक्माभ (°म-आभ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, shining like gold, bright as the purest gold. —रुक्मेषु (°म-इषु), उस्, m. ‘golden-arrowed,’ N. of a king.
रुक्मत्: रुक्मत् रुक्-मत्, रुङ्-मत्। See under 2. रुच्, p. 848, col. 3.
रुक्ष: रुक्ष 1. रुक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, (for 2. see p. 848, col. 1), rough, harsh, &c. = रूक्ष, q. v.; [cf. Angl. Sax. rug, ruh, ruw; Eng. rough, rugged.]
2. रुक्ष, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see p. 847, col. 3), Ved. shining, brilliant, radiant, glittering, (Sāy. = दीप्त।)
रुक्सद्मन्: रुक्सद्मन् रुक्-सद्मन्, रुग्-अन्वित, &c. See under 2. रुज्, p. 848, col. 3.
रुग्ण: रुग्ण रुग्ण, रुग्न। See p. 848, col. 3.

रुग्ण, अस्, आ, अम् (sometimes incorrectly written रुग्न), broken, broken to pieces; thwarted, checked; bent, crooked, curved; injured; diseased, sick, in-firm. —रुग्ण-ता, f. or रुग्ण-त्व, अम्, n. broken-ness, crookedness; infirmity, sickness, disease. —रुग्-ण-रय, अस्, आ, अम्, checked in an onset, foiled in an attack.
रुच्: रुच् 1. रुच् (connected with rt. लोच्, q. v.), cl. 1. A. (sometimes P. on account of the metre), रोचते (-ति), रुरुचे, रोचिष्यते, अरुचत्, अरोचिष्ट, रोचितुम् (Ved. Inf. रुचे), to shine, be bright or resplendent (said of the sun, fire, stars, &c.); to make bright or resplendent (Ved. P.); to shine beautifully, appear beautiful, appear good; to please, be agreeable; to please any one (dat. or gen.); to be pleased, find pleasure in, approve, desire (some-times with acc. or dat.); Pass. रुच्यते, Aor. अरोचि, to be bright or radiant: Caus. रोचयति, -यते, -यितुम्, Aor. अरूरुचत्, to cause to shine; to enlighten, illu-minate, irradiate, make bright; to make pleasant or agreeable; to please (A.), be pleasant to any one (dat.); to cause to like; to cause any one (acc.) to long for anything (dat.); to cause to appear beautiful or good, to find pleasure in, like, approve, choose (A.); to resolve: Pass. of Caus. रोच्यते, to be agreeable: Desid. रुरुचिषते, रुरोचिषते; [cf. Gr. ἀμφι-λύκ-η, λύχ-νο-ς, λευκό-ς, λοῦσσο-ν:]; Lat. luc-eo, lux, lu-men, lucidu-s, lu-na, Leucesius, di-luc-ulu-m: Goth. liuh-ath, ‘light;’ lauhmoni, ‘light-ning;’ liuhtjan: Old Germ. lichan, luchjan, lochon: Angl. Sax. leoht, lioht, gelihtan, locian: Slav. luca, ‘a ray;’ luna, ‘the moon:’ Lith. lauka-s, lauki-s.]

2. रुच्, क्, f. light, lustre, brightness; lightning; splendor, beauty, loveliness; colour; appearance, (sometimes at the end of a comp., e. g. जनाः, सुर-रुचः, god-like men); pleasure, delight, liking, wish, desire; [cf. Lat. lux.] —रुक्-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. desiring splendor, eager for lustre. —रुक्-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. possessed of brightness, shin-ing; (आन्), m., N. of Agni. —रुङ्-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. containing the word रुच्।
रुक्मि: रुक्मि, इस्, m. a proper N. (= रुक्मिन्; in one or two passages रुक्मिम् is used for रुक्मिणम् on account of the metre).
रुक्मिन्: रुक्मिन्, ई, इणी, इ, wearing golden ornaments, decorated with golden ornaments (Ved.), gilded, gilt; (ई), m., N. of the eldest son of Bhīṣmaka and adversary of Kṛṣṇa (who carried off his sister Rukmiṇī; he was slain by Bala-deva); N. of a mountain; (इणी), f., N. of a daughter of Bhīṣmaka carried off and espoused by Kṛṣṇa, (she is repre-sented as the mother of Pra-dyumna, and in the later mythology = ) the goddess Lakṣmī; N. of Dākṣāyaṇī in Dvāravatī; of a daughter of Śreṣ-thin Sulocana. —रुक्मि-दर्प, अस्, m., N. of Bala-deva (so called as proud of having overcome Rukmin). —रुक्मि-दारिन्, ई, or रुक्मि-दारण, अस्, or रुक्मि-भिद्, त्, m. ‘destroyer of Rukmin,’ N. of Bala-deva.
रुच: रुच, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. bright, radiant, brilliant; (आ), f. light, lustre, beauty; pleasure, delight, desire, liking; the note of the parrot or Maina.
रुचक: रुचक, अस्, आ, अम्, agreeable, pleasing; sharp, acrid; tonic, stomachic; (अस्), m. epithet of a kind of four-sided column; epithet of one of the five great personages born under particular constellations; the citron, Citrus Medica; a pigeon; N. of a moun-tain; of a son of Uśanas; (अम्), n. one of the five kinds of bone in the human body (that of the teeth), a tooth, (said to be also अस्, m.); a kind of golden ornament, an ornament for the neck, a ring, an ornament for a horse, (according to some अस्, m.); a curl on a horse's neck; any object or substance sup-posed to bring good luck, (also अस्, m.); epithet of a sort of building or temple having terraces on three sides and closed only on the north side; a stomachic, tonic; (according to native authorities also) Ricinus Communis; a garland, wreath, crown; sochal salt; natron, alkali; the perfume Rocanā; an anthel-minthic medicine commonly called Viḍaṅga; = प्रोत्-कट; = उत्कट; = स्वाद्यरस (?).
रुचि: रुचि, इस्, f. light, lustre, brightness, splendor, beauty; a ray of light; colour; appearance; liking, taste, re-lish, zest, appetite, hunger; wish, desire, pleasure, (रुच्या, with pleasure, willingly); passion; inclina-tion, taste for, liking for, (at the end of comps. in the sense ‘having a taste or liking for,’ cf. मांस-र्°, हिंसा-र्°); intent application to any object; (in erotic works) epithet of a particular kind of lover's embrace; a kind of yellow pigment (= गो-रोचना); N. of an Apsaras; of the wife of Deva-śarman; (इस्), m., N. of a Prajā-pati, the husband of Ākūti and father of Yajña or Su-yajña and of Manu Raucya; of a son of Viśvā-mitra; of a king; (इस्, इस्, इ), pleasing, pleasant, agreeable (= रुचिर). —रुचि-कर, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, causing pleasure, entertaining, diverting, amusing, exciting desire; causing an appe-tite or relish, tasteful, savoury, sapid, appetizing, stomachic; (अस्), m., N. of a son of Keśava. —रुचि-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, causing a relish, relishing. —रुचि-ता, f. or रुचि-त्व, अम्, n. the having a taste or liking for, taking pleasure in (at the end of comps., cf. स-मान-रुचि-ता, हिंसा-रुचि-त्व); desire, interest, (आरम्भ-रुचि-ता, engaging in enterprises from mere liking or from interested motives, having a taste for new enterprises.) —रुचि-दत्त, अस्, m., N. of a commentator on the Tattva-cintā-maṇi-prakāśa. —रुचि-देव, अस्, m. a proper N. —रुचि-धामन्, आ, आ, अ, having light for an abode; (अ), n. the abode of light (epithet of the sun). —रुचि-नाथ, अस्, m., N. of an author. —रुचि-पति, इस्, m., N. of a commentator on the Anarghya-rāghava. —रुचि-पर्वन्, आ, m. a proper N. —रुचि-प्रद, अस्, आ, अम्, giving an appetite, appetizing. —रुचि-प्रभ, अस्, m., N. of a Daitya. —रुचि-फल, अम्, n. a kind of fruit (= अमृताह्व). —रुचि-भर्तृ, ता, m. ‘lord or bearer of light,’ the sun; ‘lord or cherisher of pleasure,’ a husband. —रुचि-रुचि in रुचि-रुचे रोचनम्, N. of a Sāman. —रुचि-वह, अस्, आ, अम्, bringing light. —रुचि-सम्प्रकॢप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, prepared with good taste.
रुचित: रुचित, अस्, आ, अम्, brightened, bright, shining; pleased; sweet, delicate, dainty; sharpened (said of the appetite); digested. —रुचित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. containing the meaning of रुचित or of rt. 1. रुच्।
रुचित; add — (अम्), n. an exclamation used at a Śrāddha.
रुचित्वा: रुचित्वा or रोचित्वा, having shone, &c. (Pāṇ. I. 2,26).
रुचिर: रुचिर, अस्, आ, अम्, bright, brilliant, radiant, light, shining, glittering, beautiful; pleasing, agreeable, charm-ing, pleasant; sweet, dainty, nice; stomachic, cordial, restorative; (अस्), m., N. of a son of Sena-jit; (आ), f. a kind of yellow pigment (= गो-रोचना); N. of a metre, four times thirty instants; of another, four times ˘¯˘¯, ˘˘˘˘¯˘¯˘¯; N. of a river; (अम्), n. saffron; a radish; cloves. —रुचिर-केतु, उस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva. —रुचिर-दन्तौष्-ठ (°त-ओष्°), अस्, ई, अम्, having beautiful teeth and lips. —रुचिर-देव, अस्, m., N. of a king. —रुचिर-धी, ईस्, m., N. of a king. —रुचिर-प्रभास-सम्भव, अस्, m., N. of a serpent-demon. —रुचिर-वदन, अस्, आ, अम्, having a pleasing or beautiful countenance. —रुचिर-वाच्, क्, क्, क्, having pleasant speech, eloquent. —रुचिर-श्री-गर्भ, अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva. —रुचिराञ्-जन (°र-अञ्°), अस्, m. = शोभाञ्जन, Hyperanthera Moringa. —रुचिरानन (°र-आन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, handsome-faced, beautiful. —रुचिरापाङ्गी (°र-अप्°), f. ‘having beautiful corners of the eyes,’ a woman with beautiful eyes. —रुचिराश्व (°र-अश्°), अस्, m., N. of a son of Sena-jit. —रुचिरा-सुत, अस्, m. a metronymic of Pālakāpya.
रुचिष्य: रुचिष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, pleasing, pleasant, agree-able, liked; giving an appetite, tonic, stomachic; dainty, nice.
रुच्य: रुच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, bright, radiant, beautiful, handsome, pleasing, agreeable, delightful; palatable, delicious, giving an appetite, stomachic, tonic; (अस्), m. a lover, husband; N. of various plants, Strychnos Potatorum; rice; Ægle Marmelos; (अम्), n. a digestive, tonic; = सौवर्चल. —रुच्य-कन्द, अस्, m. Arum Campanulatum.
रुज्: रुज् 1. रुज्, cl. 6. P. रुजति (rarely A. -ते), रुरोज, रोक्ष्यति, अरौक्षीत् (in Vāja-saneyi-s. XVI. 47. मा रोक् = भङ्गम् मा कार्षीः), रोक्तुम्, to break, break open, break to pieces, break down, destroy; to bend; to pain, cause pain, afflict with disease, disorder, injure: Pass. रुज्यते, to be broken, &c.: Caus. रोजयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अरूरु-जत्, to cause to break, to injure, hurt, kill: Desid. रुरुक्षति: Intens. रोरुज्यते, रोरोक्ति; [cf. Gr. λυγ-ρό-ς, λευγαλέο-ς, λοιγό-ς, λοίγιο-ς, perhaps ὀ-ρύσσω, ὄ-ρυγμα, ὀ-ρυκτή, ὀ-ρυχή; Lat. lug-e-o, lug-u-bri-s, luc-tu-s, lu-e-s; Lith. luz-ti, ‘to break.’]

2. रुज्, क्, क्, क्, breaking, breaking or dashing to pieces; (क्), f. fracture; pain, sickness, illness, disease, (अक्षि-रुज्, a disease of the eye); toil, fatigue, weariness, effort, trouble. —रुक्-प्रतिक्रिया, f. counteraction of disease, treatment of sickness, prac-tice of medicine, curing, remedying. —रुक्-सद्मन्, अ, n. ‘seat of pain,’ excrement, feces. —रुग्-अन्-वित, अस्, आ, अम्, attended with pain, painful. —रुग्-दाह, अस्, m. a kind of fever. —रुग्-भय, अम्, n. fear of disease. —रुग्-भेषज, अम्, n., Ved. ‘disease-medicine,’ any medicine or drug. —रुग्-विनिश्चय, अस्, m. ‘determination of disease,’ N. of a work by Mādhava (treating of the causes and diagnosis of eighty kinds of disease). —रुजस्-कर, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (रुजस्, acc. pl. + कर), causing or producing pain.
रुज: रुज, अस्, आ, अम्, breaking, breaking to pieces, destroying (at the end of comps., cf. वलं-र्°); (अस्), m. a word of doubtful meaning in Atharva-veda XVI. 3, 2; (आ), f. breaking, fracture, rupture, destruction, overthrow; pain, sickness, disease, illness, disorder; Costus Speciosus or Arabicus (= कुष्ठ); an ewe. —रुजा-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, causing pain, making sick or ill, sickening; (अस्), m. sickness, disease; sickness induced by passion or love (said to be one of the Bhāvas or sentiments); (अम्), n. the acid fruit of Averrhoa Carambola. —रुजापह (°जा-अप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, keeping off pain, removing sickness or dis-ease. —रुजा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having pain or disease, painful, diseased. —रुजा-विन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. painful. —रुजा-सह, अस्, m. a species of fruit tree.
रुजाय: रुजाय, Nom. A. रुजायते, &c., to be sick or ill.
रुरुक्षणि: रुरुक्षणि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. the Desid.), Ved. wish-ing or able to destroy.
रुट्: रुट् रुट्, cl. 1. A. रोटते, &c., to strike against, resist, oppose; to suffer pain; to shine; cl. 10. P. रोटयति, &c., to be angry [cf. rt. 1. रुष्]; to shine; to speak.
रुठ्: रुठ् रुठ्, cl. 1. P. रोठति, &c., to strike, strike down, fell; cl. 1.A. रोठते, &c., to strike against, resist, oppose; to torment, pain; to suffer pain; [cf. rt. रुट्।]
रोठमान: रोठमान, अस्, आ, अम्, paining; suffering pain.
रुणस्करा: रुणस्करा रुणस्करा, f. a cow easily milked, a gentle cow.
रुणा: रुणा रुणा, f., N. of a river flowing into the Sarasvatī.
रुण्ट्: रुण्ट् रुण्ट्, cl. 1. P. रुण्टति, &c., to steal, rob.
रुण्ठ्: रुण्ठ् रुण्ठ् (= rt. लुण्ठ्), cl. 1. P. रुण्-ठति, &c., to go; to be lame; to be idle; to strike against, resist; to steal, (in this sense a various reading for rt. रुण्ट्।)
रुण्ड्: रुण्ड् रुण्ड्, cl. 1. P. रुण्डति, &c. = rt. रुण्ट्, p. 848, col. 3.
रुण्ड: रुण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, maimed, mutilated; (अस्), m. according to some also (अम्), n. a headless body, mere trunk (retaining life and continuing to mix in battle).
रुण्डिका: रुण्डिका, f. a field of battle; a female messenger or go-between; the threshold of a door; superhuman power (= वि-भूति).
रुथ: रुथ रुथ, अस्, m. a proper N.
रुद्: रुद् 1. रुद् [cf. rt. 1. रु], cl. 2. P. रोदिति (Ved. also cl. 6. रुदति, ep. also A. रुदते), Impf. अरोदीत् or अरोदत् (Pāṇ. VII. 3, 98, 99; 1st sing. अरोदम्, 3rd pl. अरुदन्), Impv. रोदितु (2nd sing. रुदिहि), Perf. रुरोद (ep. रुरुदे), 2nd Fut. रोदिष्यति (Ved. रोत्स्यति), Aor. अरोदीत् (3rd pl. अरोदिषुस्) or अरुदत्, रोदितुम्, to weep, cry, shed tears, wail, lament; to bewail, deplore; to roar, howl: Pass. रुद्यते, Aor. अरोदि: Caus. रोदयति, -यि-तुम्, Aor. अरूरुदत्, to cause to weep or lament: Desid. रुरुदिषति: Intens. रोरुद्यते, रोरोत्ति, to weep very much; [cf. perhaps Gr. ὀῤῥωδέω; Lat. rud-o; Old Germ. riuzan; Angl. Sax. reotan; Lith. raudoju; Slav. rudajun.]
2. रुद्, त्, त्, त्, weeping, crying, lamenting [cf. अघ-र्°]; (त्), f. cry, wail, lamentation; sound, noise; grief; pain, affliction; disease.
रुदत्: रुदत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, weeping, crying, wailing, bewailing; (अन्ती), f. a species of small shrub (= रुदन्तिका).
रुदथ: रुदथ, अस्, m. a child, a pupil, scholar; a dog; a cock.
रुदन: रुदन, अम्, n. the act of crying, weeping, lamentation.
रुदन्तिका: रुदन्तिका, f. ‘the weeper,’ epithet of a species of small succulent shrub (= अमृत-स्रवा).
रुदमान: रुदमान, अस्, आ, अम्, weeping, wailing, lament-ing.
रुदित: रुदित, अस्, आ, अम्, wept, lamented, deplored; weeping, crying, lamenting; wet with tears; (अम्), n. a weeping, wailing, crying, lamentation.
रुदित्वा: रुदित्वा, ind. having wept, having lamented.
रुद्यमान: रुद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being bewailed.
रुद्र: रुद्र, अस्, आ, अम् (according to Uṇādi-s. II. 22. fr. rt. 1. रुद् above; according to others fr. rt. 1. रु + द्र fr. rt. 2. द्रु, to run; connected with रोदस्, q. v., and perhaps with रुधिर), crying, howling, roaring, one who cries or roars, dreadful, horrible, terrific, awful; great, large; (according to the fanciful etymologies of native writers, the following meanings are also assigned to this word), driving away evil; running about and roaring; praiseworthy, to be praised, (according to Naigh. III. 16) = स्तोतृ, a praiser, panegyrist, worshipper; (अस्), m. ‘the Roarer’ or ‘Howler,’ N. of the god of tempests and father of the Rudras or Maruts, (originally perhaps the mere personified roaring of the storms, but as the crackling or raging of fire may resemble the sound of wind, so in the Veda the god of storms is some-times identified with the god of fire; though gene-rally represented as a destroying deity whose terrible shafts bring death or disease on men and cattle, he is also addressed as benevolent and auspicious [शिव], and is even supposed to have a healing efficacy from his chasing away vapours and purifying the atmo-sphere; hence he has various epithets in the Veda, such as ‘multiform,’ ‘terrible as a wild beast,’ ‘tawny-coloured,’ ‘wearing braided hair’ [कपर्दिन्], ‘ce-lestial boar,’ ‘armed with a strong bow and fleet arrows,’ ‘cause of prosperity to man and beast,’ ‘pos-sessor of healing remedies,’ ‘greatest of physicians,’ &c.; he is of course ruler of the Rudras, who are the same as the storm winds, more usually called Maruts, and who are often associated with Indra [see मरुत्]: in the later mythology the epithet शिव, ‘propitious,’ which does not occur as a name in the Veda, was employed as the real name of the destroy-ing deity, being at first applied as an euphemism to propitiate him: moreover the character of the deity lost its special connection with storms, and developed into a personification of the destroying principle generally, though even the Epic and Purānic Śiva was regarded as the generator as well as destroyer: moreover a new class of beings, described as eleven in number, though still called Rudras, took the place of the original Rudras or Maruts: in the Veda only three groupings of deities into classes appear to be recognised, Indra belonging to the Vasus, Varuṇa to the Ādityas, and Rudra to the Rudras or Maruts; but in Manu XI. 221. the Maruts are enumerated as a fourth group, being there distinguished from the eleven Rudras: in Viṣṇu-Purāṇa I. 7. Rudra is said to have sprung from Brahmā's forehead, and to have afterwards separated himself into a figure half male and half female, the former portion sepa-rating again into the eleven Rudras, who were so called because they ‘ran about crying aloud’ [रुद-नाद् द्रावणाच्-च, cf. rts. 1. रुद्, 2. द्रु]; hence these later Rudras are sometimes regarded as inferior manifestations of Śiva, and most of their names are also names of Śiva; these names are variously given in the different Purāṇas; those of the Vāyu are Ajaikapād, Ahvi-bradhna, Hara, Nir-ṛta, Īśvara, Bhuvana, Aṅgāraka, Ardha-ketu, Mṛtyu, Sarpa, Kapālin: according to other accounts the Rudras are represented as children of Kaśyapa and Surabhī or of Brahmā and Surabhī or of Bhūta and Su-rūpā); a form or manifestation or N. of Śiva (in the later mythology, as explained above; according to the Viṣṇu-Purāṇa I. 8. Rudra is one of the eight forms of Śiva; he is elsewhere reckoned among the Dik-pālas as regent of the north-east quarter); a symbo-lical expression for the number eleven (from the eleven Rudras, see above); a mystical epithet of the letter ए; Calotropis Gigantea; N. of various persons; of a lexicographer; of a poet; of a king; (आस्), m. pl. the Rudras (described above); an abbreviated expression for the texts or hymns ad-dressed to the Rudras [cf. रुद्र-जप]; (आ), f., N. of a wife of Vasu-deva; of a daughter of Rau-drāśva; = रुद्र-जटा; (ई), f. a kind of lute or guitar; [cf. रुद्र-वीणा; cf. perhaps also Gr. λύρα.] —रुद्र-कलश, अम्, n. ‘Rudra's vessel,’ a parti-cular kind of pot or vessel used in making oblations to the planets. —रुद्र-कवीन्द्र (°वि-इन्°), अस्, m. a proper N. (= रुद्र-भट्ट). —रुद्र-काली, f. a form of Durgā. —रुद्र-कोटि, इस्, f., N. of a place of pilgrimage. —रुद्र-कोष, अस्, m., N. of a lexicon by Rudra. —रुद्र-गण, अस्, m., Ved. ‘Rudra-class,’ the troop of beings called Rudras, (see under रुद्र।) —रुद्र-गर्भ, अस्, m. ‘Ru-dra's offspring,’ N. of Agni. —रुद्र-गीत, अम्, आ, n. f. the song of Rudra (in which Agastya repeats a dialogue between himself and Rudra). —रुद्र-चण्डिक, epithet of a particular text or formula. —रुद्र-चण्डी, f. a form of Durgā; N. of a section in the Rudra-yāmala. —रुद्र-चन्द्र, अस्, m., N. of a king. —रुद्र-च्छत्त्र, अस्, m. a proper N. —रुद्र-ज, अस्, m. (according to some) अम्, n. ‘produced from Rudra or Śiva,’ quicksilver (supposed to be the semen of Śiva). —रुद्र-जटा, f. ‘Rudra's hair,’ N. of a species of creeper. —रु-द्र-जप, अस्, m., N. of a particular prayer or hymn addressed to Rudra. —रुद्र-जपन, अम्, n. the recitation of the Rudra-japa in a low tone. —रुद्र-जापक, अस्, इका, अम्, or रुद्र-जापिन्, ई, इनी, इ, one who recites the Rudra-japa in a low tone. —रुद्र-जाप्य, अम्, n., N. of a particular hymn or prayer extracted from the Vājasaneyi-saṃ-hitā and addressed to Rudra. —रुद्र-तनय, अस्, m. ‘Rudra's son,’ N. of the third black Vāsudeva; of Punishment; epithet of a sword. —रुद्र-त्व, अम्, n. the being Rudra. —रुद्र-दत्त, अस्, m., N. of an author; of a work on medicine. —रुद्र-दामन्, आ, m., N. of a king. —रुद्र-देव, अस्, m., N. of various persons; of the author of the Yayāti-carita; of the author of a commentary on the Prabodha-candrodaya. —रुद्र-धर, अस्, m., N. of an author. —रुद्र-न्याय-वाचस्पति-भट्-टाचार्य (°त-आच्°), अस्, m., N. of an author (= रुद्र-भट्टाचार्य). —रुद्र-पण्डित, अस्, m., N. of an author (= रुद्र-सूरि). —रुद्र-पत्नी, f. Rudra's wife, the goddess Durgā; linseed, Linum Usitatissimum. —रुद्र-पद्धति, इस्, f., N. of a work by Paraśu-rāma. —रुद्र-पाल, अस्, m. a proper N. —रुद्र-पुत्र, अस्, m. Rudra's son, a patronymic of the twelfth Manu; [cf. रुद्र-सा-वर्णि।] —रुद्र-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a province. —रुद्र-पूजन, अम्, n. or रुद्र-पूजा, f. ‘wor-ship of Rudra,’ N. of a work. —रुद्र-प्रताप, अस्, m., N. of a king (= प्रताप-रुद्र). —रुद्र-प्रयाग, अस्, m., N. of the sacred place where the river Mandākinī joins the Ganges. —रुद्र-प्रिया, f. ‘dear to Rudra,’ epithet of Terminalia Chebula; the goddess Pārvatī. —रुद्र-बलि, इस्, m. an oblation of meat &c. presented to the Rudras. —रुद्र-भट्ट, अस्, m., N. of the author of the Śṛṅgāra-tilaka (= रुद्रट); of the author of a commentary on the Vaidya-jīvana; = रुद्र-कवीन्द्र. —रुद्र-भट्टाचार्य (°ट-आच्°), अस्, m., N. of an author and commentator. —रुद्र-भाष्य, अम्, n., N. of a work by Ahobala. —रुद्र-भू, ऊस्, or रुद्र-भूमि, इस्, f. ‘Rudra's ground,’ a cemetery. —रुद्र-भूति, इस्, m., N. of a preceptor (having the patro-nymic Drāhyāyaṇi). —रुद्र-भैरवी, f. a form of Durgā. —रुद्र-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of Rudra, having the essence of Rudra. —रुद्र-महा-देवी, f., N. of the wife of king Govinda-canda. —रुद्र-यज्ञ, अस्, m. an oblation or sacri-fice offered to Rudra. —रुद्र-यामल, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra work in the form of a dialogue between Bhairava and Bhairavī. —रुद्र-राय, अस्, m., N. of a king. —रुद्र-राशि, इस्, m. a proper N. —रुद्र-रोदन, अम्, n. ‘Rudra's tears,’ i. e. gold. —रुद्र-रोमन्, आ, f., N. of one of the Mātṛs attending upon Skanda. —रुद्र-लटा, f. = रुद्र-जटा. —रुद्र-लोक, अस्, m. Rudra's world. —रु-द्र-वट, N. of a Tīrtha. —रुद्र-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having Rudra or the Rudras. —रुद्रवद्-गण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. surrounded by the Rudra troop. —रुद्र-वर्तनि, ई, m. du. ‘proceeding on terrible roads,’ N. of the Aśvins, (Sāy. = रोदन-शील-मार्गौ or स्तूयमान-मार्गौ।) —रुद्र-विंशति, इस्, f. epithet of the last twenty years in the Jupiter cycle of sixty years. —रुद्र-विधान, अम्, n., N. of a work. —रुद्र-वीणा, f. epithet of a particular religious observance. —रुद्र-शर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a Brāhman. —रुद्र-सम्प्रदायिन्, इनस्, m. pl., N. of a sect. —रुद्र-सरस्, अस्, n., N. of a lake. —रुद्र-सर्ग, अस्, m. Rudra's creation; the creation of the eleven Rudras. —रुद्र-सामन्, अ, n., N. of a particular Sāman. —रुद्र-सावर्णि, इस्, m., N. of the twelfth Manu; [cf. रुद्र-पुत्र, मनु।] —रुद्रसावर्णिक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to Rudra-sāvarṇi, being under Rudra-sāvarṇi. —रुद्र-सिंह, अस्, m. a proper N. —रु-द्र-सुन्दरी, f., N. of a goddess. —रुद्र-सू, ऊस्, f. a mother of eleven children. —रुद्र-सूक्त, अम्, n., N. of a particular hymn. —रुद्र-सूरि, इस्, m., N. of an author. —रुद्र-सृष्टि, इस्, f. Rudra's creation; the creation of the eleven Rudras; [cf. रुद्र-सर्ग।] —रुद्र-सेन, अस्, m., N. of a warrior. —रुद्र-सोम, अस्, m., N. of a Brāhman. —रुद्र-स्कन्द, अस्, m., N. of a commentator. —रुद्र-स्वर्ग, अस्, m. Rudra's heaven. —रुद्र-स्वामिन्, ई, m. a proper N. —रुद्र-हिमालय, अस्, m., N. of a peak of the Himālaya mountains. —रुद्र-हूति, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. (according to Mahī-dhara on Vājasaneyi-s. XXXVIII. 16) being invoked by praisers or worshippers. —रुद्र-हृदय, अम्, n., N. of an Upaniṣad. —रुद्राक्रीड (°र-आक्°), अस्, m. ‘Rudra's play-ground,’ a cemetery, place where dead bodies are burnt or buried (Rudra being supposed to dance and sport in such places at evening twilight). —रुद्राक्ष (°र-अक्°), अस्, m. ‘Rudra-eyed,’ a kind of tree, Elæocarpus Ganitrus; (अम्), n. the berry of this tree (used for rosaries); a rosary; N. of an Upaniṣad, (the gender here and in the preced-ing sense is doubtful.) —रुद्राक्ष-माला, f. a rosary made of Rudrākṣa berries. —रुद्राचार्य (°र-आच्°), अस्, m. a proper N. —रुद्राध्याय (°र-अध्°), अस्, m. epithet of particular prayers addressed to Rudra. —रुद्राध्यायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, one who recites or repeats the above prayers. —रुद्रायण (°र-अय्°), अस्, m., N. of a king of Roruka. —रुद्रारि (°र-अरि), इस्, m. Rudra's enemy; N. of Kāma-deva; (इस्, इस्, इ), having Rudra for an enemy, hostile to Rudra. —रुद्रावर्त (°र-आव्°), N. of a place of pilgrimage. —रुद्रावसृष्ट (°र-अव्°), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. let go or hurled by Rudra. —रुद्रावास (°र-आव्°), अस्, m. Rudra's abode, i. e. Kāśi or Be-nares. —रुद्रैकादशिनी (°र-एक्°), f. the eleven Rudra hymns. —रुद्रोपनिषद् (°र-उप्°), त्, f., N. of two Upaniṣads. —रुद्रोपस्थ (°र-उप्°), अस्, m. ‘Rudra's generative organ,’ N. of a mountain.
रुद्रक: रुद्रक, अस्, m. a proper N.
रुद्रट: रुद्रट, अस्, m. an abbreviated form of Rudra-bhaṭṭa.
रुद्राणी: रुद्राणी, f. Rudra's wife, the goddess Durgā; epithet of a girl eleven years of age, in whom men-struation has not yet commenced, representing the goddess Durgā at the Durgā festival.
रुद्रिय: रुद्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging or relating to Rudra [cf. शत-रुद्रिय], coming from Rudra; relating to the Rudras, coming from them, &c.; terrific, fearful, awful, impetuous; (according to Sāy. also) uttering praise or giving pleasure; (आस्), m. pl. the Maruts; (अम्), n. Rudra's majesty or power; (Sāy.) pleasure, delight (= सुख).
रुरुदिषु: रुरुदिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. the Desid.), wishing or intending to weep, inclined to cry.
रोद: रोद, अस्, m., Ved. weeping, wailing, lamenting, lamentation.
रोद रोद, रोदन, &c. See p. 850, col. 1.
रोदन: रोदन, अम्, n. the act of weeping or wailing, bewailing, lamentation; weeping, a tear, tears; (ई), f. Alhagi Maurorum.
रोदमान: रोदमान, अस्, आ, अम्, for रुदमान, q. v.
रोदस्: रोदस्, अस्, n. heaven, &c. See p. 855, col. 1.

रोदस् रोदस्, अस्, n. (fr. rt. 1. रुद्; in Ni-rukta VI. 1. रोदस् is connected with रोधस् as if fr. rt. 2. रुध्), the seat of the roaring winds, heaven; (असी), n. du. heaven and earth, the upper and lower world, (in Ṛg-veda IX. 22, 5. रोदसोः, gen. du. = द्यावा-पृथिव्योः।) —रोदः-कुहर, अम्, n. the canopy of heaven. —रोदस्-त्व, अम्, n., Ved. a word used in explaining the etymology of रोदसी।
रोदितव्य: रोदितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be bewailed or lamented.
रोरुदत्: रोरुदत्, अन्, अती, अत्, weeping or wailing bitterly.
रोरुदत्; the nom. case sing. masc. ought rather to be like that of the 3rd cl., in which case it must be रोरुदत्।
रोरुदा: रोरुदा, f. violent weeping, excessive lamentation. —रोरुदा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, full of excessive lamen-tation, weeping violently or intensely.
रोरुद्यमान: रोरुद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, weeping or crying bitterly.
रुद्ध: रुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, stopped, checked, impeded, restrained, obstructed, suppressed, opposed; held, withheld; kept, kept back; shut, closed, shut up, secured; invested, besieged, blockaded; shut in, enclosed, confined, surrounded, begirt, fenced in; covered, covered up; (अस्), m., N. of a town; (आ), f. a siege. —रुद्ध-गिर्, ईर्, ईर्, ईर्, having the utterance choked or impeded. —रुद्ध-प्रवाह, अस्, आ, अम्, having the stream obstructed. —रुद्ध-मूत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having the urine suppressed; suffering from retention of urine.
रुध्: रुध् 1. रुध् (= rt. 1. रुह्), cl. 1. P. रो-धति, &c., Ved. to sprout, shoot, grow, germinate; [cf. न्यग्-रोध, 2. अव-रोध।]

रुध् 2. रुध्, cl. 7. P. A. रुणद्धि, रुन्द्धे (ep. also रुन्धति, रुन्धते, रोधति, Impf. अरुन्धत्), रुरोध, रुरुधे, रोत्स्यति, -ते, अरुधत् or अरौत्सीत्, अरुद्ध (Ved. forms अरौत्, रुध्मस्, अरौत्सि), रोद्धुम् (ep. also रोधितुम्), to stop, check, arrest, restrain, hinder, impede, prevent, obstruct, suppress, oppose; to hold, withhold, retain, keep; to avert, keep off, keep back; to shut, close, lock, shut up, lock up, block up, close up, stop up, fill up; to besiege, blockade, lay siege to, invest; to shut in, enclose, surround, confine (with loc. of the place of confine-ment or with double acc. according to Vopa-deva V. 6); to bind; to cover, cover up, cover over, obscure; to oppress, torment, harass: Pass. रुध्यते, Aor. अरोधि: Caus. रोधयति, -ते (ep. also रुन्ध-यति), -यितुम्, Aor. अरूरुधत्, to cause to stop; to restrain, impede, obstruct; to cause to be con-fined; cause to be besieged; to fetter, enchain; to oppress, torment, harass: Desid. रुरुत्सति, -ते: Intens. रोरुध्यते, रोरोद्धि; [cf. perhaps Hib. rundha, ‘secret, mysterious;’ rundhachd, ‘secrecy;’ ruindiamhar, ‘a mystery;’ ruine, ‘secrecy:’ Goth. runa, ‘a mystery:’ Old Germ. runen, runazjan, which may be related to rt. 1. रु।]
3. रुध्, त्, त्, त्, stopping, restraining, impeding, holding; [cf. कर-र्°।]
रोध: 1. रोध, अस्, m. sprouting, growing, &c.; [cf. 2. अव-र्°, न्यग्-र्°।] —रोधावरोध (°ध-अव्°), probably ‘moving up and down.’

2. रोध, अस्, m. (for 1. रोध see col. 1), the act of stopping, checking, arresting, restraining, hindering, impeding, preventing, &c.; restraint, stoppage, obstruction, suppression, prevention, pro-hibition; shutting up, confining; closing, blocking up; siege, blockade (of a town); attacking, making war upon; a dam, bank, shore [cf. रोधस् below]; a proper N.; N. of a hell. —रोध-कृत्, त्, m. epi-thet of the forty-fifth year in the Jupiter cycle of sixty years. —रोध-चक्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
