रोध 2. रोध, रोधस्, रोधिन्, &c. See p. 850, col. 2.
रुद्धक: रुद्धक, अम्, n. citron, (perhaps for रुचक।)
रुद्ध्वा: रुद्ध्वा, ind. having stopped or checked, having restrained or obstructed.
रुध: रुध, अस्, आ, अम्, stopping, restraining, hinder-ing, repelling.
रुधिक्रा: रुधि-क्रा, m., Ved., N. of an Asura or demon conquered by Indra.
रुन्धत्: रुन्धत्, अन्, अती, अत्, stopping, hindering, op-posing, impeding; resisting, refusing.
रुरुत्सु: रुरुत्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to obstruct or oppose; wishing to bind or tie up (as the hair).
रोद्धव्य: रोद्धव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be closed or shut.
रोद्धव्य रोद्धव्य, रोद्धृ। See p. 850, col. 2.
रोद्धृ: रोद्धृ, धा, ध्री, धृ, one who stops or obstructs, one who shuts in, a besieger.
रोधक: रोधक, अस्, इका, अम्, stopping, checking, re-straining, confining, shutting up, besieging, block-ading.
रोधन: रोधन, अस्, ई, अम्, obstructing, impeding, being an obstacle or hindrance; (अस्), m. the planet Mer-cury; (आ), f. = रोधस्; (अम्), n. the act of stop-ping, checking, restraining, preventing, impeding, oppressing; the act of confining, confinement, re-straint; besieging, blockading.
रोधस्: रोधस्, अस्, n. a bank, embankment, dam, ob-struction; a mound, high bank, wall, a shore; the brink of a well; a flank, epithet of a woman's hips; [cf. तट।] —रोधः-पतन-कलुष, अस्, आ, अम्, (rendered) muddy by the falling in of a bank. —रो-धस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having high banks (said of rivers; Ved.); (अती), f., N. of a river. —रोधो-वक्रा, f. ‘winding along its banks,’ a river. —रोधो-वती, f. ‘having banks,’ a river. —रोधो-वप्र, अस्, m. a rapid river.
रोधिन्: रोधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, stopping, checking, restraining, hindering, preventing, prohibiting; shutting up, closing; destroying; a species of plant, (gender doubtful.)
रोध्य: रोध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be stopped or checked, to be restrained, &c.
रुधिर: रुधिर रुधिर, अस्, आ, अम् (according to Uṇādi-s. I. 52. fr. rt. 2. रुध्; according to some fr. a lost rt. रुध्; according to others connected with rts. 1. रुध् and 1. रुह्; cf. रोहित), red, blood-red, bloody (Ved.); (अस्), m. the blood-red planet, i. e. Mars; a kind of precious stone [cf. रु-धिराख्य]; (अम्), n. blood; saffron; N. of a town; [cf. शोणित-पुर: cf. also Gr. ἐρεύθ-ω, ἐρυθ-ρός, ἔρευθ-ος, ἐρυθρ-ιά-ω, ἐρυσίβη, ῥούσιος:] Lat. ruber, rufu-s, rutilu-s (for old ruthilus), rob-igo: Old Norse riod-r, ‘ruddy;’ rioda: Goth. ga-riud-jo: Old Germ. rot, rost: Angl. Sax. read, roder: Slav. rud-e-ti, ruzd-a: Lith. raud-a, rud-a-s, rūdi-s: Hib. ruadh, ruaid, ‘red, reddish;’ ruaidhim, ‘I redden.’] —रुधिर-ताम्राक्ष, अस्, ई, अम्, having blood-red eyes. —रुधिर-पायिन्, ई, m. ‘drinking blood,’ a Rākṣasa or demon. —रु-धिर-प्रदिग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, besmeared with blood. —रुधिर-प्लावित, अस्, आ, अम्, swimming with blood, soaked in blood. —रुधिर-रूषित, अस्, आ, अम्, covered with blood. —रुधिर-लेप, अस्, m. blood-stain, smear of blood. —रुधिर-विन्दु, उस्, m. a drop of blood. —रुधिराक्ष (°र-अक्°) = रुधि-राख्य below (according to some). —रुधिराख्य (°र-आख्°), अस्, अम्, m. n. ‘blood-named, red as blood,’ epithet of a particular precious stone. —रुधिराध्या-य (°र-अध्°), अस्, m., N. of a chapter of the Kālikā-Purāṇa treating of the sacrifice of animals. —रुधि-रानन (°र-आन्°), अम्, n. epithet of one of the five retrograding motions of Mars. —रुधिरान्ध (°र-अन्°), ‘whose waters are blood,’ N. of a hell. —रुधिरामय (°र-आम्°), अस्, m. ‘blood-disease,’ hemorrhage (= रक्त-पित्त). —रुधिराविल (°र-आव्°), अस्, आ, अम्, blood-stained, soiled with blood. —रुधिराशन (°र-अश्°), अस्, आ, अम्, feeding on blood (said of Rākṣasas &c.). —रुधिरोद्गारिन् (°र-उद्°), ई, इणी, इ, spitting blood, vomiting blood; (ई), m. epithet of the fifty-seventh year in the Jupiter cycle of sixty years.
रुप्: रुप् 1. रुप् (an older form of rt. 1. लुप्), cl. 4. P. रुप्यति, रुरोप, अरुपत्, &c., to suffer violent or racking pain (Ved.); to violate, confound, disturb: Caus. रोपयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अरूरुपत्, to cause acute pain; to break off; [cf. Lat. rumpo, rupi, &c.]
रुप् 2. रुप् (connected with rt. 1. रुह्), Ved. the earth.
रोप: रोप 1. रोप, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. रुप् = rt. 1. लुप्), confusing, disturbing; (अम्), n. a fissure, chasm, hole, cavity, (in this sense possibly connected with rt. 1. रुह्, cf. रुहक।)
रोप 2. रोप, अस्, m. (fr. the Caus. of rt. 1. रुह्), the act of raising or setting up, &c. (= 2. रोपण); the planting (of trees); an arrow.
रुभेटि: रुभेटि रुभेटि, इस्, f. fog, vapour.
रुम: रुम रुम, अस्, m. a proper N. (Ved.); (आ), f., N. of a salt-mine or salt-lake (in the district of Sambhar in Ajmere); of a wife of the ape Su-grīva. —रुमा-भव, अस्, आ, अम्, obtained from the Rumā salt-mines; [cf. रौमक।]
रुमण्वत्: रुमण्वत्, आन्, m. a proper N.; N. of a moun-tain (‘possessing salt’).
रुम्र: रुम्र रुम्र, अस्, आ, अम् (in Uṇādi-s. II. 14. said to be fr. rt. रम्) = अरुण, tawny; the dawn, &c.; = शोबन, bright, beautiful, &c.
रुरु: रुरु रुरु, उस्, m. (in Uṇādi-s. IV. 103. said to be fr. rt. 1. रु), a kind of deer; a species of rapacious animal, a dog; a species of fruit tree; N. of a son of the Ṛṣi Pramati by the Apsaras Ghṛ-tācī; of a divine being enumerated among the Viśve Devāḥ; of one of the seven Ṛṣis under Manu Sāvarṇi (his patronymic is Kāśyapa); of a Dānava or Daitya (said to have been slain by Durgā); of a form of Bhairava, (sometimes called रुरु-भैरव।) —रुरु-मुण्ड, अस्, m., N. of a mountain, (also read उरु-मुण्ड।) —रुरु-शीर्षन्, आ, -ष्णी, अ, Ved. ‘deer-headed,’ having a deer's horn or having a destructive point (said of an arrow; Sāy. = शृङ्ग-शीर्षन् or हन्तृ-शिरस्क).
रुरुक: रुरुक, अस्, m., N. of a king.
रुवु: रुवु रुवु, उस्, m. [cf. उरुवु], the castor-oil tree, Ricinus Communis (= रक्तैरण्ड).
रुवुक: रुवुक or रुवूक, अस्, m. Ricinus Communis; [cf. उरुवुक, रूवुक, &c.]
रुश्: रुश् रुश् (connected with and in some forms and meanings identified with rt. 1. रुष्), cl. 6. P. रुशति, रुरोश, रोक्ष्यति, अरुक्षत्, रोष्टुम्, to hurt, injure, kill; to vex, displease, annoy: Caus. रोशयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अरूरुशत्: Desid. रुरुक्षति: Intens. रोरुश्यते, रोरोष्टि।
रुशत्: 1. रुशत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, hurting, injuring, vexing, displeasing; cursing, imprecating.

रुशत् 2. रुशत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत् (probably to be regarded as a participle connected with rt. 1. रुच्), Ved. brilliant, bright, light-coloured, white; [cf. Gr. λευκός] —रुशत्-पशु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. having white cattle; (Sāy.) having brilliant rays or blazing with the oblation (= रुशद्-रश्मि or प्रकाशित-हविस्). —रुशद्-ऊर्मि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. having glis-tening waves, having bright flames (said of Fire; Sāy. = दीप्त-ज्वाल). —रुशद्-गु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. having white or bright cattle; bright-rayed, (Sāy. = रोचमान-रश्मि); (उस्), m. a proper N. —रु-शद्-रथ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having a light-coloured carriage; (अस्), m. a proper N. —रुशद्-वत्स, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having a bright or white calf or offspring, (the Dawn is so called as parent of the Sun.)
रुशङ्गु: रुशङ्गु रुशङ्गु, उस्, m., N. of a Ṛṣi.
रुशना: रुशना रुशना, f., N. of one of the wives of Rudra.
रुशम: रुशम रुशम, अस्, m. a proper N.; (आ), f. a proper N., (Ruśamā is said to have contended with Indra as to which of the two would run fastest round the earth, and to have won by the artifice of only going round Kurukṣetra.)
रुशेकु: रुशेकु रुशेकु, उस्, m., N. of a king.
रुष्: रुष् 1. रुष् (connected with and in some forms and meanings identified with rt. रुश्; allied also to रुक्ष् in 1. रुक्ष), cl. 1. P. रोषति, रुरोष, रोषिष्यति, अरोषीत् or अरुषत्, रोषितुम् or रोष्टुम्, to hurt, injure, kill; to vex, annoy, displease, make angry, disgust; to take ill, be offended (Ved.); cl. 4. रुष्यति, to be vexed or annoyed; to be offended; to be cross or angry; to injure, &c.: cl. 10. or Caus. रोषयति, -यि-तुम्, Aor. अरूरुषत्, to vex, annoy, displease, irritate; to enrage, exasperate: Desid. रुरुषिषति, रुरोषि-षति: Intens. रोरुष्यते, रोरोष्टि; [cf. probably Gr. λύσσα, λυσσάω, λυσσαίνω, (perhaps also) ἀλυσταίνω, ἀλυκταίνω, ἀλαλὐκτημαι; Goth. in-rauht-jan.]
2. रुष्, ट्, f. anger, wrath, rage, fury, passion.
रुषङ्गु: रुषङ्गु, उस्, m., N. of a Brāhman.
रुषत्: रुषत्, अन्, अन्ती or अती (as if fr. rt. रुश्), अत्, hurting, injuring, vexing, displeasing. —रुषद्-गु, उस्, m., N. of a king.
रुषा: रुषा, f. = 2. रुष्, anger, wrath, rage, fury. —रुषान्वित (°षा-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, filled with anger, full of wrath.
रुषित: रुषित, अस्, आ, अम्, injured; enraged, irritated, &c., = रुष्ट below.
रुष्ट: रुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, enraged, irritated, offended, angry, furious; (अस्), m., N. of a Muni.
रुष्टि: रुष्टि, इस्, f. anger, wrath, rage, fury, passion. —रुष्टि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, angry, &c.
रुष्य: 1. रुष्य, रुष्य-मत्, see Gaṇa Madhvādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 86.
2. रुष्य, ind. having irritated or enraged, &c. (Rāmāyaṇa II. 98, 12).
रुष्यत्: रुष्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, being angry or offended.
रोष्: रोष्, ट्, m. one who hurts or injures, an injurer; one who irritates or enrages.
रोष् रोष्, रोष, &c. See p. 851, col. 1.
रोष: रोष, अस्, m. anger, rage, wrath, passion, fury. —रोष-ताम्राक्ष, अस्, ई, अम्, having eyes red with anger. —रोष-परीत, अस्, आ, अम्, filled with wrath. —रोष-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of anger, proceeding from fury. —रोष-वाहण, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘being a vehicle of anger,’ bearing or feeling wrath (= आरूढ-क्रोध). —रोषाक्षेप (°ष-आक्°), अस्, m. (in rhetoric) angry expression of dissent, angry reproach, ironical taunt. —रोषावरोह (°ष-अव्°), अस्, m., N. of a warrior on the side of the gods in the war against the Asuras.
रोषण: रोषण, अस्, ई, अम्, angry, wrathful, passionate, easily enraged; enraged at or against, (क्षत्रिय-रोषण, exasperated at the Kṣatriyas); (अस्), m. a touch-stone; quicksilver; an arid or desert soil con-taining salt; Grewia Asiatica. —रोषण-ता, f. the state of being easily enraged, proneness to anger, irritability, wrath.
रोषित: रोषित, अस्, आ, अम्, enraged, exasperated, irritated.
रोषिन्: रोषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, angry, wrathful, irritable, furious.
रोष्टृ: रोष्टृ, टा, टॄ, an injurer; one who is vexed or angry, wrathful.
रुह्: रुह् 1. रुह् (originally written रुध्; cf. rt. 1. रुध्), cl. 1. P. रोहति (ep. also A. रोहते), रुरोह, रोक्ष्यति, अरुक्षत् (Ved. and ep. अरुहत्), रोढुम् (ep. रोहितुम्, Ved. रोहिष्यै, Pāṇ. III. 4, 10), to rise, mount upwards, ascend, climb; to spring up, shoot forth, sprout, germinate, to be produced or born; to grow, grow up, be developed or formed, grow larger, increase, increase in size; to grow together, grow over, cicatrize, heal; to reach to, attain: Caus. रोहयति or (in the later language) रोपयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अरूरुहत् or अरूरुपत्, to cause to ascend, raise up, elevate; to place in or on, fix, fasten; to deliver over, com-mit, entrust; to plant, sow, put in the ground; to cause to grow, cause to grow over or heal: Desid. रुरुक्षति: Intens. रोरुह्यते, रोरोढि; [cf. per-haps Gr. λαό-ς, βασι-λεύ-ς: perhaps Lat. rus, rur-is: Goth. liugan, jugga-lauths; liudith, ‘it grows;’ lauths, ‘a man’ (gen. laudi-s): Old Germ. liut, ‘a people;’ liuti (= Mod. Germ. Leute), sumarlota, ‘a twig;’ ruota, ‘a set, twig:’ Old Sax. ruoda: Angl. Sax. rod: Slav. rod-i-ti, ‘to bring forth;’ na-rodu, ‘a people:’ Lith. liu-dinu, ‘to produce;’ rudu, ‘autumn:’ Celt. rho-dara, ‘a kind of plant;’ rod-ra, ‘a tree:’ Scot. ros, ‘seed;’ rosach, ‘full of seed:’ Hib. rosan, ‘a shrub;’ rud, ‘a wood, forest;’ ruadh, ‘strength, value; strong;’ romho, ‘very much, great;’ rom-hoide, ‘greatness;’ ruidh, ‘running, a race;’ roid, ‘a race;’ ruaidhneach, ‘hair;’ laidir, ‘strong, stout;’ laidireacht, laidireas, ‘strength.’]
2. रुह्, ट्, f. rising, ascending, ascent, sprouting, germinating, growth; (at the end of a comp.) shoot-ing up, germinating, growing, increasing; [cf. अम्-भो-र्°, क्षिति-र°, भूमी-र°।]
रुह: रुह, अस्, आ, अम्, rising, mounting, springing up, germinating, growing, springing from, growing on, produced on (at the end of a comp., cf. पङ्क-र्°, भूमी-र°, मही-र°); mounted, ascended upon; (आ), f. bent grass, Panicum Dactylon.
रुहक: रुहक, अम्, n. a hole, vacuity, cave, chasm; [cf. 1. रोप।]
रुहाण: रुहाण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. attaining, gaining; gain-ing over, delighting, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 32, 8. मनो रुहाण = चित्ताम् आरोहत्।)
रुह्वन्: रुह्वन्, आ, m. a plant, tree.
रूढ: रूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, mounted, risen, ascended; sprung up, born, produced; grown, grown up, in-creased; budded, blown; large, bulky, great, much; grown or spread about, diffused, commonly known, notorious; certain, ascertained; traditional, generally received, popular, customary, conventional, not to be etymologically resolved; having a special meaning or one not depending directly on the etymology (said of words); obscure. —रूढ-प्रणय, अस्, आ, अम्, whose love or affection has grown strong. —रू-ढ-योग, अस्, आ, अम्, whose Yoga or devotion has increased. —रूढ-यौवन, अस्, m. one who has attained to youth or adolescence. —रूढ-वञ्श, अस्, आ, अम्, of a high family. —रूढ-वचन, अम्, n. = रूढि-शब्द below. —रूढ-सौहृद, अस्, आ, अम्, whose friendship is grown or increased, firm in friendship.
रूढि: रूढि, इस्, f. ascending, rising, rise, ascent; springing up, germination, birth, origin; growth, increase; fame, renown, notoriety; tradition, cus-tom, traditional or customary usage, common cur-rency, general prevalence, popular or conventional acceptation of words (as opposed to their direct ety-mological meaning); the employment of a word in a sense not borne out by its etymology. —रूढि-शब्द, अस्, m. a word not etymologically derived, a word used in a conventional sense (as opposed to the etymological, thus शत्रु as a Rūḍhi-śabda means ‘enemy,’ but in its etymological sense ‘a destroyer’). —रूढिशब्द-ता, f. the state of being used in a conventional sense (said of a word).
रूढ्वा: रूढ्वा, ind. having ascended, having grown, &c.
रोढृ: रोढृ रोढृ, ढा, ढ्री, ढृ (fr. rt. 1. रुह्), one who ascends or grows, &c.
रूक्ष्: रूक्ष् रूक्ष् (more properly regarded as a Nom. fr. रूक्ष below; cf. rts. 1. रुष्, रूष्, रूषित), cl. 10. P. रूक्षयति (according to Vopa-deva also रूक्षापयति), -यितुम्, Aor. अरुरूक्षत्, to be rough or harsh; to make dry or emaciated (Ved.); to soil, smear (Ved.).
रूक्ष: रूक्ष, अस्, आ, अम् (perhaps fr. rt. 1. रुष्, q. v., but according to Uṇādi-s. III. 66. fr. rt. 1. रुह्; and according to others connected with rt. रूष् and रूषित; sometimes written रुक्ष, see 1. रुक्ष), rough, harsh (to the touch), not smooth or soft; rough to the taste, astringent, not bland; rough, rugged, uneven, difficult; harsh, cruel, unkind, un-couth, austere; firm, dry, arid, parched, emaciated; (अस्), m. a species of grass (= वरक); a tree [cf. रुह्वन्, according to some for Prākṛt rukkha = वृक्ष]; (आ), f. Croton Polyandrum or Croton Tiglium. —रूक्ष-गन्धक, अस्, m. bdellium. —रूक्ष-ता, f. or रूक्ष-त्व, अम्, n. roughness, harshness, dryness, aridity, emaciation; harshness, unkindness, unfriendliness. —रूक्ष-दर्भ, अस्, m. a kind of grass. —रूक्ष-पत्त्र, अस्, m. Tro-phis Aspera (= शाखोट). —रूक्ष-पेषम्, ind., with rt. पिष्, to pound dry, i. e. without adding butter or any liquid (Pāṇ. III. 4, 35). —रूक्ष-प्रिय, अस्, m. = ऋषभौषध. —रूक्ष-स्वादु-फल, अस्, m. a species of fruit tree. —रू-क्षी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to make rough or dry. —रूक्षी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made rough, soiled, besmeared, covered with, (पांसु-रूक्षीकृत, soiled or covered with dust; cf. रूषित।)
रूक्षण: रूक्षण, अस्, ई, अम्, making dry or thin, attenu-ating (Ved.); (अम्), n. the act of making dry or thin; (in medicine) treatment for reducing fat or corpulence. —रूक्षणात्मिका (°ण-आत्°), f. a species of grain (= लङ्का).
रूक्षित: रूक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, made rough, rough; soiled, smeared; [cf. अ-रूक्षित, रूषित।]
रूखर: रूखर रूखर, आस्, m. pl., N. of a Śaiva sect.
रूचक: रूचक रूचक, incorrect for रुचक, q. v.
रूप्: रूप् रूप् (more properly regarded as a Nom. fr. रूप below), cl. 10. P. रूप-यति, &c., to form, mould, model, figure, represent, to represent on the stage, exhibit in pantomime or by gesture, act; to feign; to view, inspect, contem-plate; (probably) to appear, (in this sense only A. रूपयते, see Vopa-deva XXII. 2.)
रूप: रूप, अम्, n. (according to Uṇādi-s. III. 28. fr. rt. 1. रु, but probably fr. a base रूप् for रोप्, Caus. of rt. 1. रुह्; at the end of an adj. comp. the fem. ends in आ), any outward appearance or phenomenon, form, figure, shape, (रूपं कृ, to assume a form); any object of vision or visible object (as colour &c.); reflected form, image, representation, similitude, re-semblance, semblance; the form of a noun or verb &c. (in grammar), an inflected form by declension or conjugation; a beautiful appearance, handsome form, mien, or figure, shapeliness, beauty, elegance, grace; natural state or condition, natural disposition, nature, essence, property, character, characteristic, peculiarity, feature, sign, symptom; kind, sort, species; mode, manner; a single specimen, type, copy, pattern, original, exemplar; discrete quantity, the number one, the arithmetical unit; integer number, (in this sense said to be plur.); known or absolute number, a known quantity (expressed in algebra by the first syllable रू); a particular coin, (probably) a rupee [cf. रूपक, रूप्य]; a drama, play, dramatic compo-sition; (according to native lexicographers रूप has also the following meanings), cattle, a herd of cattle; = मृग, a beast; = शब्द, sound, word; a Śloka, verse; = ग्रन्थावृत्ति, acquiring familiarity with any book by frequent recitation or learning by heart; (अस्), m. a proper N.; (अस् or अम्), m. n. (?) , N. of a place; (आ), f., N. of a river. रूप is frequently used in compounds in the sense ‘formed of,’ ‘com-posed of,’ ‘consisting of,’ ‘having the figure or appearance of,’ ‘in the form of,’ ‘having the same form or colour as,’ ‘like to’ (especially at the end of adj. comps., e. g. मनोज्ञ-रूपा स्त्री, a beautifully-formed woman; अन्-आचार-रूप, of an unusual ap-pearance; अशोक-रूप, having the colour of the Aśoka, Aśoka-coloured; sometimes used almost re-dundantly, cf. घोर-र्°). —रूप-कर्तृ, ता, m. ‘maker of forms or figures,’ N. of Viśva-kṛt. —रू-प-कार, अस्, m. a maker of images, sculptor. —रू-प-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, making forms or figures; (त्), m. epithet of Tvaṣṭṛ (Ved.); a sculptor. —रूप-गो-स्वामिन्, ई, m., N. of an author. —रूप-ग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, apprehending forms, perceiving colours; (अस्), m. the eye. —रूप-चिन्ता-मणि, इस्, m., N. of a work. —रूप-जीव for रूपाजीव, q. v. —रूप-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, knowing forms, perceiving or recog-nising shapes, distinguishing or discriminating visible objects (as colours &c.). —रूप-तत्त्व, अम्, n. ‘reality of form,’ inherent property, natural dispo-sition, nature, essence. —रूप-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having most form or colour. —रूप-तस्, ind. according to form, by shape, in form. —रूप-ता, f. or रूप-त्व, अम्, n. the state of being formed or composed of (often at the end of comps., e. g. दुःख-रूप-ता, the consisting of pain). —रूप-धर, अस्, आ, अम्, having the form or shape of, being of the colour of (at the end of a comp., e. g. गो-रूप-धर, cow-shaped; cf. काम-र्°); (अस्), m., N. of a king. —रूप-धातु, उस्, m. the element of form, original seat or region of form (with Bud-dhists; the other two elements being काम-ध्°, q. v., and अरूप-ध्°, ‘the element of formlessness’). —रूपधारि-त्व, अम्, n. the power of assuming any form or shape. —रूप-धारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, bear-ing a form, assuming a shape; endowed with a good figure, possessed of beauty. —रूप-धृक् or रूप-धृत्, त्, त्, त् (see धृक्, p. 459), having the form or shape of, resembling (at the end of a comp., e. g. कपि-रूप-धृत्, monkey-shaped; cf. विवि-ध-र्°). —रूप-धेय, अम्, n., Ved. form, external appearance; [cf. नाम-धेय।] —रूप-नयन, अस्, m., N. of a commentator. —रूप-नारायण, अस्, m., N. of an author. —रूप-नाशन, अस्, m. ‘form-destroying,’ an owl. —रूप-प, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people. —रूप-पति, इस्, m., Ved. ‘lord of forms,’ epithet of Tvaṣṭṛ. —रूप-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town. —रूप-भागानुबन्ध (°ग-अन्°), अस्, m. the addition of a fraction to a unit. —रूप-भागापवाह (°ग-अप्°), अस्, m. the deduction of a fraction from a unit. —रूप-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, having form or beauty. —रूप-भेद, अस्, m. diversity of form, variety of manifestations; (अम्), n., N. of a Tantra work. —रूप-मञ्जरी, f., N. of a woman; of a work on medicine. —रूप-मात्र, अम्, n. only beauty. —रूप-माला, f., N. of a grammatical work; (ई), ? f., N. of a metre, four times — -. —रूप-यौवन-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing beauty and youth. —रूप-रत्नाकर (°न-आक्°), अस्, m., N. of a work. —रूप-लता, f., N. of a princess. —रूप-लावण्य, अम्, n. beauty of form, elegance, loveliness. —रूप-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having form or colour, possessing shape or figure, possessed of body, formed, embodied, bodily, corporeal; having a beauti-ful form or figure, handsomely formed, handsome, beautiful, lovely, graceful; having the form or ap-pearance of (at the end of comps.); (अती), f. a handsome or beautiful woman; N. of various women; of a river. —रूप-वाहिक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people, (also read रूप-वासिक।) —रूप-विपर्यय, अस्, m. a morbid change of bodily form. —रूप-विभा-ग, अस्, m. the portioning of an integer number. —रूप-शस्, ind., Ved. in various forms, according to different formations. —रूप-शालिन्, ई, इनी, इ, pos-sessing form or figure, possessed of beauty, hand-some, beautiful. —रूप-शिखा, f., N. of a daughter of the Rākṣasa Agni-śikha. —रूप-समृद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. perfect in form; perfectly beautiful. —रूप-समृद्धि, इस्, f. perfection of form, a suitable form. —रूप-सम्पत्ति, इस्, or रूप-सम्-पद्, त्, f. perfection or excellence of form, beauty, handsomeness, elegance. —रूप-सिद्धि, इस्, m. a proper N. —रूप-सेन, अस्, m., N. of a Vidyā-dhara; of a king. —रूप-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘being in form,’ having form or figure. —रूप-हानि, इस्, f. loss of form, (in the Nyāya one of the seven pre-ventives of classification.) —रूपाजीव (°प-आज्°), अस्, आ, अम्, making a living by beauty of form, living by prostitution; (आ), f. a harlot, prostitute. —रू-पाधिबोध (°प-अध्°), अस्, m. the perception of form or of any visible object (by the senses). —रूपा-वचर (°प-अव्°), आस्, m. pl., N. of a class of gods (with Buddhists); [cf. कामावचर।] —रूपावली (°प-आव्°), f. a string of inflections, series of varia-tions of form through declension and conjugation, &c. —रूपाश्रय (°प-आश्°), अस्, m. a reposi-tory or receptacle of beauty, an exceedingly hand-some person. —रूपास्त्र (°प-अस्°), अस्, m. ‘having beauty for a weapon,’ Kāma-deva, the god of love. —रूपेन्द्रिय (°प-इन्°), अम्, n. the organ of form, the organ which perceives form and colour, the eye. —रूपेश्वर (°प-ईश्°), अस्, m., N. of a particular god; (ई), f., N. of a goddess. —रूपोपजीवन (°प-उप्°), अम्, n. the gaining a livelihood by a handsome figure. —रूपोपजीविन् (°प-उप्°), ई, इनी, इ, gaining a livelihood by means of a handsome form.
रूपक: रूपक, अस्, आ, अम्, appearing in an assumed form (Ved.); illustrating by metaphor, describing by figu-rative language, figurative; (अस्), m. a particular coin, (probably) a rupee [cf. रूप्य]; (इका), f. swallow-wort, Asclepias Lactifera: (अम्), n. form, figure, shape, image (often at the end of a comp. in the sense of ‘having the form of,’ ‘composed of,’ ‘con-sisting in’); any manifestation or representation; feature, sign, symptom; kind, species; (in rhetoric) a metaphor, comparison, simile, the description of one object under the form of another which it is poetically supposed to resemble (especially a simile or comparison when इव, वत्, &c. are omitted: there are three or four varieties of the figure Rūpaka, e. g. the खण्ड-रूपक or ‘imperfect metaphor,’ the अर्ध-रूपक or ‘partial metaphor,’ and the ललामक-रूपक or ‘flowery metaphor;’ and they differ from the Upamā or comparison chiefly in the omission of the particles denoting resemblance, such as इव, यथा, सह, or the Taddhita affix वत्; when this last is added the simile is called Taddhito-pamā); a drama, play, theatrical performance, (one of the two classes of dramatic composition divided into ten species including the Nāṭaka or principal play and the Prahasana or farce; see also प्र-क-रण, भाण, &c.; cf. उप-रूपक); a particular weight (= 3 Guñjās); = मूर्त (मूर्ति?); = धूर्त। —रूपक-ताल, अस्, m. a particular time in music. —रूपक-वाक्य, अम्, n. or रूपक-शब्द, अस्, m. a figurative expression.
रूपण: रूपण, अम्, n. figurative illustration, metaphorical description; examination, investigation, proof.
रूपयत्: रूपयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, figuring, describing, repre-senting, acting.
रूपयित्वा: रूपयित्वा, ind. having represented or acted.
रूपस्विन्: रूपस्विन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. handsome, beautiful.
रूपिक: रूपिक, coined gold or silver, money.
रूपिणिका: रूपिणिका, f. (dimin. fr. रूपिणी), a proper N.
रूपित: रूपित, अस्, आ, अम्, formed, represented, exhibited, imagined.
रूपिन्: रूपिन्, ई, इणी, इ, having form or figure, possessed of body, formed, embodied, corporeal; having a beautiful form or figure, well-shaped, handsome, beautiful; having the form or appearance of, having the character of, characterized by, appearing as, like (at the end of a comp., e. g. काल-रूपिन्, ई, m. ‘having the form of Death,’ an epithet of Śiva; cf. देव-र्°); (ई), m., N. of a son of Aja-mīḍha.
रूप्य: रूप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, having a beautiful form or appearance, well-shaped, handsome, beautiful; bear-ing a stamp, stamped, impressed; to be denoted figuratively or metaphorically; formerly in the pos-session of or possessed by (as an affix or at the end of a comp., see Pāṇ. V. 3, 54, Vopa-deva VII. 67; cf. also Pāṇ. IV. 3, 81); (अस्), m. a proper N.; N. of a mountain; (अम्), n. silver; wrought silver, silver or gold bearing a stamp or impression, stamped coin; wrought gold. —रूप्य-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made or consisting of silver, containing silver. —रू-प्य-माक्षिक, अम्, n. silver Mākṣika, Hepatic pyrites of iron. —रूप्याचल (°य-अच्°), अस्, m. ‘silver-mountain,’ N. of the mountain Kailāsa. —रू-प्याध्यक्ष (°य-अध्°), अस्, m. a superintendent of silver or of silver coinage, master of the mint.
रूम: रूम रूम, N. of a place, (also read रूप।)
रूर: रूर रूर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. hot, burning.
रूवुक: रूवुक रूवुक, अस्, m. the castor-oil tree, Ricinus Communis; [cf. रुवुक।]
रूष्: रूष् रूष्, cl. 1. P. रूषति, &c., to adorn, decorate; to cover, smear [cf. rt. रूक्ष्, रूक्षित]; cl. 10. P. रूषयति, &c., to tremble; to burst.
रूषक: रूषक, अस्, m. a plant, Gendarussa Vulgaris.

रेउइ: रेउइ रेüइ, N. of a village.

रेच: रेच, अस्, m. the emptying of the lungs (in the practice of Yoga), emission of breath; (ई), f., N. of a plant (= कम्पिल्लक); of another (= अङ्कोठ).

2. रेज्, ट्, ट्, ट्, shining; shaking, a shaker; (ट्), m., N. of Agni or fire.

रेणु: रेणु रेणु, उस्, m. (according to some also उस्, उ, f. n.; according to Uṇādi-s. III. 38. fr. rt. 1. री), dust, a grain or atom of dust, sand, &c.; the pollen of a flower; N. of a particular medicinal drug (= रेणुका, पर्पट); N. of the author of the hymns Ṛg-veda IX. 70, X. 89, (his patronymic is Vaiśvāmitra); of a son of Vikukṣi; (उस्), f., N. of a wife of Viśvā-mitra. —रेणु-ककाट, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. furrowing through or tossing up the dust; (Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VI. 28, 4 = रजस उद्भेदकः।) —रेणु-कारिका, f., N. of a Kārikā. —रेणु-गर्भ, अस्, m. ‘sand-vessel,’ (probably) a kind of hour glass (used for astronomical purposes). —रेणु-त्व, अम्, n. the state or condition of dust, the being dust, dustiness. —रेणु-दीक्षित, अस्, m., N. of an author. —रेणु-प, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people. —रेणु-पदवी, f. a path of dust. —रेणु-पालक, अस्, m. a proper N. —रेणु-मत्, आन्, m., N. of a son of Viśvā-mitra by Reṇu. —रेणु-रूषित, अस्, आ, अम्, covered with dust, dusty; (अस्), m. an ass. —रेणु-वास, अस्, आ, अम्, dwelling in dust, covered with the pollen of flowers; (अस्), m. a bee. —रेणु-शस्, ind. to dust, into dust, (रेणुशः कृ, to make into dust, turn to dust.) —रेणु-सार or रेणु-सारक, अस्, m. ‘essence of dust, ‘camphor.

(fr. rt. 1. री), a flow, flood, stream, current, flow of water or rain (Ved.); flow of semen, seminal fluid, semen, sperm, virile energy; seed, offspring, progeny, posterity, descendants (Ved.); quicksilver (regarded as ‘Śiva's semen’); sin, (Sāy. on Ṛg-veda IV. 3, 7 = पाप।) —रेतः-कुल्या, f. a stream or river of semen virile (in a particular hell). —रेतः-सिच्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. discharging semen; an epithet of particular Iṣṭakās. —रेतः-सिच्य, अम्, n., Ved. discharge of semen. —रेतस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. possessed of seed, abounding in seed, impregnat-ing, prolific, productive; (आन्), m. epithet of Agni. —रेतस्-विन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. abounding in seed, pro-lific, productive. —रेतो-धा, आस्, f., Ved. the act of impregnating, impregnation; (आस्, आस्, अम्), impreg-nating, fertilizing; (आस्), m. a father. —रेतो-धेय, अम्, n., Ved. impregnation. —रेतो-मार्ग, अस्, m. the seminal duct or canal.

रेतिन्: रेतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. abounding in seed; impreg-nating.
रेत्र: रेत्र, अम्, n. semen virile; quicksilver; nectar, ambrosia; perfumed or aromatic powder; (these meanings are sometimes given to वेत्र, which is confounded with रेत्र।)

रेवट: रेवट, अस्, m. a boar; a bamboo cane; a whirl-wind; a kind of poison; oil of the Morunga tree; the fruit of the plantain; (अम्), n. a muscle or conch-shell with its windings or spiral lines going from right to left.
रेवण: रेवण, अस्, m. a proper N.
रेवत्: रेवत् रे-वत्, रे-वती। See below and p. 854.

रे-वत्, आन्, अती, अत् (रे contracted fr. रयि + वत्), having prosperity or wealth, rich, wealthy, opulent, prosperous; grand in external appearance, shining, glittering, beautiful, illustrious; (अत्), ind., Ved. ra-diantly, beautifully; (अती), f., N. of the fifth Nak-ṣatra, (see नक्षत्र; sometimes also अत्यस्, f. pl.); the day of Revatī; N. of the evil genius or goddess presiding over a particular sickness, (some-times identified with Durgā, sometimes with Aditi); N. of the wife of Mitra; of a daughter of the Lustre (कान्ति) of the Nakṣatra Revatī and mother of Manu Raivata; of the wife of Bala-rāma (daughter of Kakudmin); of a wife of Amṛtodana; (अत्यस्) f. pl. ‘the wealthy ones, the shining ones,’ epithet of cows (Ved.); waters, water, a quantity of water (Ved.); epithet of the verse Ṛg-veda I. 30, 13 (so called from रेवती being the first word; the Raivata Sāman is formed from this verse; according to Pāṇ. रेवत: रेवत रेवत, अस्, m. the citron tree; Ca-thartocarpus Fistula; N. of various persons; of a son of Andhaka or of Ānarta; of the father of Revatī and father-in-law of Bala-rāma; of a Varṣa (?) .
रेवतक: रेवतक, अस्, m. a proper N.; (अम्), n. a species of plant.
रेवति: रेवति, इस्, f., N. of Rati (wife of Kāma-deva); = रे-वती, the wife of Bala-rāma. —रेवति-पुत्र, अस्, m. (रेवति for रेवती), the son of Revatī.
रेशयदारिन्: रेशयदारिन् रेशय-दारिन् (रेशय = हिंसत्), Ved. destroying those who injure, (used in Nirukta VI. 14. to explain रिशादस्, q. v.)
रेशी: रेशी रेशी, f., Ved. epithet of water.
रेष्: रेष् 1. रेष्, cl. 1. A. रेषते, रिरेषे, रे-षितुम्, to howl, roar, yell (as wolves); to neigh, whinny (as a horse; cf. rt. ह्रेष्); to utter any inarticulate sound.
2. रेष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, one who howls or neighs, howling, neighing.
रेष् 3. रेष्, ट् (fr. rt. 1. रिष्), in Vājasa-neyi-s. VI. 18. according to Mahī-dhara = रिष्टा or हिंसिता, (perhaps referrible to rt. रिश्, to injure.)
रेषण: 1. रेषण, अम्, n. the howl of a wolf, howling, yelling, roaring.
2. रेषण, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. injuring, hurting; (अम्), n. the act of injuring, injury, hurt, damage; failure.
रेषा: रेषा, f. howling, yelling (of wolves); neighing.
रेषित: रेषित, अस्, आ, अम्, yelled, sounded; (अम्), n. neighing, roaring.
रेष: रेष, अस्, m., Ved. injury, hurt, receiving injury.
रेषिन्: रेषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, injuring, hurting; [cf. पुरु-ष-र्°।]
रेष्टृ: रेष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, one who injures or hurts, an injurer.
रेष्मन्: रेष्मन्, आ, m., Ved. a storm, whirlwind, storm-cloud, (according to Mahī-dhara) the dissolution or destruction of the world. —रेष्म-च्छिन्न or रेष्म-मथित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. rent or broken by a storm, torn up by a tempest.
रेष्म्य: रेष्म्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being in or exposed to a storm, involved in destruction (at the dissolution of the world).
रेहत्: रेहत् रेहत्, see Gaṇa Bhṛśādi to Pāṇ. III. 1, 12.
रेहाय: रेहाय, Nom. A. रेहायते, &c., see Gaṇa Bhṛ-śādi to Pāṇ. III. 1, 12.
रै: रै 1. रै, cl. 1. P. रायति, ररौ, रातुम्, to bark, bark at (with acc.); to sound; [cf. Lat. latrare.]
2. रै, आस् (?) , m. barking, sound, noise.

रै 3. रै, रास्, m. rarely f. (connected with रयि, q. v., fr. rt. 1. रा; acc. रायम्, Ved. राम् = Lat. rem; for other cases see Gram. 132), property, possessions, goods, wealth, gold; costliness; (रै), ind., see Gaṇa Cādi to Pāṇ. I. 4. 57; [cf. Lat. res.] —रायस्-काम, अस्, आ, अम् (रायस्, gen. c.), Ved. desirous of property, anxious to become rich. —रा-यस्-पोष, अस्, m., Ved. increase of property or riches, the possession of wealth, increase of pros-perity; (अस्, आ, अम्), increasing riches (said of Kṛṣṇa). —रायस्-पोषक, अस्, इका, अम्, increasing riches. —रायस्-पोष-दा, आस्, आस्, अम्, or रायस्पोष-दावन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. granting increase of wealth, bestowing increase of prosperity. —रायस्-पोष-वनि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. procuring increase of riches (धन-पुष्टेः सम्पादयितृ). —रायो-वाज, अस्, m. रेवत्य: रेवत्य (a Vedic adjective fr. रेवती, Pāṇ. IV. 4, 122), illustrious, beautiful, &c. (?)
रेवन्त: रेवन्त, अस्, m., N. of a son of Sūrya and chief of the Guhyakas; the fifth Manu of the present Kalpa; [cf. रैवत।] —रेवन्त-मनु-सू, ऊस्, f. mother of Manu Revanta, epithet of Sañjñā (wife of Sūrya). —रेवन्तोत्तर (°त-उत्°), N. of a work.

रैय: रैय, Nom. P. रैयति, &c., to desire riches.
रैवत: रैवत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. रे-वत्), coming or de-scended from a wealthy family, rich, opulent, wealthy; relating to Manu Raivata; belonging to or connected with the Raivata Sāman (said of Indra, Savitṛ; Ved.); (अस्), m. a cloud (Ved.); a kind of Soma; a sort of vegetable; N. of a demon presiding over a particular child's disease; N. of one of the eleven Rudras; of Śiva; of the fifth Manu; of a Daitya; of a Ṛṣi; of a Brahmarṣi; of a king; a patro-nymic of Kakudmin (the ruler of Ānarta; in this sense fr. रेवत); a metronymic of a son of Amṛ-todana by Revatī; N. of a mountain near Kuśa-sthalī, the capital of the country Ānarta; (ई), f. in Mahā-bh. Anuśāsana-p. 6236, according to the com-mentator = रैवत above; (अम्), n., N. of a Sāman. —रैवत-मदनिका, f., N. of a Goṣṭhī drama.
रैवतक: रैवतक, see Gaṇa Arīhaṇādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80; (अस्), m., N. of a mountain (= रैवत); N. of a porter (in the Śakuntalā); (आस्), m. pl., N. of the inhabitants of the mountain Raivataka; (अम्), n. a species of plant.
रैवतिक: रैवतिक, अस्, m. a metronymic from Revatī.
रैवत्य: रैवत्य, अम्, n. (fr. रेवत्), riches, wealth; रैवत्य ऋषभः, N. of a Sāman.
रैख: रैख रैख, अस्, m. (fr. रेख), a patro-nymic.
रैणव: रैणव रैणव, अस्, m. (fr. रेणु), a patro-nymic; (अम्), n., N. of a Sāman.
रैणुकेय: रैणुकेय, अस्, m. (fr. रेणुका), a metronymic of Paraśu-rāma.
रैतस: रैतस रैतस, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. रेतस्), Ved. be-longing to seed or semen, seminal.
रैतिक: रैतिक रैतिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. रीति), of or belonging to brass, brazen.
रैत्य: रैत्य, अस्, &c., made of brass, brazen.
रैभ: रैभ रैभ, अस्, m. (fr. रेभ), a patronymic; (ई), f., Ved., scil. ऋच्, epithet of particular ritualistic verses; N. of the three verses, Atharva-veda XX. 127, 4-6 (so called from the word रेभ occurring several times).
रैभ्य: रैभ्य, अस्, m. a patronymic from Rebha, N. of a son of Sumati and father of Dushyanta.
रैष्णायन: रैष्णायन रैष्णायन, अस्, m. a patronymic.
रोक: रोक रोक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. रुच्), light, lustre, brightness, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VI. 66, 6 = दीप्ति, ‘light,’ or बाधक, ‘obstructing’); buying with ready money; (अम्), n. a hole, cavity; a boat, ship; moving, shaking; = कृपण-भेद।
रोकस्: रोकस्, अस्, n., Ved. light or any phenomenon of light.
रोग: रोग रोग, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. रुज्), ‘breaking up of strength,’ infirmity, weakness, sickness, disease, malady, (क्षुद्-रोग, disease from hunger; क्षे-त्रिय-रोग, an incurable disease, see क्षेत्रिय); Disease regarded as an evil genius or demon; Costus Speciosus or Arabicus. —रोग-ग्रस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, seized with sickness, sick, diseased. —रोग-घ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, removing sickness, curative, remedial, medicinal; (अम्), n. medicine. —रोग-ज्ञान, अम्, n. knowledge of diseases. —रोग-द, अस्, आ, अम्, giving or causing sickness. —रोग-नाशन, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. destroying sickness, removing disease. —रोग-निग्रहण, अम्, n. suppression of disease. —रोग-प्रद, अस्, आ, अम्, causing disease. —रोग-भय, अम्, n. fear of disease. —रोग-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, possessing sickness, one who suffers from disease, ill, sick. —रोग-भू, ऊस्, f. the place or seat of sickness, the body. —रोग-मुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, freed from sickness, recovered from illness. —रोग-मुरारि (°र-अरि), इस्, m., N. of a work on medicine. —रोग-राज, अस्, m. ‘king of sicknesses,’ consumption. —रोग-लक्षण, अम्, n. the sign or symptoms of a disease. —रोग-शान्तक, अस्, m. a curer of disease, a physician. —रोग-शान्ति, इस्, f. cure or alleviation of disease. —रोग-शिला, f. realgar, red arsenic. —रोग-शिल्पिन्, ई, m. a species of plant (com-monly called Śaralu), Cassia Fistula. —रोग-श्रेष्-ठ, अस्, m. ‘the chief of sicknesses,’ fever. —रोग-ह, अम्, n. ‘destroying disease,’ a drug, medicament. —रोग-हन्, हा, m. ‘remover of disease,’ a phy-sician. —रोग-हर, अस्, आ, अम्, taking away disease, remedial, curative, medicinal; (अम्), n. medicine. —रोग-हारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, taking away disease, curing, curative; (ई), m. a physician. —रोग-हृत्, त्, त्, त्, curing disease; (त्), m. a physician. —रोगान्तक (°ग-अन्°), अस्, ई, अम्, ‘disease-destroying,’ curative, medicinal; (अस्), m. a physician. —रोगान्वित (°ग-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, possessed of sickness, sick, diseased. —रोगायतन (°ग-आय्°), अम्, n. the abode of disease, seat of malady, the body. —रोगार्त (°ग-आर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, suffering from sickness or disease, afflicted with any disease. —रोगोन्मादित (°ग-उन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, maddened with disease, mad (said of a dog). —रोगोपशम (°ग-उप्°), अस्, m. cure or alleviation of disease. —रोगोल्बण-ता (°ग-उल्°), f., Ved. the spreading or raging of diseases.
रोगित: रोगित, अस्, आ, अम्, diseased, suffering from sick-ness; mad (said of a dog).
रोगिन्: रोगिन्, ई, इणी, इ, sick, sickly, diseased, ill, (मन्द-रोगिन्, seldom ill.) —रोगि-तरु, उस्, m. ‘tree of the sick, ‘epithet of the Aśoka tree. —रोगि-ता, f. sickness, illness, a diseased state. —रोगि-वल्लभ, अम्, n. ‘friend of the sick,’ medicine, a drug.
रोगिष्ठ: रोगिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. of रोगिन्), one who is always sickly or ill.
रोग्य: रोग्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. रोग), related to or con-nected with disease, producing sickness, unwhole-some, unhealthy; (रोग्य may also be a fut. part. pass. fr. rt. 1. रुज्, q. v.)
रोच: रोच रोच, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. रुच्), en-lightening, illuminating, one who lightens or makes bright; (अस्), m., N. of a king; [cf. गो-र्°।]
रोचक: रोचक, अस्, आ, अम्, brightening, enlightening, &c. (= रोचन); giving an appetite, (अ-रोचक, taking away appetite, depriving of appetite); pleas-ing, agreeable; (अस्), m. hunger, appetite; a sto-machic, stimulant, any medicine, fruit, &c. supposed to strengthen the tone of the stomach and restore lost appetite; N. of various plants, the plantain; a kind of onion; a worker in glass or artificial orna-ments.
रोचकिन्: रोचकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having desire or appetite; अ-रोचकिन्, free from desire or appetite.
रोचन: रोचन, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, enlightening, making bright, illuminating, irradiating, lightening, light, bright, splendid, beautiful; causing or exciting de-sire, giving pleasure or satisfaction, pleasing, agree-able, pleasant, charming, lovely; sharpening or giving an appetite, stomachic; (अस्), m. a stomachic; a variety of the cotton tree; = पलाण्डु, आरग्-बध, करञ्ज, अङ्कोठ, दाडिम; epithet of a demon presiding over a particular disease; N. of one of the five arrows of the god of love (‘exciter of pleasures’); N. of a son of Viṣṇu by Dakṣiṇā; N. of Indra under Manu Svārociṣa; of a mountain; (आ), f. the bright sky, firmament, (see रोचनम् below); a handsome woman; a particular yellow pigment (com-monly called गो-रोचना, q. v.); a red lotus-flower; dark Śālmali (= Marāṭhī kāḷī sāmvarī) = वंश-रोचना, bamboo manna or Tabāṣīr; N. of a wife of Vasu-deva; (ई), f., N. of various plants, Convol-vulus Turpethum; = काम्पिल्ल; = दन्ति; = आम-लकी; red arsenic, realgar; a particular yellow pig-ment, = रोचना; (अम्), n. light, brightness (Ved.), the bright sky, firmament, luminous sphere (of which there are said to be three, see Ṛg-veda I. 102, 8; in this sense sometimes आ, f.); a luminary (Ved.); the raising a desire for; देवानां रोचनम्, N. of a Sāman. —रोचन-फल, अस्, m. the citron tree; (आ), f. a species of cucumber. —रोचन-स्था, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. abiding in light, dwelling in the firma-ment. —रोचना-कृ, see Gaṇa Sākṣādādi to Pāṇ. I. 4, 74. —रोचना-मुख, अस्, m., N. of a Daitya. —रोचना-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. possessing light, shining, light, bright.
रोचनक: रोचनक, अस्, m. the citron tree; (इका), f. a species of plant (= शुण्डा-रोचनी, काम्पिल्लिका); = वंश-रोचना, bamboo manna or Tabāṣīr.
रोचमान: रोचमान, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, glittering, bright, splendid, resplendent; pleasing, gratifying, charming, pleasant, agreeable, (अ-रोचमान, not agreeable, unpleasant); (अस्), m. a tuft or curl of hair on a horse's neck; N. of a king; of one of the Mātṛs attending upon Skanda.
रोचिन्: रोचिन्, ई, इनी, इ, light, bright, (see मित-र्°।)
रोचिष: रोचिष, अस्, m. (fr. रोचिस्), N. of a son of Vibhā-vasu by Uṣas.
रोचिष्णु: रोचिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, shining, giving light, bright, splendid, brilliant, beautiful, gaily adorned, elegantly dressed, gay, blooming; giving an appetite. —रो-चिष्णु-मुख, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, having a bright countenance.
रोचिस्: रोचिस्, इस्, n. light, splendor, brightness, brilliancy, flame. —रोचिष्-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing light, giving light; (आन्), m., N. of a son of Manu Svāro-cisha.
रोची: रोची, f. a pot-herb, Hingtsha Repens.
रोच्य: रोच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be illuminated or enlight-ened.
रोट: रोट रोट in पूग-रोट, q. v.
रोटकव्रत: रोटक-व्रत, अम्, n. epithet of a particular reli-gious observance.
रोटिका: रोटिका, f. bread or a kind of bread, wheaten cakes toasted on an earthen or iron dish (= Hindūstānī रोटी); यव-रोटिका, barley bread.
रोटी: रोटी, f. bread, in फिरङ्ग-र्°, q. v.
रोड्: रोड् रोड्, cl. 1. P. रोडति, &c., to be mad (= rt. लोड्); to despise, disrespect, (in this sense = rts. रौड्, रौट्।)
रोड: रोड रोड, अस्, आ, अम्, satisfied, contented; (अस्), m. crushing, pounding (= क्षोद).
रोणीक: रोणीक रोणीक, N. of a place.
रोणीकीय: रोणीकीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to Roṇīka.
रोदसी: रोदसी, f. heaven; N. of the wife of Rudra and mother of the Maruts; (Sāy. also) mother of the Maruts or lightning; (अस्यौ or असी), f. du. heaven and earth, the upper and lower world, (in Ṛg-veda I. 33, 5. रोदस्योः, gen. du. = द्यावा-पृथिव्योः; the form रोदसी for nom. acc. du. is also referred to रोदस् above.) —रोदसि-प्रा, आस्, आस्, अम् (रोदसि for रो-दसी), Ved. filling heaven and earth (= द्यावा-पृथिव्योः पूरयितृ).
रोध्र: रोध्र रोध्र, अस्, m. (probably connected with rt. 1. रुध् and रुधिर), the tree Symplocos Racemosa (having yellow leaves; the red powder thrown over persons during the Holī festival is pre-pared from the bark of this tree); (अम्), n. sin, (in this sense also अस्, m.); offence, injury, (in these two senses probably connected with rt. 2. रुध्।) —रोध्र-पुष्प, अस्, m. Bassia Latifolia; a species of ringed snake. —रोध्र-पुष्पक, अस्, m. a kind of grain (said to be a sort of शालि); a species of ringed snake. —रोध्र-पुष्पिणी, f. Grislea To-mentosa. —रोध्र-शूक, अस्, m. a kind of rice (the ears of which are similar in colour to the flowers of the Rodhra).
रोपण: 1. रोपण, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. causing bodily pain, causing racking or griping pain; (अम्), n. according to the commentator on Taittirīya-Brāhmaṇa III. 476, 9 = विमोहन or उपद्रव।

2. रोपण, अस्, ई, अम्, causing to grow, causing to grow over or cicatrize, healing; putting or placing on, (अम्), n. the act of setting up or erecting, raising; the act of planting, setting, &c.; healing, cicatrizing; a healing application (used for sores).
रोपि: रोपि, इस्, f., Ved. acute or racking pain.
रोपित: 1. रोपित, अस्, आ, अम्, bewildered, perplexed.
2. रोपित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to grow; raised, erected, elevated; set, planted, placed in or upon.
रोपुषी: रोपुषी, f., Ved., according to some = रोपि; ac-cording to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 191, 13. ‘destroying,’ रोपुषीणाम् = लोपयित्रीणाम् = छेत्त्रीणाम्।
रोपक: रोपक, अस्, m. a planter [cf. वृक्ष-र्°]; a weight of metal or a coin ((1/70) of a Suvarṇa; cf. रूपक).
रोपणीय: रोपणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be set up or erected or raised; to be planted; useful for healing or cicatrizing.
रोपयितृ: रोपयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who sets up or erects, an erecter; a planter.
रोपिन्: रोपिन्, ई, इणी, इ, raising, erecting, setting, planting.
रोप्य: रोप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be raised or erected; to be planted.
रोपणाका: रोपणाका रोपणाका, f., Ved. a kind of bird, (Sāy.) a thrush (= शारिका).
रोम: रोम 1. and 2. रोम, 1. and 2. रोमक, &c. See col. 3.
1. रोम = रोमन् (at the end of an adj. comp., e. g. अ-रोम, having no hair, hairless; cf. स-र्°); (अस्), m. a hole, cavity [cf. 1. रोप]; (अम्), n. water.
रोमन्: रोमन् रोमन्, अ, n. (probably fr. rt. 1. रुह्; cf. लोमन्; according to Uṇādi-s. IV. 150. fr. rt. 1. रु), the hair on the body of men and animals, (especially) short hair, bristles, wool, down, nap, &c., (less properly applicable to the long hair on the head and beard of men, and to that on the mane and tail of animals); the feathers of a bird; (आणस्), m. pl., N. of a people; [cf. Hib. romach, ‘hairy;’ ro-machad, ‘hairiness;’ roinfaith, ‘hair-cloth;’ roin, roine, ‘hair, fur;’ roineach, ‘hairy.’] —रोम-कन्द, अस्, m. a kind of bulbous root or vegetable (= पिण्डालु). —रोम-कर्णक, अस्, m. ‘hair-eared,’ a hare. —रोम-कूप, अस्, अम्, m. n. ‘hair-hole,’ a pore of the skin; [cf. रोम-रन्ध्र।] —रोम-केसर, अम्, n. the tail of the Bos Grunniens used as a Chowri, a whisk; (also written रोम-केशर।) —रोम-गर्त, अस्, m. = रोम-कूप। —रोम-गुच्छ, अस्, m. or रोम-गुत्स, अम्, n. the tail of the Bos Grunniens used as a Chowri. —रोमण्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. = रो-म-वत्, covered with hair, hairy. —रोम-त्यज्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. losing the hair (said of a horse). —रोम-पाद, अस्, m., N. of a king. —रोम-पुलक, अस्, m. the bristling of the hairs of the body, a thrill of joy or fear (= रोम-हर्ष)। —रोम-फला, f. = रोमश-फल. —रोम-बद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘hair-bound,’ made or fastened with the hair of animals, woven with hair. —रोम-बन्ध, अस्, m. hair-texture. —रोम-भूमि, इस्, f. the place of the hair, i. e. the skin. —रोम-मूर्धन्, आ, आ or ध्नी, अ, having short hairs on the head, covered with hair or down on the head (said of insects). —रोम-रतासार, अस्, m. the belly, (apparently a wrong form.) —रोम-रन्ध्र, अम्, n. a hole through which a hair shoots out, a pore of the skin. —रोम-राजि, इस्, or रोम-राजी, f. a row or line of hair, a streak of hair (on the abdo-men of men and especially of women just above the navel, said to be a sign of puberty). —रोम-राजि-पथ, अस्, m. the line of the hair above the navel, (in तनु-र्° = ‘the waist.’) —रोम-लता or रोम-लतिका, f. the winding line of hair above the navel (of women). —रोम-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessed of hair, covered with hair, hairy, woolly. —रोम-वाहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, cutting off hair, sharp enough to cut a hair. —रोम-विकार, अस्, m. or रोम-विक्रिया, f. change of the hair of the body, bristling or erection of the hair of the body, horripilation. —रोम-विध्वंस, अस्, m. ‘hair-destroying,’ a louse. —रोम-विवर, अम्, n. = रोम-कूप. —रोम-वेध, अस्, m., N. of an author. —रोम-शुक, अम्, n. a kind of per-fume. —रोम-हर्ष, अस्, m. the bristling of the hair of the body, a thrill or shudder (caused by joy, fear, cold, &c.). —रोम-हर्षण, अस्, ई, अम्, causing the hair to bristle or stand erect, causing excessive joy, causing a shudder or horror, awe-inspiring, thrilling; (अस्), m. Terminalia Belerica (the nuts of which are used as dice); N. of Sūta (the pupil of Vyāsa and supposed narrator of the events in the Purāṇas); N. of the father of Sūta; (अम्), n. = रोम-हर्ष. —रोम-हर्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, thrilled with delight, having the hair of the body bristling or erect with joy or horror. —१। रो-माञ्च (°म-अञ्°), अस्, m. ‘curling or erection of the hair of the body,’ a thrill of rapture (= रोम-हर्ष); thrill of horror, horripilation. —२। रो-माञ्च (fr. the preceding), Nom. P. रोमाञ्चति, &c., to have the hair erect from excessive rapture, to feel a thrill of joy or horror. —रोमाञ्च-कञ्चुक, अस्, m. a coat of mail consisting (as it were) of the down of the body erect through delight. —रोमाञ्-चकिन्, ई, m., N. of a serpent-demon. —रोमाञ्चिका, f. a species of plant (= रुदन्ती). —रोमाञ्चित, अस्, आ, अम्, having the hair of the body erect or thrilled with joy or horror, enraptured. —रोमान्त (°म-अन्°), अस्, m. the hairy side, i. e. the upper side of the hand. —रोमाली (°म-आली), f. a row or line of hair (above the navel; cf. रोम-राजि); = वयः-सन्धि, (probably) puberty. —रोमालु (°म-आलु), उस्, m. a sort of vegetable (= पिण्डालु). —रोमालु-विटपिन्, ई, m. a species of plant (= कुम्भी). —रो-मावली (°म-आव्°), f. a row or line of hair (above the navel; cf. रोमाली). —रोमाश्रय-फला (°म-आश्°), f. a species of shrub. —रोमोद्गति (°म-उद्°), इस्, f. or रोमोद्गम (°म-उद्°) or रोमोद्भेद (°म-उद्°), अस्, m. erection of the hair (= रोम-हर्ष, q. v.).
रोमक: 1. रोमक = रोमन् (at the end of an adj. comp.).

2. रोमक, अस्, m. Rome; ‘the Roman’ as epi-thet of a particular astronomer; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people (mentioned in Mahā-bh. Sabhā-p. 1837; cf. रोमाणस् under रोमन्); the people of the Roman empire, the Romans; (अम्), n. a kind of saline earth and the salt extracted from it; a kind of magnet. —रोमक-पत्तन, अम्, n. the city of Rome. —रोमक-सिद्धान्त, अस्, m., N. of one of the five chief Siddhāntas in the age of Varāha-mihira. —रोमकाचार्य (°क-आच्°), अस्, m., N. of a teacher of astronomy.
रोमश: रोमश, अस्, आ, अम्, having thick hair, having thick wool or bristles, hairy, woolly; (अस्), m. a sheep, ram; a hog, boar; a sort of vegetable (= पिण्डालु, कुम्भी); N. of a Ṛṣi; of an astro-nomer [cf. 2. रोमक]; (आ), f. Cucumis Utilissi-mus; N. of the reputed authoress of Ṛg-veda 1. 126, 7; (अम्), n. the pudenda (Ved.). —रोमश-फल, अस्, m. a species of plant (= टिण्डिश).
रोमकायण: रोमकायण, अस्, m., N. of an author.
रोमन्थ: रोमन्थ रोमन्थ, अस्, m. (according to some fr. रुज् + मन्थ), ruminating, chewing the cud, (गगण-रोमन्थ, अस्, m. ‘ruminating on the sky, ‘nonsense, absurdity); chewing; frequent repetition; [cf. Gr. ἐρεύγομαι, ἐρυγγάνω, ὀρυγγἀνω; Lat. rūmen (for rug-men), ruminare, ructare; Old Germ. ita-ruchjan; Angl. Sax. roc-cettan.]
रोमन्थाय: रोमन्थाय, Nom. A. रोमन्थायते, &c., to ruminate, chew the cud.
रोमन्थायमान: रोमन्थायमान, अस्, आ, अम्, ruminating, chew-ing the cud.
रोरुक: रोरुक रोरुक, N. of a country or of a town.
रोल: रोल रोल, अस्, m. Flacourtia Cataphracta; green ginger; (आ), f. a particular metre (= लोला)। —रोल-देव, अस्, m., N. of a painter.
रोलम्ब: रोलम्ब रोलम्ब, अस्, आ, अम्, distrustful, unbelieving (?); (अस्), m. a bee; dry or arid soil (?). —रोलम्ब-कदम्ब, अम्, n. a swarm of bees.
रोलिचन्द्रू: रोलिचन्द्रू रोलिचन्द्रू, ऊस्, m. a proper N.
रोह: रोह रोह, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. रुह्), rising, mounting upwards, ascending, springing up, growing [cf. रोह-शिखिन्]; riding on, (अश्व-रोह, riding on a horse); (अस्), m. rising, height, altitude; the raising or increasing of anything (as of a number from a smaller to a higher denomination); the growing, growth; a bud, blossom, shoot, sprout. —रोह-ग, अस्, m., N. of a mountain (= रोहण)। —रोह-शिखिन्, ई, m. fire which mounts upwards, ascending flame. —रोह-सेन, अस्, m. a proper N.
रोहक: रोहक, अस्, &c. = रोढृ; riding on [cf. कटि-र्°], a rider; growing on [cf. ग्राव-र्°]; (अस्), m. epithet of a kind of spirit or goblin.
रोहण: रोहण, अस्, m., N. of a mountain (Adam's peak in Ceylon); (ई), f. a medicine for healing or cica-trizing (a wound; Ved.); (अम्), n. a rising or ascending; a means of ascending (Ved.); the act of mounting up, riding on, sitting on, standing on (ज्या-रोहण, the putting or fastening on of a bow-string); the growing over, healing; the proceeding from, consisting of; semen virile. —रोहण-द्रुम, अस्, m. the sandal tree.
रोहत्: रोहत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, rising, mounting, ascending, growing.
रोहन्त: रोहन्त, अस्, m. a particular tree; a tree in general; (ई), f. a particular creeper; a creeper in general.
रोहस्: रोहस्, अस्, n., Ved. height, elevation.
रोहाय: रोहाय (fr. रोहत् above), Nom. A. रोहायते, &c., see Gaṇa Bhṛśādi to Pāṇ. III. 1, 12.
रोहि: रोहि, इस्, m. a kind of deer; a seed; a tree; a pious or religious man, one observing a vow (= व्रतिन्).
रोहिण: रोहिण, अस्, आ, अम्, born under the asterism Rohiṇī; (अस्), m., N. of Viṣṇu; of a man; of various plants, = भू-तृण, वट, रोहितक; (आस्), m. pl. the descendants of Rohiṇa; (अम्), n. epithet of the ninth Muhūrta (a part of the forenoon, extending to midday, in which Śrāddhas are espe-cially to be observed).
रोहिणि: रोहिणि, इस्, f. = रोहिणी, the Nakṣatra. —रोहिणि-त्व, अम्, n., Ved. = रोहिणी-त्व. —रोहिणि-नन्दन, अस्, m. the son of Rohiṇī, i. e. Bala-rāma. —रोहिणि-पुत्र, अस्, m. ‘son of Rohiṇī,’ a proper N. —रो-हिणि-षेण or रोहिणि-सेन, अस्, m. a proper N.
रोहिणिका: रोहिणिका, f. a woman with a red face (either from anger or from being coloured with pigments); inflammation of the throat.
रोहिणी: रोहिणी, f. (fem. of रोहित, col. 2; see also the fem. of रोहिन्, col. 2), a red cow, (in the Veda perhaps also) a red mare; a cow in general, (in Hindū mythology Rohiṇī is represented as a daughter of Surabhi and mother of cattle; she is also said to be the mother of Kāma-dhenu, the cow of plenty); N. of the ninth Nakṣatra or lunar asterism (personified as a daughter of Dakṣa, and the favourite wife of the Moon, called ‘the Red one,’ from the colour of the star Aldebaran or principal star in the constellation; the Nakṣatra contains five stars, probably α, β, γ, δ, ε, Tauri, and according to Hindū notions is figured by a wheeled carriage or sometimes by a temple or a fish); N. of the lunar day belonging to the above Nakṣatra; lightning; a young girl, one in whom menstruation has just commenced, a girl nine years of age; inflammation of the throat (of various kinds); N. of various plants, a kind of vegetable (= कटु-रोहिणी, सोम-वल्क, काश्मरी, हरीतकी, मञ्जिष्-ठा); N. of a wife of Vasu-deva and mother of Bala-rāma; of a wife of Kṛṣṇa; of the wife of Mahā-deva; of a daughter of Hiraṇya-kaśipu; of one of the sixteen Vidyā-devīs; (according to Pāṇ. IV. 4, 34, Vārtt. 1, there is an adj. रोहिणी, meaning ‘born under the Nakṣatra Rohiṇī.’) —रोहिणी-कान्त, अस्, m. ‘the lover of Rohiṇī,’ epithet of the Moon. —रोहिणी-चन्द्र-व्रत and रोहिणी-चन्द्र-शयन, अम्, n., N. of two religious observances. —रोहिणी-तनय, अस्, m. the son of Rohiṇī, i. e. Bala-rāma. —रोहिणी-तपस्, N. of a work. —रो-हिणी-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha. —रोहिणी-त्व, अम्, n., Ved. the state or condition of the Nakṣatra Rohiṇī. —रोहिणी-पति, इस्, m. the husband of Ro-hiṇī, i. e. the Moon. —रोहिणी-प्रिय, अस्, m. the lover of Rohiṇī, i. e. the Moon. —रोहिणी-भव, अस्, m. the son of Rohiṇī, i. e. the planet Mercury. —रोहिणी-योग, अस्, m. the conjunction of the moon with the Nakṣatra Rohiṇī. —रोहिणी-रमण, अस्, m. ‘the lover of the cow,’ a bull; the lover or husband of Rohiṇī, i. e. the Moon. —रोहिणी-वल्-लभ, अस्, m. the lover of Rohiṇī, i. e. the Moon. —रोहिणी-व्रत, अम्, n., N. of a particular reli-gious observance. —रोहिणीश (°नी-ईश), अस्, m. the lord or husband of Rohiṇī, i. e. the Moon. —रोहिणी-शकट, अस्, अम्, m. n. an asterism, probably α, β, γ, δ, ε, Tauri. —रोहिणी-षेण, अस्, m. a proper N.; [cf. रोहिणि-षेण।] —रोहिणी-सुत, अस्, m. ‘son of Rohiṇī, ‘the planet Mercury. —रोहिण्य्-अष्टमी, f. the eighth day in the dark half of the month Bhādra when the moon is in conjunction with the Nakṣatra Rohiṇī.
रोहित्: रोहित्, त्, m. (according to Uṇādi-s. I. 99. fr. rt. 1. रुह्), the sun; a species of fish, = रोहित; (त्), f. a red mare (Ved.); the female of a deer, doe; a sort of creeper; (तस्), f. pl. epithet of rivers (ac-cording to Naigh. I. 13); the fingers (according to Naigh. II. 5); (त्, त्, त्), red, of a red colour. —रो-हिद्-अश्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having red mares (said of Agni).
रोहित: रोहित, अस्, आ or (more commonly) रोहिणी, अम् [cf. लोहित], red, of a red colour [cf. रुधिर]; coloured; (अस्), m. red (the colour), a red horse; a fox; a form of Fire or the Sun (Ved.); another deity in Atharva-veda XIII. 1; N. of the hymns of the above Veda in which the god Rohita is mentioned; a kind of deer; a species of fish, Cyprinus Ro-hita; a kind of tree, Andersonia Rohitaka; a sort of ornament made of precious stones; a particular form of rainbow, (see रोहितम् below); N. of a son of Hari-ścandra; of a Manu; of a son of Kṛṣṇa; of a son of Vapuṣ-mat (king of Śālmala); of a river; (आस्), m. pl. epithet of a class of Gandharvas; of a class of gods under the twelfth Manu; (इणी), f., see col. 1; (अम्), n. a kind of rainbow appearing in a straight form, Indra's bow unbent and invisible to mortals; blood; saffron. —रोहित-कूल, N. of a place. —रोहित-कूलीय and रोहित-कूलीयाद्य and रोहित-कूलीयोत्तर, अम्, n., N. of Sāmans. —रो-हित-गिरि, इस्, m., N. of a mountain. —रोहित-गिरीय, आस्, m. pl. the inhabitants of the mountain Rohita-giri. —रोहित-पुर, अम्, n., N. of the town founded by Rohitaka the son of Hari-ścandra. —रो-हित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having a red horse. —रोहित-वस्तु, N. of a place. —रोहिताक्ष (°त-अक्°), अस्, ई, अम्, red-eyed, having red eyes. —रो-हिताञ्जि (°त-अञ्°), इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. marked with red. —रोहिताश्व, अस्, आ, अम्, having red horses; (अस्), m. the god of fire, Agni; N. of a son of Hari-ścandra. —रोहितैत (°त-एत), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. variegated with red.
रोहितक: रोहितक, अस्, m., N. of a tree, Andersonia Ro-hitaka; N. of a river; of a Stūpa; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; (इका), f. a woman whose face is stained with red pigments or red with rage. —रोहितका-रण्य (°क-अर्°), अम्, n. ‘Rohitaka-wood,’ N. of a place.
रोहितायन: रोहितायन, अस्, m. a patronymic, (probably for रौहितायन।)
रोहिन्: रोहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, rising, mounting upwards, grow-ing, increasing; grown, shot up, long, tall; (ई), m., N. of various trees, Andersonia Rohitaka; the sacred fig-tree, Ficus Religiosa; the Indian fig-tree, Ficus Indica; (इणी), f., N. of various plants, [cf. रोहिणी।]
रोहिष्: रोहिष्, ट्, f. = रोहित्, a doe; = रौहिष।
रोहिष: रोहिष, अस्, m. a kind of fragrant grass; a species of fish; a kind of deer. —रोहिष-तृण = भूति।
रोहिष्यै: रोहिष्यै, dat. of an unused form रोहिषी or रोहिषि, used as a Ved. inf.
रोहीतक: रोहीतक, अस्, m. = रोहितक, Andersonia Rohi-taka; N. of a place or of a mountain, (according to some a stronghold on the borders of Multan is so called.)
रौक्म: रौक्म रौक्म, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. रुक्म), golden, adorned with gold.
रौक्मिणेय: रौक्मिणेय, अस्, m. a metronymic from Ruk-miṇī, epithet of Pradyumna.
रौक्षक: रौक्षक रौक्षक, अस्, m. a patronymic.
रौक्ष्य: रौक्ष्य रौक्ष्य, अम्, n. (fr. रूक्ष), rough-ness, hardness, dryness, aridity, emaciation; rough-ness, harshness, cruelty, uncouthness.
रौचनिक: रौचनिक रौचनिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. रोचना), coloured with Rocanā, Rocanā-coloured, yellowish; (अम्), n. the tartar of the teeth.
रौच्य: रौच्य, अस्, m. (fr. रुच्य = बिल्व), a staff of Bilva wood; (according to some) an ascetic with a staff of Bilva wood, a patronymic of the thir-teenth Manu; of the ninth Manu, (in these senses fr. रुचि); (अस्, &c.), of or belonging to the thirteenth Manu.
रौट्: रौट् रौट् or रौड् (see rt. रोड्), cl. 1. P. रौटति, रौडति, to despise, treat with disrespect.
रौढीय: रौढीय रौढीय, आस्, m. pl. (probably fr. रूढि), N. of a grammatical school.
रौद्र: रौद्र रौद्र, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (fr. रुद्र), of or belonging to Rudra or to the Rudras, &c., Rudra-like, violent, impetuous, wrathful, irascible, savage, wild, fearful, terrible, formidable; acute; addressed to Rudra (said of a hymn); called after Rudra (said of a river); bringing or betokening misfortune; (अम्), ind. fearfully, horribly; (अस्), m. a patronymic of a descendant of Rudra; a worshipper of Rudra; heat, warmth, ardor, passion, wrath, rage, (also अम्, n.); the cold season of the year, winter; N. of Yama; of the fifty-fourth year of the Jupiter cycle of sixty years; N. of a particular Ketu (Ved.); (आस्), m. pl., N. of a class of evil spirits; N. of a people; (ई), f., N. of Gaurī; a species of plant (= रुद्र-जटा); N. of a commentary on the Siddhānta-muk-tāvalī by Rudra-bhaṭṭācārya; (अम्), n. formidable-ness, dreadfulness, fierceness, savageness; heat, warmth, solar heat, sunshine; wrath, rage; N. of the Nak-ṣatra Ārdrā when situated under Rudra; N. of a Liṅga; of a Sāman. —रौद्र-कर्मन्, अ, n. a terrible magic rite or one performed for some dread-ful purpose; (आ, आ, अ), doing dreadful acts, perform-ing horrors; (आ), m., N. of a son of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra. —रौद्र-कर्मिन्, ई, इणी, इ, doing dreadful acts, performing fearful things. —रौद्र-ता, f. wild or savage state, fierceness, fearful condition, horribleness, formidableness, dreadfulness. —रौद्र-दर्शन, अस्, आ, अम्, of dreadful appearance, formidable, ter-rific. —रौद्र-पाद, (apparently) N. of a Nak-ṣatra (= रौद्र = आर्द्रा). —रौद्र-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. savage-minded, fierce. —रौद्राश्व (°र-अश्°), अस्, m., N. of a son or more distant descendant of Puru. —रौद्री-भाव, अस्, m. the character of Rudra or Śiva.
रौद्रक: रौद्रक = रुद्रेण कृतम्, see Gaṇa Kulālādi to Pāṇ. IV. 3, 118.
रौद्राग्न: रौद्राग्न, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. रुद्र + अग्नि), Ved. relating to Rudra and Agni.
रौद्राणी: रौद्राणी in रौद्राणी-स्तोत्र, probably for रु-द्राणी-स्तोत्र।
रौद्रायण: रौद्रायण, अस्, m. a patronymic from Rudra.
रौद्रि: रौद्रि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Rudra.
रौध: रौध रौध, अस्, m. a patronymic from Rodha.
रौधादिक: रौधादिक रौधादिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. रु-धादि), belonging to the class of roots beginning with रुध्, i. e. the seventh class.
रौधिर: रौधिर रौधिर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. रुधिर), bloody, consisting of blood, caused by blood.
रौप्य: रौप्य रौप्य, अस्, &c. (fr. रूप्य), made of silver, silver; like silver, silvery; (आ), f., N. of a place; (अम्), n. silver. —रौप्य-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of silver, made of silver, silver. —रौप्य-माषक, अस्, m. a Māṣaka weight of silver.
रौप्यायणि: रौप्यायणि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Rūpya.
रौम: रौम रौम, अस्, m. a proper N.; (अम्), n. a kind of salt (= रौमक below). —रौम-ल-वण, अम्, n. salt from the Rumā district, (see below.)
रौमक: रौमक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 2. रोमक), Roman, spoken by the inhabitants of the Roman empire; derived or coming from the astronomer Romaka; (अम्), n. a kind of salt procured from a salt-lake near Sambhar in Ajmere, (in this sense fr. रुमा।)
रौमकीय: रौमकीय (fr. रोमक), see Gaṇa Kṛśāvādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80.
रौमण्य: रौमण्य रौमण्य (fr. रोमन्), see Gaṇa Saṅkāśādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80.
रौमशीय: रौमशीय (fr. रोमश), see Gaṇa Kṛśāśvādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80.
रौमहर्षणक: रौमहर्षणक, अस्, इका, अम् (fr. रोमहर्-षण), made or composed by Roma-harṣaṇa.
रौमायण: रौमायण (fr. रोमन्), see Gaṇa Pakṣādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80.
रौम्य: रौम्य रौम्य, आस्, m. pl., N. of particular evil spirits in the service of Agni.
रौरव: रौरव रौरव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. रुरु), made of the hide of the deer called रुरु; fearful, dread-ful, terrible; unsteady, cheating, fraudulent, dishonest; (अस्), m. a savage; N. of one of the hells (Manu IV. 88); of the fifth Kalpa; (अम्), n. the fruit of the Ruru tree; N. of various Sāmans.
रौरवक: रौरवक = रुरुणा कृतम्, see Gaṇa Kulālādi to Pāṇ. IV. 3, 118.
रौरुकिन्: रौरुकिन्, इनस्, m. pl. (fr. रुरुक), the school of Ruruka.
रौशर्मन्: रौशर्मन् रौशर्मन्, आ, m. a proper N.
रौहिक: रौहिक रौहिक = रुह इव, see Gaṇa Aṅgulyādi to Pāṇ. V. 3, 108.
रौहिण: रौहिण रौहिण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. रोहिणी), born under the Nakṣatra Rohiṇī; (अस्), m. the sandal tree; the Indian fig-tree; N. of Agni; of a demon vanquished by Indra; a proper N. (according to Naigh. I. 10) = मेघ, a cloud; N. of a gramma-tical school; (अम्), n. sandal-wood; N. of the ninth Muhūrta of the day; इन्द्रस्य राजन-रौहिणे and धातू रौहिणम्, N. of particular Sāmans.
रौहिणक: रौहिणक, अम्, n., N. of a Sāman.
रौहिणायन: रौहिणायन, अस्, m. (fr. रोहिण), a patronymic of Priya-vrata.
रौहिणि: रौहिणि, इस्, m. a patronymic; रौहिणेर् एकर्-षे राजनम्, N. of a Sāman.
रौहिणेय: रौहिणेय, अस्, m. (fr. रोहिणी), a metronymic; a calf, (also ई, f.); N. of Bala-rāma; the planet Mercury; (अम्), n. an emerald. —रौहिणेश्वर-तीर्थ (°ण-ईश्°), अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.
रौहित: रौहित, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. रोहित), coming from the animal or fish called रोहित; relating to Manu Ro-hita; (अस्), m., N. of a son of Kṛṣṇa.
रौहितक: रौहितक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. रोहितक), Ved. made from the wood of the Andersonia Rohitaka.
रौहिदश्व: रौहिदश्व, अस्, m. (fr. रोहिद्-अश्व), a patro-nymic of Vasu-manas.
रौहिष्: रौहिष्, ट्, m. = रौहिष, a kind of deer.
रौहिष: रौहिष, अस्, m. (according to Uṇādi-s. I. 48. fr. rt. 1. रुह्; cf. रोहित्, रोहित, रोहिष), a kind of deer; a species of fish, = रोहित; (ई), f. a doe of the Rauhiṣa species; a creeper (= लता); = दूर्वा; a sort of grass (= कत्-तृण).
रौही: रौही, f. the female of a particular kind of deer.
रौहीतक: रौहीतक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. रोहीतक), coming from the Andersonia Rohitaka, made of Andersonia Rohitaka wood; coming from the district Rauhīta; (अस्), m. = रोहीतक, Andesonia Rohitaka.
रौहीतदेश: रौहीत-देश, अस्, m., N. of a country.
रौहेय: रौहेय (fr. रोह), see Gaṇa Sakhyādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80.
